reviewsWithKeywords.text: After a three week visit in Hawaii, this was the best beach we visited. Lots of space to sit on the Sand or grassy area to suntan or read a book. Ocean on the left-hand side of the beach is calm. Soft sand and easy swimming and snorkeling. Water in the middle is a little rocky but great for snorkeling. Ocean on the right leads to a small island about 100 yards offshore. Lifeguards are there to tell you when it is safe, or unsafe, to swim in that area. 6 to 10 turtles sleep on the beach at night. In the mornings you can watch them go out to see. And in the evenings, just before sunset, you can watch them return.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Saw turtles, decent snorkeling, great sand but rocky in the water. We loved trekking out to the little island/sandbar, cool little adventure for my 4 and 5yo.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice Sandy beach.  They have picnic facilities.  It is good snorkeling place, especially for beginners.  They have showers right on the beach by the picnic area.  It does tend to be quite crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poipu Beach - rocky and painful but ok for snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is true that you will see fish while snorkeling here.  So, in that respect it is worthwhile.  However, under the water it is nothing but rocks (which apparently pass as coral in Hawaii).  There is a strip of sand on the beach  to lay on but it becomes rocks instantly as the water begins.  Don't go expecting family friendly frolicking in the sand because the water will dash you on the rocks below.  Also, the rip current was very strong and the lifeguards kept yelling at people to leave and move from the west half moon part of the beach to the east half.  Worth a short visit for snorkeling but not much else.  Go to Kiahuna beach just to the west and you'll have a much better time.  It has a sandy bottom to please your toes while wading, is a pretty beach and also a few places to snorkel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Views & Waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach location is ideal and the views of the coast and waves were amazing. There were sea turtles about 50 feet off the shoreline, which was memorable. The power of the waves were unforgettable. A great location to take in the sun and ocean

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect for kids and swimming
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Yes, I’m giving this a 5 star for this reason. After 5 days in Kauai this was the only beach that was sunny (East and North shores were windy and overcast the entire time. Additionally, we saw many turtles and a monk seal. You could actually swim here and snorkel. Probably the most calm waters we saw and this was June. They have multiple bathrooms and picnic tables. We got to the beach at 10am two different days and there was plenty of parking.  Even when we left at 2pm there were a couple spots. Yes, it got very crowded on the beach but you can find a place. There is a restaurant across the street that opened for lunch at 11am. Decent food. They also had a deli with smoothies and other items.  This beach saved out visit to Kauai after dealing with overcast skies and big waves on the East and North side of the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded, fun surfing!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very crowded. Marriott and other vacation clubs are right off this beach. However, the reef is awesome for viewing sealife, the waves are great for surfing and boogie boarding (and there's on-site surf lessons and rentals), and plenty of sun to fortify that tan. The sand here is stickier than most beaches so be prepared to have it stuck to you until you scrub it off with soap and water. Hawaiian Seals laying on the beach, greens nearby for lounging, kicking a ball, playing volleyball, etc. Concessions and picnic tables nearby. Some areas are monitored by lifeguards whereas others aren't. Occasional riptides and currents.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: my favorite beach of the whole trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I would definitely check out this beach - great for snorkeling, and you can swim out to a small sandbar to see tide pools. There are also picnic areas and bathrooms. Stay til dusk to sea the turtles come up at night!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach, but come early or late to get a spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really nice beach, great to surf, swim or snorkel.  On the day we were there, we were joined by a Monk Seal, so it was very memorable.  The reason for 4 and not 5, is that at mid day it felt over-crowded and finding a parking spot took about half hour.  Plan accordingly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Easy walk to the water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Short beach. The walk to the water is mostly hard surface so easier on joints. The water is wonderful and if you’re there at sunset, the turtles come onto shore to rest for the night. Now that is worth waiting for! Also the hot dog place has good hot dogs and terrific lemonade but the shave ice is not the best on the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful enclosed beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with enclosed tidal pools for safe swimming and active lifeguard station for a safe and fun experience. Nice covered picnic tables to enjoy our Puka Dog lunch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good snorkeling but shallow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was our first time snorkeling at Poipu Beach. There were lots of fish which was great. However it's very shallow and I got some cuts from the coral. As a bonus, there was a turtle on the beach that was fun to watch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great family beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Calm enough durning the day to snorkel. Nice variety of fish to see but reef is quite grey. Bring a beach chair and umbrella. Some days you can find people placing volleyball. Nice eateries close and free parking lot available.Can be quite busy

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This is the BEST place to snorkel!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited many beaches and Poipu was by far the best to snorkel and swim.  Wear swim shoes to get past the rocks at the entrance, but then so many beautiful fish can be seen!  You may also see Sea turtles and monk seals resting on the shore during the day, carefully watched over by volunteers who set up the ropes and signs to protect them.   We stayed at a Suite Paradise condo and could walk to the beach from there.  What a treat!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quaint beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach with protected bay (no large surfs) great for swimming, snorkeling, floating.  Well-maintained grass area with picnic tables, jungle-gym; across the street from Puka Dog

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great ocean view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very large beach area with good restrooms. This is a. Ery busy beach though so get there early for a decent parking spot and location. There  were two sea turtles beached on the sand that we got to see make there way to the sea. Plenty of restaurants and shaved ice nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: La Playa Bonita
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach is our favorite beach to visit, only 5 minutes away from where we were staying. We visited Poipu Beach Park nightly to see the Turtles (Honu) swim up to rest, don't use flashlights, the most we saw in one night was 18.  We laid on the beach, the Monk Seals caught some sun rays with us then we snorkeled and got to swim with different Turtles (Honu) on two different days for a minimum of 30 minutes. We saw so many different fish from Wrasses to Trigger Fish to Butterfly and Yellow Tangs to Snowflake Eels. It was the most exhilarating beach and snorkeling experience my girlfriend and I have ever experienced and the day ended with a gorgeous sunset. There's a grassy area with picnic benches to sit on if you don't want to sit on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must Go
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect place for Snorkeling. We also saw a sea turtle right on the beach. There is plenty of picnic tables, shade and kids playground. Restaurants within walking distance as well

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Read Here to Set Your Poipu Beach Expectations
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a classic Kauai beach you cannot miss, but set your expectations carefully.-We sat near Brennecke's Beach Broiler.  There is not much food except Brennecke's-Come early.  Parking is OK, but the beach is popular.-There is not much sand.  Late comers will be on the grass...like me.-There are some picnic tables and toilets-This beach has many personalities.  One section is better for kids.  Another is better for bodysurfing.-There is shade.  But the sun is hot regardless.  Come prepared.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Check Ocean Conditions
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went a little too early in the season and the oceans were pretty rough. Check the Kaui page for ocean conditions. A lot of tourists get in trouble because they don't. If the ocean is pretty rough then Poipu is a safe beach as it has a rocky break halfway around. It's really good for families and kids. The lifeguards are VERY attentive. If you like to snorkel there are a few fish and some fun things to see but if the other beaches are open I would not snorkel here. Very popular beach lots of people, a resort feel. If you've been to beach bathrooms used by lots of people you know what to expect. We will return later in the season next time and probably won't use this beach... but we snorkel and scuba so are looking for other features.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a wonderful beach! The snorkeling is really good with lots of fish. The bottom is rocky so you really need to wear water shoes.  One  side of the snorkeling area seemed to be pretty shallow so it's a good spot for kids. Another part of the beach had a lot of boogie boarders. There are picnic tables, large grassy areas, a playground and lifeguards. This is also an area in which you can see the sea turtles that come to bask, especially early in the day.  We also watched the sunset here. Parking is a little tight, so get there early. There is also a restaurant/snack bar across the street.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go see the turtles and seals
reviewsWithKeywords.text: •	Go early in the morning to see the turtles.  On overcast days they are there for longer (on an overcast morning they were out until around 8:30am).  At dusk, there were also turtles within the waves.  •	You can also probably see monk seals there as well—either sleeping on shore, or playing around in the water. •	While there were a lot of people, there was ample space for everyone and didn't feel crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family-friendly beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Relatively crowded but not overly so (mid-afternoon, midweek). While we were there, two monk seals came right up onto the beach! The lifeguard had to keep warning people that they were wild animals. So cool to see!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtles and Monk Seals
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The titles says it all.  Decent swimming (a few rocks to worry about) and not to rough.  Great home base Beach for our stay.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We love this beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our family loves this beach because there is something for all ages. We all snorkeled and saw a lot of fish. Our young daughter loved the shallow warm water of the kids beach. Next door was perfect for boogie boarding. We saw monk seals, nesting turtles, and seals actually came right in and laid on the beach! Across the street have the best Hawaiian Ice on the island!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Picnic Tables and Grass or Sand that You Can Lay/Sit On | See Turtles!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great views here. We didn't try the swimming here, but had a nice relaxing afternoon. There are picnic tables, restrooms and restaurants nearby - which was great to grab some shaved ice by the beach! There is both sand and grass here. There are some shady areas and some not shady areas. Plenty of people brought their own tents, chairs, etc to enjoy the sceneryParking can get a little tricky here depending on the time that you go, but we did find spots each time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach on South Kauai
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were here in Feb 2022. This is a well-kept and popular beach.  Protected waters are very safe for kids. Get here early in the day and go to the east end of the beach to find sea turtles snoozing.  Covered picnic benches are available to bring your lunch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for swimming or wading in the waves. It is very crowded though with free parking so be patient. There is a lifeguard on duty showers on site and a market across the street for water and the like.Also lots.of monk seals on the neach so please respect amd maintain your distance pleas resist the urge to take a selfie within 100 ft of the seal. Be respectful of the animal. It's not a joke.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sunrise with sea turtles and a monk seal
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 5 sea turtles and a monk seal at sunrise.  Fabulous!  Not very crowded and respectful of the need to stay distanced.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Okay beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Its a decent beach, its very crowded. We did see the monk sea basking on the beach and some turtles in the water. Its okay, but nothing special here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Slice of Heaven
reviewsWithKeywords.text: With unreal snorkeling and an idyllic stretch of sand, we loved our morning here and wish we had time to return. We watched two large sea turtles laying in the sun and then later dragging themselves back into the ocean. Not very challenging to snorkel as the best spots are within the shallow, protected bay, where the fish are plentiful and the coral shows encouraging signs of color.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: good place to snorkel and just layout
reviewsWithKeywords.text: couple different places to snorkel, we found the one just past the main beach, in front of the hotel the best spot, it was a little deeper so you could actually move around more without scraping your knees on the rocks and coral .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great beach good snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Third trip to Kauai it's the most beautiful place on earth. Played golf, whale watched, great food and beautiful scenery,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very pretty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a lovely beach. It is very crowded and busy though. After sunset however,  green seat turtles come ashore and hangout.  So cool to get to see them upclose.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, great views, great wildlife
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach, been coming since I was very little, very nice waves and swimming, but has gotten a lot busier over the years. Boogeyboarding at Brenneneckies next door is amazing, and make sure you check out the shave ice and deli! Saw lots of turtles too which was fantastic!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Difficult snorkel entry
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Check it out first for snorkeling. There is just one less-rocky place to enter the water for snorkeling. But there are sea turrles hanging around at a big rock not far out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved it!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great walk-in snorkeling!  So happy there were lifeguards at this beach, they were friendly, alert and attentive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Whales right off of Poipu!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Plenty of parking, nice facilities and a gorgeous beach make this a perfect beach for families or large groups. We traveled to Kauai with our extended family (a group of 8 including 2 kids under the age of 10), and found Poipu Beach to be an excellent place for swimming and snorkeling for all ages. As an added bonus, we had our own whale watch- with multiple whales breaching and diving for about 15 minutes right off of Poipu Beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sight worth seeing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely incredible place to snorkel, see the sea turtles and seals come onto the beach and watch beautiful sunsets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach with wildlife
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We made several trips here. Some of us went snorkeling which they loved, seeing urchins, turtles, etc underwater. I got to see three turtles on the beach, two trying to mate. Not sure if they did. Each day a monk seal was snoozing some where on the beach much to everyone's delight. The location was not far from our rental. It wasn't too crowded this time of year and people were considerate of each other.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good for snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good for snorkeling Life guards keep close track of all in the water and make announcements frequently to keep swimmers in their space . Life guards also protect wildlife in the water protected from swimmers who come too close . We saw seals and turtles . Restrooms are typical beach quality . Parking  is at premium during prime time hours .Family friendly for picnics . Restaurant across street for take-out if needed .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtles and Monk Seals
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Since we were staying in the Poupou area, we managed to visit the beach a couple times.  We did snorkel here with the turtles but came back twice for the sunsets and to see the turtles come onto the beach in the evening.  My husband runs every morning and mentioned there were more turtles there in the morning than in the evening.One evening, we saw a Monk Seal resting and sunning on the beach.  Know that there are conservationists there to protect the turtles and seals from vacationers.  They will make sure you keep your distance and answer questions you may have about the species.Besides the wildlife, there are picnic tables and modern restrooms for the public.  Parking is also nearby and good.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Such a cool beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stopped here twice, to see the sea turtles and monk seals.  They are protected by volunteers but easy to see, and watch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bring your snorkel gear and come see the turtles!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach to come with kids.  We arrived about 6:30pm (in Feb) to come see the turtles and would highly recommend this.  We also saw a monk seal on the beach and whales in the distance.  Bring snorkel gear - it's much calmer in this area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach with turtles sunning themselves on the sand! We snorkeled here and found it to be a great snorkel spot. The lifeguards are friendly and helpful and parking is good.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We enjoyed the snorkeling there.  There are some rocks that have to be negotiated but well worth the effort.  There are life guards and a shallow area ideal for children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Something for Everyone
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach offers something for everyone!  There was amazing snorkeling area, a small beach shielded from the waves for the little ones, and surfing all within a short distance of each other.  The day we visited, we saw a Hawaiian Green Turtle, and a Monk Seal sunning themselves on the beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice enough beach but way too crowded for me.  Not as pretty as many other beaches but it appears to be a good place to snorkel.  Not too deep and well protected little Bay Area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love the Grassy Areas
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just a great beach to hang out. There’s shallow water for the kids, a nice snorkeling section, boogie boarding - though crowded - nearby restaurants and equipment rental, two lifeguards, and a coastal trail that takes you to the Sheraton and beyond. I especially liked the shady grassy area if you just want to hang out and read a book. Clean and well maintained, there seems to be plenty of parking, but go early on weekends!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded but good for everyone
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are decent snorkeling spots - we saw some sea turtles unexpectedly.  The snorkeling space is rather small and shallow - we found better snorkeling nearby but this would be good for young ones/novice snorkelers since it is patrolled well by lifeguards who keep you in the safe areas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent beach for playing and swimming in the water.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We saw lots of seals here, one laying up on the beach.  It's a large beach, good parking.  The Sheraton is nearby, so it had more people on the beach than  some of the others that we visited, but it was still a great beach to go to.  Multiple life guards, too.  Great for kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach and snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ample free parking just across from a beautiful Kauai beach.  Lifeguard on duty and areas for small children to adventurous adults.  A Hawaiian monk seal was sunbathing on the beach right in front of the lifeguard tower as if he owned the place.  Snorkeling to the west we quickly found a variety of fish including moorish idol fish and a large female sea turtle munching along the rocks.  Great place to enjoy all beach acetivities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy But Spacious Beach with Plenty of Wildlife
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Had a nice time snorkling here. It was pretty busy, lots of families. There are bathrooms and lifeguards. There was one main area that schools of fish were congregating and they got pretty close to you. It was pretty shallow. I saw a turtle swimming. Some areas are harder to swim since it can be rocky and shallow. There is another cove with a beach on the right side of the island that I did not walk down.I went out to the island, but it is very rocky so walk carefully and wear water shoes. Once on the island, there was a seal and 2 turtles sunbathing! Someone had put up rocks as a barrier to allow them some space. There is sand in the middle of the island, and rocks around the edges. You can watch the waves crashing on the rocks. Very few people go to the island because it is slightly difficult to walk to. I did scrape my knee slightly on a rock when heading back to shore but it was worth it.There is plenty of space at this beach. We sat under one of the trees to the far left near some picnic tables. There are lots of chickens and baby chicks running around losing their mothers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Every morning around 6:30 the green sea turtles can be spotted. One morning there were 21! I was also lucky enough to spot a monk seal. The beach is clean and there is a grass area with picnic tables for lunch. There are many chickens that will try and join you for a snack. The snorkeling was good as well. If you time it right, you may spot a green sea turtle swimming back to sea. Sunset is also a magical time to visit this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded.  Not good for swimming- super rocky
reviewsWithKeywords.text: May be good for snorkeling but NOT swimming. Very rocky. several kids got their legs cut up. Bathrooms are really disgusting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach for children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This tucked away little beach with its natural rock enclosure is the perfect beach for children, keeping them safe and well-protected from turbulent waters. It's safe feature also allows parents the comfort to relax as they watch their toddlers and young children play in the sand and water.   The water is calm, the sand is warm, and the grass is inviting for all ages to enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach for families
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent a couple of days at the beach. Go early before the crowds arrive.  Parking is easy and there is food to eat nearby. The snorkeling is surprisingly good on the larger side of the area. You may get to see a Monk Seal too. I'd return here again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family friendly beach with sea life
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Rocky but nice beach! Seal was hanging on beach. Protected beach with minimal shore break. Nice food & shopping close by. Cute little island to walk over to

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Can be a bit crowded but very nice sand beach.  Bathrooms are awful.  Was able to see Monk Seals on the beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Public Beach and a Good Place to Catch Sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came here to try to catch sunset.  We got there in time, but there were clouds along the horizon--still beatiful.Seems like this is quite the spot for surfing.  Good facilities and looks like a great place to spend the day if you're looking to get away from your resort.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good beach, has showers, restrooms and foot washing stations. Like most of the beaches here it is clean. Decent snorkeling overall.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Brennecke’s Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Way too crowded.  Too many tourists.   Which is why the turtles don’t come so if you want to see turtles don’t come here.   Sunset here was very nice.  Riptides snow cone or shredded ice place was super close but other than that not the best beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful Hawaiian beach with plenty of space and parking. Park includes playground and restrooms along with lifeguards.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Average snorkeling, awesome turtle watching at sunrise and sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Snorkeling is ok. Lots of fish in the area. We saw 2 turtles while snorkeling. A LOT more turtles right after sunset (about 10 turtles ~30 minutes after sunset), and 30min before sunrise (we saw at least 15 turtles one morning). Brennecke’s Beach Broiler is right on the beach. Great place for lunch and dinner after snorkeling or turtle watching at sunset

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are two areas to snorkel in...to the left is a secluded area which looked great for the kids and was full of families.  To the right was a more open area where we went.  The only caution is that there is a reef to the right fairly close to shore which we did not know was there until we went out.  It was sharp and hard to cross over without damaging the reef or cutting yourself.  I suggest entering on the secluded side and swimming around the reef if you want to move to the right. We saw quite an assortment of fish and then waited for the sunset.  Great day!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good place to eat lunch, plenty of picnic benches and restrooms
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We've eaten  our Puka Dog twice here and it is a nice place to eat.  There are plenty of tables tho weekend might be too busy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mediocre beach at best.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is very small and very rocky for most of it. It wasn’t terribly busy when we were there, and there still wasn’t a lot of room. I can’t imagine going during  a busy season. Not one of the top 10 beaches in Kauai.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and setting
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely site for swimming-lots of turtles. Great grassy park, too. Brennecke's restaurant across the street.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkel spot!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great snorkeling spot on the right hand side of Poipu beach.  We were able to walk directly from the Sheraton on the boardwalk in the morning.  We saw green sea turtles and a TON of beautiful fish in the surprisingly clear water near the rocks.  Also pulled up a Hawaiian reef crab that was really big :)LOVED IT

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We saw several turtles on the beach each day we came. There are bathrooms and a few places to eat. The ocean floor is very rocky and not sandy, but it makes for great snorkeling. We saw tons of fish

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun snorkeling!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach - 5 starsPoipu Beach is a great park for hanging out and snorkeling. It’s a bit busy, but has easy access to snorkeling with beautiful fish. We even saw an octopus and eels! Parts of the area are shallow for snorkeling, but it was easy to find deeper water. There were also 1 or 2 endangered monk seals on the small island beach. There are public restrooms and showers for rinsing off afterwards.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach with view of sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is lovely. Plenty of parking, washrooms and home of Puka Dog, another restaurant and a deli.There are picnic tables and a covered picnic area and a playground.  There are tons of chickens roaming around the grass areas.It is a great spot to watch the sunset.There is a shallow area almost enclosed by rocks and larger open areas of beach as well.After sunset you can see the turtles come on shore to rest…..but be respectful and stay far back and do not take flash photography as it hurts their eyes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place to watch sunset and see sea turtles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went at sunset upon recommendation of someone we met while here. It was very crowded for sunset but beautiful views. If you stay after sunset, the sea turtles come up on the beach. We waited probably 10 minutes after sunset before they started coming up! Definitely worth it to wait and see!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Average tourist beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Highly over rated, too many people, too many people snorkeling that have no idea what they are doing. If you want a quiet beach or a good snorkeling beach drive around a fund a place to have your solitude.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go early to get parking!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach and area for kids to swim in.  Can get very crowded there, so parking can be an issue.  It is walkable from several of the Poipu resorts - some hills.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poipu Beach , home to many hanu on island.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach is a lovely beach that many honu call home. Be mindful that they are sometimes hard to see when you are entering the water. Don't step an these beautiful turtles. In fact , you must give them space where ever they are on the beach or in the water. This is their home and laws protect them not the tourist in this case. Do not ever touch these beautiful creatures.  Your Zoom lense works beautifully to get upclose and personal. Its the only way.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing and family friendly
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Relaxing family friendly beach. Busy with activities and people. Water entry an be difficult at certain times of the year.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stopped to eat lunch
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was very crowded and small, but it was fine for hanging out on the grass long enough to eat lunch. It was hard to enjoy the waves with all the people crowding the small space, though. If you want to snorkel or swim, I recommend going down to Kuhio Shores.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect for a day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want to spend a day at the beach, Poipu is just about as perfect of a place as can be. The sandy beach is large enough to not be crowded, even when there are a lot of people. The water is relatively calm and there's gentle slope providing a lot of enjoyable space for reluctant swimmers, like myself, who don't like not being able to reach the bottom. Snorkeling is great everywhere, even in knee deep water there are lots of different kinds of fish. You do need to wear either fins or water shoes as the bottom is all coral. There are shaded picnic tables. A number of food options just across the street, including funky Puka Dog, Deli, and ice cream place. And parking is free and sufficient, at least on a weekday.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach to Visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: No it’s not South Beach in Miami, but can certainly appear as such with the crowds of people, but most are respectable of each other’s space.  Going beyond the crowd you have a safe lifeguarded beach with solid surfing to the far right and additionally there are many wildlife sightings.  We we went here two days while in Kauai and saw five seals total sleeping on the beach (and saw two of those make their way to the beach), including a pregnant female, plus while snorkeling saw two giant sea turtles close to 30” long and many other small fish.  With lots of free parking, clean bathrooms and outdoor showers available this is a great beach to spend the day at!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkel spot that won’t worry mom
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great spot for snorkeling. Lots of grass further back from the sand with a moderate amount of palm trees to offer some shade. Covered picnic tables. Showers. Rental shop across the street has snorkel gear, boogie boards, and surfboards. Deli shop with hot dogs and snow cones. Life guards. Lots and lots of fish, I even saw a turtle.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a nice beach. It’s a place to snorkel and swim if you want to spend the day. A little rocky when you are trying to get out snorkeling, but then if you want to swim you can just walk down a 100 yards or so. Definitely beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a bit rocky -  but absolutely delightful! Bathroom available for changing, too.  Food and ample parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This beach has it all.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was excellent!  There were big waves at one end and very little waves at the other due to protection from rocks.  This made it great for my 4 year old to play in the water safely.  We even had a sea turtle come up and rest in the beach!  There is also a park with a play structure perfect for drying off.  Plenty of bathrooms and areas to picnic. There is a restaurant with carry out across the street. It wasn’t too crowded.  And it was beautiful. Also has lifeguards on duty at designated times.  We almost spent the whole day here. Definitely missing this beach now that we’re back on the east coast.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not a lot of Shade
reviewsWithKeywords.text: But wonderful beach.  It’s close to th main road.  There’s parking; picnic tables.  Across the street there’s a restaurant; surf; n a MUST hv Puka Dog.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An easy access beach with fantastic snorkeling and boogey-boarding right off the beach.  The fish were colorful and plentiful.  You can rent snorkel gear right across the road.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach to hit the waves. Super clear water and awesome waves. Saw a few giant turtles. Bring a chair, food and drink as the lines are long at the shop

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great adventurous day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach waves and rocks were a bit rough, all of us have some battle wounds. But worth the trip and experiece (Kids: 17-f, 15-f. 15-M, 12-F). Plus, 5 adults. The island was fun but challeging to tackle. We saw a full size sea turtle basking in the sun on the little island. Plus, a small one playing in the choral. Do not approach the island the shortest distance go over through the middle. At the end (shortest distances) is rough with waves hitting you from both directions and trying to navigate the choral. All of us have some wounds from the choral and learned our lessons the hard way. There is a very protected area for small children that is almost as calm as a swimming pool and swallow. Boring for the teens but great for the littles.Snorkeling was okay..but the day we were there was rougher than normal.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Too many resorts, too many people for this small beach.  Rocky ground.  Nice sunsets. Visit early or late in day to find parking space and uncrowded beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, great snorkeling, have to walk over rocks to get to snorkel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu is a great beach, with lifeguard, picnic tables, restrooms, and lots of fish.  Good place for easy snorkeling, although the rocks make it somewhat difficult to get into water deep enough to float and observe.   Best bet is to get a setup of water shoes and fins without a bottom that strap around the back of your heel.  While I didn’t see turtles swimming, there were three of them sunning on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Must See
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My only regret is that we did not have a lot of time to spend at this beach. It is beautiful and very well maintained. There were picnic tables in the shade and plenty of beach space (we were there early, but there was a constant stream of people coming in). It looked like a good spot for snorkeling. I think this would be a good beach for families with young kids as there are shallow areas with minimal waves. We did see one sea turtle on the beach. He was in an area marked off with rocks. I was told that there are more turtles earlier in the morning but once the beach starts to get a lot of activity they don't come on shore as much. All the better, get there early, see the turtles and stake out a spot for the day. This is a must see beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Well Maintained Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very well maintained beach with attentive lifeguards who watch to make sure guests are not bothering the seals or turtles that sometimes beach on the island area near the beach.  The bathrooms are well maintained and there was plenty of parking each day that we went.  Nearby you can rent different beach gear to snorkel or boogey board.  If you have small children that want to snorkel here, I would recommend a snorkel vest or some type of floatation device because the waves can get strong.   While you will see some fish here and even some sea turtles, the Lawai Beach area has many more fish to see when snorkeling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtles and snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely a must see if you are nearby. Shallow park water that is perfect for snorkeling. We walked up and marveled at the three sea turtle sculptures only to realize that they were REAL sea turtles on the beach. This was around 9:30 AM. There is a shallow sandy area perfect for young children. BRING WATER SHOES or flippers if you want to go further into the water it’s rocky but you will see the most beautiful fish and sea urchins and coral. There are lifeguards who make sure you don’t go too far because the current will make it difficult to swim back. When we resurfaced we were able to watch the final sea turtle return to the ocean. Absolutely a beautiful experience. We also watched a seal come up for some sun. People were mostly respectful but a few people needed some reminders to give them plenty of space.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent Place to Snorkel for Beginners
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent beach within an enclosed cove for little kids.  There is excellent snorkeling even on the shallow part of the tidepools.  Saw a trash can lid sized Green Sea Turtle on the same.  Everyone was respectful and kept their distance from the turtle.  There are lifeguards on duty.  It can get very hot.  Bring lots of sunblock or an umbrella.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice swimming place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Was very crowded when we were there but nice little place to swim and snorkel. Protected by a reef so no waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtle & Sea lions
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our family stayed in the nearby Ocean facing condo. Poipu beach park was excellent. To our surprise, when we went to watch sunset we saw Sea Lions and Turtles crawling all over the beach. Wonderful place to watch sunset and amphibians.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sun & Honu!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We enjoy this beach for sunbathing, people watching, snorkeling, and bobbing in the water. This is the place for spring sunsets. After the sun goes down, the Honu (green sea turtles) come out to sleep.  (KEEP YOUR DISTANCE)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Little sand, lots of people, and a monk seal.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After having spent the first half of our trip on the more isolated North Shore (as a result of the restricted access via the Kuhio Highway), Poipu Beach was a let-down.  Perhaps if it had been our first stop, we would have been more pleased.  The area is made up of small coves with limited and steep beaches against a backdrop of corporate resorts.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach to hang out. We saw (up close) a sea lion and turtle sun bathing which was an unexpected and unique experience. Right across the street is puka dog which was delicious.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: fun, beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a beautiful and relaxing beach. We took our breakfast out there and ate with the chickens. Wonderful, clean beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Huge sea turtles at night and monk seals during the day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were close buy so we walked this beach many times. Public park here so parking and bathrooms. If you're on the south shore go place to walk, swim and see the animals

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This crescent shape beach offers crystal clear waters. Very popular with visitors and locals alike however,  it has been empty since the pandemic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I’d recommend this beach always sunny even when rest of island is raining. So come here for the day stay for the week.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice snorkeling daytime and turtles at night !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice small beach- has a cute snorkeling spot for daytime and easy to rent snorkel gear at Koa Kea hotel and Marriott beach club nearby. During day, we saw a giant turtle or two.At night , we saw almost twenty turtles on the beach sleeping!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fire ball sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wasn’t a lot of people there tonight but normally I hear it is packed -the sky was beautiful fire ball and the beach is really nice

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach--wonderful snorkeling, nice bathrooms, nice grass area, palm trees for shade, good showers.  The snorkeling is pretty good, and we had luck with monk seals and turtles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach for young children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a good beach for young children because the island/natural jetty creates a sheltered cover from waves that is very shallow. Snorkeling is okay not great. The beach is the most overcrowded beach on the island and not totally sure why.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poipu Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Since COVID-19 it's been a pleasant beach to go being less crowded and safe for kids under the age of 5 to enjoy the water. While the side closer to Sheraton caters more toward juniors and adults who wants to snorkel, body board and surf. 2 life guard towers operates til 5pm daily. Ocean currents remains strong daily.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful family spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach Park is a lovely park ideal for families as it has a beautiful, shallow lagoon that children can walk and swim in safely. There are very nice picnic tables plus a lifeguard station. Poipu is the sunniest side of the island, so beach days here are a great experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun beach with a lot of fish and a giant turtle!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a busy but fun beach with good snorkel opportunity and the day we were there, a big sea turtle came to the shore to visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: popular place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: it was busy w/lots of people, but manageable.  the water was very clear.  snorkeling was great.  we saw tons of colorful fish.  very protected beach from the surf.  we didn't need to snorkel too far out because the fish were all about us just a few feet into the water.  good facilities....restrooms, picnic tables etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kauai Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We rented a condo a walking distance from Poipu Beach Park.  It is a great place for families with a shallow water area, deeper area for snorkeling, an island and surfing areas.  There are two life guard towers, showers and restrooms.  This is a beautiful sandy beach to catch sun rays and to see turtles and monk seals.  Great place to sit and relax as well as get in the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It rained all day but a got a break for a quick stroll
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It makes a very nice stroll after a big meal while enjoying the scenic views. There's a unique small area especially suited for young children to enjoy the beach safely.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach with not too strong of waves, we had a great time there. We were a family with 8 people ranging in age from 7 to 72.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded, but great swimming and snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is pretty narrow, so less sand for sitting or laying out on, and hence, a bit more crowded than some. It's great for snorkeling and nice for swimming. Wear swim shoes for the rocks under the water, although I didn't and found it was still easy enough to swim and float. I advise arriving earlier than 11am. Parking and a good beach spot were easier to find before that time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family friendly beach at the south end of Kauai
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu beach is widely known locally and among tourists as one of the best family friendly beaches in Kauai. This beach is excellent for families even with small kids. There are rocks forming a cove that protects the beach from the relentless waves of the Pacific ocean. Poipu beach is a good swimming and snorkeling beach. It is also a place to see monk seals and turtles sunbathing on the beach. Poipu beach is also know for its excellent sunsets.There are public restrooms and outdoor showers. There are lifeguards. There is sufficient parking. There are covered pavillions with tables. There are nearby restaurants for shaved ice and meals.I would recommend this beach while visiting Kauai.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach with easy access
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We said just across the street of Poipu Beach park.  The beach and surrounding area is just beautiful.  We saw turtles and monk seals sunning themselves.  It’s a great place for kids and families.  We watched the waves roll in and crash for hours on the rocky areas of the park and played in the water on the sandy beaches.  We watched the sunset at night.  Loved the ares.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This may be a great spot in the early morning but later in the day it was crowded. Maybe a mini Waikiki but still the snorkling was fun and you can see a lot of colorful fish

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good place on Kauai for Snorkeling. Beach can be crowded, but if you go early you will not have a problem.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large beach with lots of people. Not the place to go if you want to avoid crowds, but  great for snorkeling (SO many fish and we saw a HUGE sea turtle just offshore). Easy parking if you go early and multiple lifeguard stands, decent bathrooms, shady areas and a nearby spot for food help explain why it is so popular.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go around the corner
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Go around the corner to the beach in front of the Marriott Waiohai. Often, there is a monk seal on this beach. Do not snorkel near the island where most of the people are swimming. Go to the right, directly in front of the Marriott for the best snorkeling. Also, this beach, in the wintertime, is often the only one suitable for swimming with your kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy but Great
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach located in a somewhat busy area. Great snorkelling with lots of seals and sea turtle to see. The primary swimming area is fairly shielded from the ocean so the waves are never too big, so it’s good for smaller kids. Absolutely worth your time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful swimming beach with turtle and Monk Seals
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed near this beach and enjoyed walking, wading and swimming here. On the last day, we saw a monk seal and two turtles on the beach with two more turtles on the island. Lots of local families enjoying the beach. Clean grass and sand

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very crowded.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There wasn't much free space and the grounds are pretty worn down from all the use.  The surf was pretty high the day we were there, so the lifeguards had their hands full trying to keep everyone safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mother Daughter Adventure
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very accessible beach. With beach chairs in hand we made our way to a nearby palm tree for the partial shade I was looking for. Hit the waves to cool off. Brought water shoes to cross rock areas to small island where we found a large turtle sunbathing. Brilliantly colored fish along the way. Clean restroom facility with enclosed changing area. Grassy areas and picnic tables nearby. Cool little store to grab water, candy and a sandwich.Went to Brennecke’s for Happy Hour.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a nice family friendly beach with lifeguards on duty. We stayed nearby so we were able to walk right over. Lots of fish to see if you snorkel. If you go after sunset, you can see turtles relaxing on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to this beach twice. The first time we snorkeled and enjoyed the sun. The second time it was quite windy with occasional rain showers and there was a bit of a rip current so we didn't snorkel as much. However we saw several turtles in resting from the high surf and also a monk seal!  A really nice beach with a lifeguard and usually good swimming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Beach With It All
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Turtles, snorkeling, whales, monk seals, walking, sand for digging in, and lifeguards...what more could you ask for in a public access beach?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Public and perfect. Walk between the beaches and enjoy the water. Safe to swim and fun to watch the surfers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wedding
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach near Marriott Waiohai hotel. There is life guard as well. Good snorkeling area as well. Loved it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A definite favorite of ours.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent a lot of time here, walking, snorkeling, beaching.  Nice restrooms and wonderful showers.  Loved "doing" our beach thing here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is known for snorkeling and it is a good place for that.   The parking is good especially if you arrive early, there are restaurants and stores across the street and the park has shaded picnic tables, restrooms, and lifeguards.  The fish are abundant and the water is shallow.  Recommend for snorkeling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great family beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Easy fun snorkeling in shallow water.  Lots of fish, bot much coral.  Lovely sand. Probably not best for boogie boarding, wVes were too minimal.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Huge beach, crowded, & please leave the sea turtles alone!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Huge beach, very crowded, has lifeguards. We would recommend going early to get a good parking spot and a nice spot on the beach. Loads of sea turtles basking in the beach - but please LEAVE THEM ALONE!  We were so frustrated to see idiot tourists going up right next to them, petting them and even surrounding them blocking their return to the ocean. The lifeguards were directly in front of this; perhaps it is not their job to protect the poor sea turtles, so I had to ask people several times to PLEASE leave the sea turtles alone and to stop blocking their attempt to swim back into the ocean!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Spot for Children to Enjoy the Water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is what we call "baby beach".  There is a gentle protected shallow bay for kids to be able to play without the worry of waves.  This spot has gotten so much more crowded over the years.  Don't expect a quiet relaxing day at the beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Watched Sunset Here Every Night for a Week
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I don't like to repeat things when I travel, but when things are this good, how could I not? Every evening at sunset, I would go to the beach with my kids, order shaved ice and (amazing) Kona Mud Pie ice cream, and drink a beer while watching the sunset--each unique, extraordinary.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The reviews are correct ! A fantastic beach- one if the best in Hawaii,!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lifeguard protected! Fine sand ,great for sunbathing!  lots of ocean frontage, reef protected, great for scuba and snorkel and swimming. Lots of ocean life - might even see humpbacks out in the deeper water. Lots of sun- worshippers, local and tourists. Nearby parking, nearby food. Come and stick an umbrella in the sand , park your cooler , swim, snorkel or whatever and enjoy life! The sun is intense, so bring the sunscreen.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to watch the whales from the beach and relax!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a perfect beach for protected swimming and snorkeling and watching the whales from beach chairs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family Friendly
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fun place to take the family for some snorkeling.  It's a pretty beach that is clean and safe.  Some shade available. Parking available too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach with all you need to spend a day alone or with kids. And there are turtles!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My 7 and 10-year-olds enjoyed playing around the lava wall for crabs, fish and other creatures. They then spent hours playing in the waves and the sand. The beach has sheltered tables, great showers, and a changing room. It is also across from a nice restaurant and a bistro. Loved it! Some folks were also snorkeling, but we did not try it, so cannot say anything about that.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Calm waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water was nice and calm even though it was incredibly windy with a high surf warning at the time. The beach was a little crowded, but there was still plenty of space. Our toddler loved the playground next to the beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poipu Beach is Kauai’s best all-around beach for tourists on the south shore.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach is Kauai’s best all-around beach for tourists on the south shore. Many would say the best beach overall (see photos). Nice wide and rather long beach with a grassy park next to it overlooking a beautiful post-card ocean scene. Because a reef protects it, normally the waves are small making it great for swimming, snorkeling, and safe for supervised kids. There is good parking and Brennecke’s is a nice restaurant there that also sells food, drinks, etc. for the beach. Try their smoothies – great. A better place for swimming at Kauai’s Poipu Beach due to fewer rocks is to the right (looking at ocean and before the Marriot). Do be careful because less doesn’t mean no rocks. Get some beach shoes and you can swim with much less worry. The best snorkeling is just to the right of the lifeguard station – you will probably see several other snorkelers right where you want to go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Some of the best snorkeling in Hawaii
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited Hawaii in December, so many of the northern beaches had waves too big for snorkeling.  Poipu Beach was the perfect alternative.  Great fish, good reef and excellent snorkeling.  Parking wasn't bad either!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good parking across the street
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ample Parking across the street and also at Brennecke’s Beach Broiler.  Some grass area and then beach.  Good people watching location.  Lots of people trying to snorkel in the cove and in deeper location.  It’s a little tricky trying to navigate the basalt getting-in-and-out of the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Baby beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place with a sheltering break wall so the kids don’t get taken out by the waves. A little rocky but it’s still a great spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Anniversary trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Enjoyed this beach for sun bathing and snorkeling! Able to rent some chairs too. A couple of guys strolling the beach playing ukulele and small drum were entertaining.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Everything for everybody, young and old
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This park is a jewel. While not huge it has a couple of lovely beaches for soaking up the sun AND many shady areas for not getting too much sun. It has both wading areas and waves that make for good body surfing. It has a lifeguard station and toilet facilities. As I said, fun for all ages (and conditions). The resident roosters are a hoot as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Little Gem of Poipu!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's THE place to be - sunrise, daytime, or sunset! Great for kids, popular for snorkelers & SUP-ers, fun for just being in the sand & gentle surf. You can grab a drink & snacks from the Marriott bar, walk the paved beachwalk, and just relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach and park, with easy snorkeling. Even on a bit of a rainy day, we had a good time. Grills and shelters are available for picnics. We saw a lot of cool ocean life, too!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kauai 2020
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Raining in Princeville where we were staying so we headed for Poipu one day  in search of sun and found it! It was a bit windy but still nice. Small beach for Hawaii but a protected cove. The waves outside were a bit strong but the water on the left side of the cove were as still as a lake! Great spot for small children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkel Here all Day!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We just love everything about this area and this beach. We've met so many wonderful people from all parts of the world at it.  The snorkeling here is fun and easy. Not to mention, often times sea lions and sea turtles come on shore to nap. It's just lovely to see. Along with the beautiful sunsets. LOVE THIS BEACH

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We could walk from the Marriott so that was great. I brought my snorkel from home and the fish were amazing. I didnt even bother taking a snorkle trip as I saw so many fish just by stepping off the beach. Off the beach some 100 feet was a little island or sand bar that i swam out to and it was like i was away from the crowd even though there were other folks there checking it out

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Popular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very popular spot with locals and tourists. Safe swimming but parking was an issue. Some snorkeling in the bay and a fairly small sand area

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach & snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited this beach multiple times, not only because it was close to where we stayed but also because we found it to be one of the most pleasant for snorkeling or just bobbing around in inflatable tubes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful little gem on the Pacific.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Easy snorkel access at Poipu Beach Park. Lifeguards to ease any worry over your kids or even your own swim safety in the Pacific. Some wave and surf surge. Protected sandy beach with some limited coral growth. Numerous tropical fish, large and small, all colors, and a turtle beached itself the sunny day we were here. Chickens are abundant but not overwhelming. Good idea to take your own tent, chairs, towels and supplies. Surfers are off to the waves west the beach. Warm sun and dry beach even when it’s stormy on the north shore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and family friendly
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We saw a turtle resting on the beach and most people were respectful of its space. The beach is extremely clean with beautiful golden sand. The snorkeling was relatively easy - we didn't see anything spectacular, but we did see a few colourful fish and an eel. The access into the water is easy. Good for beginner snorkelers and the water was not too rough when we went.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice, Family friendly Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Within walking distance from several condo complexes & hotels in the area. Very nice family friendly beach with lifeguards, restrooms, rinse off showers, picnic tables & pavilions ( first come first serve) as well as a playground for the kids. Plenty of street parking & a parking lot across the street. Brenneckes deli also across the street for sandwiches & drinks to enjoy a picnic lunch. Saw a turtle sunning on the beach one day and lots of snorkelers with the calm surf. Very popular on the weekends, so get there early for your pick of spots !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach for young children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the place to go if you want safe, secure and close to amenities.  It is crowded and unless you prefer to stay well within a comfort zone, there are better places to spend the day.  As an adventure couple, we walked in and promptly left going to Shipwreak instead.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun day out
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice white sand beach right in  Poipu.Nice outing.Beautiful place to go and relax for a few hours.Very accessible .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded and dirty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have been to Poipu beach twice. Both times it was very crowded and dirty. If you go, bring some shade, there is not much shade to be had here. Good for snorkeling if you don’t mind the crowds. There are restrooms with changing rooms that are relatively clean considering the amount of use. We heard about Anini beach on the North Shore, and liked it much better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice but getting busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have gone to this beach now 4 times over the last 20 years and it continues to get more popular and crowded. This is a great beach in a good location but is losing its appeal as it gets more and more crowded. Still a great place if you have kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Great Beach ... with parking!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent two days at this beach last week.  Nice sheltered area for little kids, lots of colorful fish to see while snorkeling in 2-6 ft of water, lifeguard on duty, washrooms and showers nearby.  We also saw green turtle and monk seal while there.  Recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beaches of Kauai
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved all the beaches on south and west side of island. Not very crowed on the day we were there and waves were calm

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice place to visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice park with beach areas and rock areas.  Sea turtles and monk seals are common sights here.  Beautiful area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Be sure to pop by this beach for sunset - lovely view and a really nice spot to relax.  Not too busy. aLoved it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy and beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s a beach on the busy side. With all the hotels around, it’s understandable. We thought we might snorkel but felt like the water was a tad too cold to have an enjoyable experience. Saw a turtle which was really cool.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach Day Fun Day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There were 17 of us staying in 2 condos on Poipu. Ages ranging from 1-62! We all had a blast. Perfect beach for kids. Clean and safe. Bathroom facilities, picnic areas, playground, snorkeling, swimming without dangerous waves. Restaurant, small convenience store and beach shop right across the street. Perfect day in Poipu.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Sunset!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went here on our first evening in Kauai and it did not disappoint.  The sunset was amazing but the seals were even better!  A mom and pup were sleeping on one side and a male on the other.  The caretakers had them roped off so no one could disrupt their slumber but lots of people were taking photos of them.  Beautiful sight.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good and bad
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Insanely crowded. Not good for swimming due to strong RIP tides, rocks, coral, and sea urchins. However, great for snorkeling. Saw 4 sea turtles and a monk seal.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Safe & Fun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for first time snorkeling.  Fish swim right next to you close to shore in 3 feet deep water and turtles can be seen just a little further out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A gem
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had stopped for a “quick peek” at this beach and ended up staying over 4 hours. The beach was clean and beautiful, the snorkeling was fantastic and despite the crowds it didn’t feel crowded. The bonus of the day was the 3 turtles that swam up on the beach that we were able to view and admire. Tip: bring Kleenex or toilet paper as there was not any in the stalls.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, very crowded though
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu beach was said to be the best beach on Kauai. I would disagree with this. Although in the morning, it’s beauty truly is present, the amount of people that flood the beach make it a less desirable destination. It does have a nice beach bar with cocktails across the street however. In my opinion, the beaches on the north shore were far superior. If you do stay on the south side, check out the ocean kayak adventure as they will take you to beaches with monk seals that are truly beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach for snorkeling. Lots of fish and they are so use to people they swarm around your legs when standing and follow you when you are swimming. The water is clear and not very deep. The variety of fish was better than we've seen on other islands. There is a spot on one side that is the perfect kiddie pool. We didn't go there we snorkeled by the lifeguard stand. This is a must go to beach. Take a lunch and spend the day or there is a restaurant across the street.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poipu Beach Park is Perfect
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We enjoyed this spot so much we came back twice during our vacation. There were five sea turtles that came up on the beach and two monk seals were also nearby. There is a lifeguard on duty which was comforting as the currents were wild. We saw them go out on a rescue with snorkelers that went way too far out and couldn’t get back. Snorkeling was good and there are restrooms with a changing room for your convenience. It was a definite highlight for us.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Watch for Rip Tides
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband and I wanted to do some snorkeling during our January vacation to Kauai  and were told Poipu beach was the place but the life guard warned us about dangerous rip tides so we didn't go into the water.  Parking is limited so go early if you want a spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic Fireworks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a great place from which to view New Year's Eve fireworks. An excellent white sand beach that is an easy walk from many condos and hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hawaiian Christmas
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was walking distance from the home we rented. Great surf and lots of sand. Grandchildren had awesome time on their bougy boards.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach nice park
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great park and beach for families.  It does great crowded and parking can be a bit of a challenge.   We always have parked creatively and never received a ticket.  Nice aloha spirit.  Watch for monk seals.  They can be found sunning on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When we visited, it was a cloudy, blustery day and a little cold. Holy this beach was still jam packed so I can't imagine how busy it would be on a warm sunny day. The sand was really soft and there is a place where littler kids could play in the ocean without risk and some people with snorkel gear lolling about. Past that little inlet, looked quite choppy on the day we were there but there was a crazy weather storm just ending so I'm not sure if it's always like that. I'm glad we saw Poipu beach but I probably wouldn't go back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Never Miss this Spot in Kauai Island, definitely a must-see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When we were at Kauai Island, we stayed at Lihue near Kalapki beach. Poipu Beach, being close to where we were at was a destination people were telling us we must see, but I was quite hesitant at first since they say this place wasn't for beginner snorkelers. Being an cautious intermediate snorkeler, we checked the place out. Man, I am so glad we did!Laying around the beach were five Hawaiian Green Sea turtles laying on the beach, basking under the sun. They were definitely a sight to behold. It is illegal to touch them and they are protected by federal laws. These majestic creatures in the wild were a definite reason to check this place out. There was also a Hawaiian Monk seal just relaxing there on the sand, with stakes poled on the sand with rope to keep people away. The park wasn't very crowded being a popular tourist destination. And they had good amenities like a shower outside and a bathroom. The snorkeling bay was pretty decent, though I personally think there are more underwater life at Hanauma Bay. But the water was really clear, and much marine life to be seen. Just be careful with some sharp rocks that could injure your toes if you don't have water shoes. The variety of fish and other creatures are really plenty. I almost had the chance to swim alongside a turtle, if I was just fast enough to put on my snorkel gear and cross the rocky terrain to the water. Overall, I recommend this place to any Kauai visitor.And IT IS ALL FREE!! YOU READ IT RIGHT, NO CHARGE!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to the Poipu Beach for sunset a couple of times during sunset and sunrise during December. There was a good number of people on the beach each time, but you could find a good angle or two to get good photos.  The beach is clean. People come here for swimming, snorkeling, surfing, and body boarding. The sand is a little rough, but nice otherwise. There is a good-sized parking lot, some picnic tables, and a water shower for cleaning off sand. We were there 4 times during the same week and saw turtles AND monk seals on the beach each time. Most times, there was someone on the beach that defined a "do not cross" line to keep people from getting too close. There was also a lifeguard on duty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ordinary beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An ordinary beach with strong currents and dangerous shorebreaks(dec) there was also some jellyfish there when we visited. There is a lifeguard on duty, toilets, Picnic tables, playground for children. The snorkeling area is very small but ok.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Small and crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is very small, a bit dirty and overcrowded.  The only real highlight was the sleeping endangered monk seal who was resting on the beach and being watched by a volunteer.  The bathroom was filthy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It was like swimming in a fish tank - amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved Poipu and I picked our accommodation due to its closeness to this beach.  You only had to get in knee deep and pop your head under and you saw the colourful fish.  It truly was like swimming in a fish tank.  Really safe for the inexperienced snorkeller as you can touch the bottom for quite a way out and not miss a thing with life guards over head.  Water shoes or flippers are a must as its rocky, but hey thats why the fish are there.  Take fish food too, its awesome watching them come charging at you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Another great little beach in Kauai
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We hit many beaches during this trip to Hawaii - Poipu may have been up there among our favorites with Hamauna Bay in Oahu and Hanalei beach in Hanalei.  Poipu has plenty of parking in the 2 lots across the street.  It's relatively protected from the surf which makes swimming and snorkeling safe.  There are also 2 lifeguard stations so you can have a good time safely.  The sand is not the best we've ever seen but it was nice nonetheless.  The park has a couple bathrooms (the one by the front pathway was dirtier, the one closer to the Brenecke Beach Boiler was cleaner and had soap).  There's an outdoor shower to help rinse the sand off of you.  As you walk along the beach heading west, you'll see some of the resorts that are right on the beach.  We also saw turtles and sea lions on the beach.  Turtles tend to come out en masse at night but we were lucky enough to see one during the day and 2 during the twilight hours.  The sea lion also came on shore during the day.  Be mindful of them and give them their space - don't be one of those stupid tourists who walk right up to the turtles to take selfies.  Some of them are tired or even injured and are looking to recover or to get rest.  We also were lucky enough to see a glorious sunset the second night we were in Poipu (pic of that attached).  Additional but not personally verified tip - I overheard one couple say snorkeling was clear and they saw a lot of fish.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, safe, family-friendly beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach Park is a beautiful beach. The grassy park has play equipment, tables, restrooms and outdoor showers for removing salt and sand.  The bay itself is protected, so calm and safe for swimming, especially with life guards present, and great for snorkling; I saw a variety of colorful fish and an eel.  We also saw sea turtles sunning themselves on the beach. Overall, a great experience!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for family and snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Found this on our last day. While all beaches on the island are great, this was a great find. Cool park with picnic tables, food across street.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular beach—Poipu
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach is the most amazing g beach with its spectacular views!! Poipu is a family friendly beach for all to enjoy the water.  I have a 11 and 9 year old boys. They enjoy boogie boarding and jumping the waves!!Take timeout of you trip to visit Poipu Beach!! It is a must!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I COULDN'T BELIEVE IT
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Going just to see what the beach was,as we were anticipating to go for snorkeling there a few days later.What we saw was unbelievable,Green Sea Turtles,and Monk Seals between the people.The animals just seem to go through their daily lives amongst the swimmers without any stress.The beach itself has various pools there to snorkel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A good overall beach area but typically crowded.  I suggest trying a few of the other smaller beaches up and down the coast.  Plenty of parking available here as well as chair/umbrella rentals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: People beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's crowded by Kauai standards.  I like Kauai's beaches because there are not a lot of people, so this is not one of my favorites.  That said, it's a nice beach that's great for families and close to restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good beach it is crowded and too sunny,  need to go in the evenings when its pass 4.30, washrooms is available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: MUST GO TO POIPU BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a must go to beach. Amazing clear, warm,  beautiful water. I typically don’t swim in the ocean but this beach is way to inviting. Perfect for snorkeling and kids. We had a blast with our granddaughters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place to enjoy the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really a beautiful beach. The only issue is everyone else knows it's beautiful. We've been there twice and both times it was really crowded. It is a protected water playground, but waves are still about 1 - 2 feet high. It's worth the time and drive, but don't expect a quiet, lone, romantic time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family Favorite
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach experience for us. The calm waves were so nice for my 2 year old granddaughter to play and have fun. The adults enjoyed the beautiful fish swimming around us. The water is so clear and calm that you could just stand in the water and see all the beautiful brightly colored fish swimming around you! We used our snorkel gear and it just took our breath away. We seen the sea turtles up close because they came up on the beach. Also, we seen the seals everyday as they lay on the beach soaking up the sun. One evening on the beach there were 8 or 10 sea turtles laying on the beach for our enjoyment. We had so much fun just watching the seals, turtles, and dolphins. Amazing to be that close to them in their natural environment. Great beach for the entire family guaranteed! Don’t forget to bring your Go Pro because the snorkeling videos are amazing in this clear water. A+ adventure

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Family Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sandy, easy for kids, lots of seals and turtles to watch also.  Tuesday, Thursdays and Saturdays they also have Water Aerobics in the ocean to the north, it is free and taught by a nice lady called Charlotte.  Lifeguard is a nice bonus here also.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great swimming and snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is an amazing beach!  Worth the walk, drive or however you get there! Lots of fish to look at! Don't forget about to ask about the turtles!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Morning Swim
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Due to our packed travel schedule, we only have the chance to swim here in the morning. We were glad we did it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poipu
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous but small beach...Sheraton hotel is right here but skip it..horrible service all around except the valet folks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach never disappoints
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went on our second day in Kauai as the north was overcast. Spent the day listening to the beautiful waves. Today a Male monk seal was sunning on the beach a sight to see and later a female also showed up. Also a huge turtle was in the area to see. Would never miss this beach if visiting the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful and really clear.  Having been around the island, I think this is definitely the best beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Favorite Beach In Hawaii - Great Location - Sea Turtles - Beautiful Sunset - FUN
