reviewsWithKeywords.title: A nice family beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a rock protected beach with decent snorkeling and a space between breaks for some beginning to intermediate surfing.  The shallow beach is great for small kids.   We saw both turtles and monk seals up on the beach as a bonus.  There are picnic areas with grass that were nice to get back up away from the sand and sun under a palm. Overall, a very nice beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poipu Beach Park
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach to go to.For sunbathing or if you like to snorkel.We went on a snorkeling boat cruise but saw more beautiful fish here.So just bring your own gear or rent it.You can find places to rent all around and it’s pretty cheep.You have to be cautious of the current however and the reefs are a bit rocky.We even saw a sea turtle resting on a reef that you can swim to.But please look from a distance.Some guy was trying to sit on one for a picture...stupid.There are life guards on this beach.I would highly recommend this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Safe for swimming, not the prettiest
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pros: Good parking, public bathrooms and safe swimming-life guards and few waves. Cons: It’s crowded and not that pretty. If you are looking for a quieter mire idyllic beach (but no life guards) you can head down the road to Shipwreck beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to swim and turtle watching
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We parked over by the Kaneiolouma heiau (nice restoration work in process, so some signage) public park - they had some sea turtles parked on the beach to get some sun in (stay 10 feet away from them for their safety).  We walked around the beach to the next cove over on the right, and that had perfect swimming water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Day and Night
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was our favorite place to snorkel. Saw a turtle and a seal and tons of tropical fish. At night, the turtles come up on shore to catch some Z’s.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Must-See beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Living in the Lihue area, this beach is very accessible.  Great area on the left for small children.  Snorkeling in Poipu is really great on the right side.  You can just stand in the water and look down to see fish all around your legs.  If you're not comfortable snorkeling, you can still see the fish through the very clear water!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Next Door to hotel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great public beach with a lifeguard during the day.  Public restrooms, sheltered picnic areas, grills available.  Small Deli/Store/Restaurant across the road from park.  Had the pleasure of seeing visiting Monk Seals sunbathing for HOURS on the beach! 😍

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkelling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was a go to safe snorkelling spot, (but I liked Koloa Landing more).  Usually calm and shallow on the east  side.  More rugged on the west side, but more fish.  Seemed to be a cross current on the west side that could be problematic for some coming back to beach.  Nice sunsets and nice facilities to grab some water time during your travels back and forth on the island:

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This was a perfect intimate beach to visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved the Poipu beach and spent several hours playing in the water and sand. The two huge Hawaii seals that call this beach home were amazing to watch as they laid on the beach. Signs say they are regular tenants!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I along with another couple recently went on a cruise vacation to numerous exotic islands in the Pacific. While on this cruise, we visited Poipu Beach on Kauai. The beach was very nice and there were great views of the ocean and surrounding area. We had a great time on this beautiful beach and got a special surprise when a sea turtle came onto the beach to sun. we would recommend this beach highly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best snorkeling for children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This has got to be one of the best beaches for snorkeling for beginners and children.  Many shallow areas that you can see a variety of colored fish easily.  Sea turtles laying out on the beach, just keep your distance as required by law.  Low tide in the morning leaves you with an even more shallow beach yet many fish still visible.  There is a breaker so waves are not as rough as other open beaches, but still tides and currents can be unpredictable so always be cautious in the ocean with children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kid friendly beach, fish in 5 feet of water, lifeguards and bathrooms
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a perfect swimming spot for young families. There are a couple of protected coves with one sandy spot having no more than a foot of water for the youngest toddler to safely enjoy the ocean.  However, it’s not all about babies here. There is a rocky cove that invites snorkelers to enjoy our fishy friends in a lifeguard protected area. If you are a gung-ho snorkeler, this is not the beach for you, but if you want a leisurely look-see, this is your place. A huge benefit of this area is that sea life love it. A seal came close into shore and was checking out the crowd. A sea snake was captured. ( The lifeguards are on game here, as well as being friendly and knowledgeable. ) And finally a sea turtle came to visit. All this on a sleepy Tuesday when we visited the beach for 4 hours. There is a shower to wash off and clean bathrooms. There is a kids play structure and grassy areas with picnic tables. What more could a young family want?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Make sure you wear water shoes, but this was a great spot for snorkeling! There was even a giant turtle chilling on the beach. Wish I had more time to explore the island you can swim out to, but we only had a couple of hours to stop. Showers to rinse off, and seemed to be plenty of parking. (we didn't arrive until 10ish) Will be sure to come back when we visit again!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: limited parking, not really a swimming beach, two monk seals joined the sunbathers on the sand, has amenities

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Moderate surf and right left ultra shallow made it hard to keep clear of coral....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Right has shallow coral too but a nice pathway beginning near the center.  Lots of fish, and saw a beached turtle on both of our visits!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful at Sunset!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Make sure you are outside to watch this beautiful beach settle in for the evening and if you have a Special Someone with you take a stroll along the path or sit by a fiirepit to gaze at the sun setting. Just gorgeous!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poipu Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best spot for snorkeling by far. Filmed a turtle swimming right next to me. Best snorkeling in Kauai

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Family Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach to bring your family to. There's a large in-let for the kids to swim and on the other side there are big enough waves to boogey board as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for everyone - beautiful, calm water, snorkeling, swimming
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our accommodations were very close to this beach so we walked down multiple times during our week-long stay in Poipu. One of our favourite things about the beach were the number of sea turtles that come up for a rest on the beach. It is equally infuriating to see the number of beach-goers who crowd the sea turtles. GIVE THE SEA TURTLES LOTS OF SPACE. On plenty of occasions we saw a poor sea turtle turn around and leave the beach area when faced with aggressive tourists. The beach itself is guarded by lifeguards and the waters are calm, which made it very safe for snorkeling and swimming. The waters are full of colourful fish and the beach itself is a beautiful one, although it was not the loveliest one we saw on the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It’s a nice park
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Public park with parking. Pretty clean. Dogs not allowed—lots of dogs. Several pavilions. Many roosters and chickens. Sit and watch the waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling, swimming and turtles too
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a wonderful beach if you are not a strong swimmer but you want to snorkel. In just a few feet of water you can float above the surface and see  such wonderful sea life.   This is also a great place to swim or hang out in the ocean and I feel safe.  They also have lifeguards nearby.  When we were there a turtle was on the beach.   The beach can get overcrowded as the day goes on so it's better to come early rather than later.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place for families
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice shallow protected cove with restrooms, playground, lifeguard, gazebos and some shade.  Lots of little children at this beach. Nice snorkeling.  Chair and snorkeling rentals nearby. We bought our chairs, snorkeling gear and umbrella at Costco, then donated them to the local church when we left. A little way to give back to the community.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Definite top beach choice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Public beach ideal to keep lots of different people happy with lifeguard station, bathrooms, grass area with shade, close by deli mart for snacks or beverages, etc. There are two beaches side by side. One is. Rey small cove with no lifeguard and great snorkeling. Another has the lifeguard station and huge area for snorkeling. The big perk for those with little children is the cove that’s one big kid “pool” built into shoreline. Sandy areas are in sunshine & clean. One down side is limited parking. And certain sections of where you walk in have rocks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkel day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great area to snorkel, lots of people and a bit crowded. If you head over closer to the Sheraton hotel side the soft rolling waves will remind you of the waves in a wave pool.Highlight was the monk seal swimming around in between swimmers!!!@

reviewsWithKeywords.title: VERY crowded...be prepared
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is a fun place for kids to play but man ALL the people!!  SOOOOO crowded.  Lifeguards are in place and we saw seals on the beach.  Be prepared for walking to your car and hauling all of your stuff.  I much prefer a beach with less people.  I'm talking almost shoulder to shoulder.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: "Our" beach in Poipu
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just few minutes from our Air B&B apartment... White sand, quite big waves but there was a shallow area good for snorkelling. And our neighbour on the beach was a big seal, just resting during the day. Very clear water, close to main accommodations and Brennecke's Restaurant ;-).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for beginner surfers
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach that has relatively shallow waters quite far out with smaller waves so it is great for beginner surfers.  Enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and area.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Located on one of many south shores, a must see if you like swimming, snorkeling, relaxing on the sand, watching the surfers try to stay on their boards or a little something different. Giant sea turtles sunning themselves in the sand, especially on the little island you can walk to. Just make sure you wear water socks or wet shoes, the rocks are very jagged to walk on barefoot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sheltered cove with huge amounts of tropical fish, turtles, and sea lions. Snorkeling was great. Good beach for families.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of our favorite beaches in Kauai. A little kid side and a more mature side for swimming. Normally it has a cool land bridge that you have to see to appreciate. A lot of sea turtles on the area. And an occasional sea monk. Showers, restaurants and shopping nearby. And roosters in trees. Just go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous experience.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu beach  was probably the best beach we had been to in Kauai especially if you want to snorkel. Though it gets a little crowded.  But We got to see some beautiful marine life and lots of fishes.  You won’t be disappointed if you want to snorkel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great wading area for kids
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice busy beach with great wading area for little kids, good snorkelling in shallow water. Food, shaved ice and rentals across the road.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best snorkeling we had on the island.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This wonderful beach had great snorkeling. The current was relatively calm and I felt better knowing there was a lifeguard on duty because some beaches on Kauai can be dangerous.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtle
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful seeing the turtles come up on shore to rest in the evening and watch the sunset. Very family friendly shore

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtles and seals
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu is a beautiful beach where you can usually see turtles or Hawaiian monk seals. There does tend to be a lot of families with kids so if you’re looking for a quiet beach this probably isn’t your place. But if you’re interested in seeing some sea life it’s a good place to stop by.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top Sunny Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you have clouds or rain, go to Poipu. Most likely sunny. Good place to snorkel, see seals and large turtles. Another Kauai treasure. If you go to Kauai, don't bother staying at the resort, get out and see all the beaches and Poipu is a not miss.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great public beach park
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Truthfully the beach here is better than at many of the nearby resorts.  Parking is plentiful though if you come later in the day you will have to walk a ways.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect day at this extraordinary beach. Awesome waves to practice surf and paddle surf. Best for snorkel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top Choice!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were on Kauai for 8 days and stopped at Poipu Beach Park on the last day.  It's a good thing we didn't stop here on day 1, because we may not have gone to any other beach!  This beach is big.  It has restrooms.  It has picnic pavilions.  It has surfers.  It has seals.  It has turtles.  It has lots of free parking, palm trees, and rainbows, and lifeguards, and restaurants across the street.  It has it all!  By all means, visit every other beach you can while on Kauai, but don't miss this one!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Had the best time playing in the surf. The sunsets were a thing of beauty. If you are in Kauai you got to make it to Poipu beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to see turtles and seals
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The area has much to offer.  There was surfing and boogie boarding on the beach.  We sat on volcano rocks by the shore and were treated to views of sea turtles and seals.  There are play sets for the kids, shelters, and picnic areas.  It rained briefly, so we saw a rainbow too.   Definitely a nice park/beach.  Go to eat at Bubba Burgers a few blocks away if you aren't picnicking on site.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spotted two sea turtles and a seal. Nice beach if you have toddlers
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Someone told me that seeing a sea turtle completes a trip to Hawaii. If you share the same sentiments, Poipu Beach is the place to be. We saw not one but two of these beautiful creatures hanging out on the sand getting some sun. Folks would stop by and take photos while keeping a good distance respecting the turtles' personal space. We even watched one of them crawl back and swim in the water. Such a fascinating thing to witness!Have small kids? The west side of the beach is perfect for your little ones as there are huge rocks blocking the waves forming almost a kiddie pool. Lifeguards were also on duty and you know they are doing their job as you hear them on megaphones warning swimmers or stubborn people trying to approach a seal on a little island several meters from the shore.The beach can be crowded for good reason but if you like swimming and being able to touch your feet on smooth sandy floor, you're not going to like it here. I would swim in the deeper end to avoid that, however, the waves can also be a challenge - just be careful. We got to see lots of fish here so bring your snorkeling gear or goggles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of my favorite beaches in Hawaii
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A long beach with enough depth to accommodate the many users that appreciate it. Lots of parking (although I have seen the lot entirely flooded after heavy rains), plenty of hens with chicks for entertainment and often a resting spot for turtles and monk seals. Snorkeling is decent in spite of the number of swimmers. Obviously the better the beach the more the people. Take your pick.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: best place we snorkeled
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A bit crowded in the snorkeling area, but saw more fish there than any of the other places we snorkeled.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too crowded!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach but way too crowded for me. I did some snorkeling there and it was ok, but not great.  When I got out I left rather than sit around with the crowd of people on the shore.  Way too many people for such a small area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Me the turtle and the fish on spring break + chickens
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great little beach with a touch of everything. Easy snorkeling close to the beach edge for beginners and families. It changes all day. Early morning you may catch a turtle or two. Late afternoon a whale in the horizon. But all day gosh to view. Nice vistas. It can get a little crowded but well worth the effort.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rainbow blessing 2 days before wedding in Poipu
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You tell us if we loved this beach!! Kid friendly. No coral for them.     Adults? Snorkeling great but you need shoes to go into water because it is over dead coral and slippery and sharp.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy, but nice sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to Poipu Beach a couple of times during our stay on Kauai and enjoyed snorkeling and checking out the monk seals. The parking lot was pretty much full by 10 am. This was a good place to go to escape the rain from the north and east side of the island (they say it's usually sunny on the south side!).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Small beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Using San Diego standard this is a small but nice beach. It can get very crowded. Parking can also get tough so it really depends when you are visiting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sweet snorkeling spot!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We snorkeled here for hours on end, took naps on the beach and saw so many animals from sea turtles to monk seals and so much more!! The fish are beautiful and exotic...so much fun to swim with!! Found ourselves here multiple mornings to catch the sunrise which is when the turtles are just hanging out on the beach. Can get a little crowded here but all and all a great place to hang!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, great snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for snorkeling and monk seal sightings! Wear your water shoes as it is pretty rocky in areas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very family friendly beach - water is calmer compared to other beaches.  Most resorts are off this beach however so can get a bit packed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A great place to relax with picnic tables and restrooms
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are in the Poi Pu area and don't want to travel too far to find a beach, go here.  There are restrooms, Clean by Kauai standards!  Picnic tables and Brennecke's bar and grill for some drinks and food.  Beautiful palm trees to lay out a blanket and enjoy the Hawaii sun and surf.  There is also a large area with shallow water and a lifeguard for the children to safely play in the ocean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful parm
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach that has a calm area for snorkeling. It also has a large grassy area that is nice. The snorkeling is good and you will see a variety of fish. You may also see sea turtles or monk seals. Only downside is on weekends you may not find parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: GREAT SUN AND SNORKLE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Found a corner of the beach with minimal traffic (human) and a few curious chickens.  Snorkeling was better than most of the beaches we’ve frequented over our 10-day stay.  Would recommend to anyone looking for a good beach with easy access and snorkeling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, ok for swimming, great for snorkeling with fish
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There were a lot of big rocks preventing full swim use of the beach.  There was a portion with no rocks that had lots of snorkelers in the nearby rocks due to tons of fish.  It’s great for snorkelling

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An amazing beach but way too many people!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach and park.  We saw turtles and a seal up close on the beach. Very touristy and hard to find parking. Fairly clean, nicely landscaped grounds.  Roosters are abundant here and are jumping on the picnic tables while you consume food but are easily shooed away and are not aggressive.  We spent a lovely afternoon here and would go back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded, but beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a beautiful, soft sand beach with very calm waters and an awesome sand bar you can get to by a short, but rocky wade across the water.  Snorkeling here was ideal with lots of fish to see. On our visit there was even a sea turtle hanging out on the beach.  There are showers and bathrooms on site, as well as a lifeguard, which makes it a great place to go for families.  Located just across the street was a restaurant, coffee house and shave ice shop.  Plenty of parking.  The only negative thing about this beach is it is very crowded.  We visited twice, at two different times and both times it was hard to find a place in the sand to call our own.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Watch out for the rocks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I like Poipu Beach. It has something for everyone--a wading area for kids, covered picnic tables, grass, restrooms, snorkel area, etc. However, if you enter the water near the wading area, there are quite a few slippery rocks and it is hard to get into the water, even with water socks on. I slipped getting out and gashed my knee. Move to the farther edge of the beach where there are less rocks and more fish. If you're lucky, you'll also see large turtles and monk seals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Family Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a must if you are vacationing with kids.  Shallow salt pool (aka "baby beach") was perfect for our 4-year old granddaughter.  She could have a beach experience without worrying about waves knocking her down.  One day we saw 3 sea turtles sunning right on baby beach and had to make a short walk to the other side to see a monk seal!  Easy place for young ones to snorkel, use their boogie boards or just play in the water and sand. Lots of shade, covered tables, and lifeguards on duty so pack a lunch and enjoy a great day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach with paddle boarding & snorkeling, the Mariot Resort is right there so food & drink nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quite crowded, could be cleaner.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is heavily used by locals, which is fine, especially on holidays and weekends. The whole area could be kept cleaner. There are two lifeguard towers now and that's a huge plus.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful! Amazing snorkling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My favorite place to visit in Kauai! I could snorkle here for hours! beaches were kept up- has rinse off area and close parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family friendly beach experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach park is well maintained and has some nice amenities, including good restrooms and covered picnic facilities. The bay is terrific for snorkeling because it is somewhat protected. We were able to see large turtles come ashore nightly to sleep on the sand, a wonderful phenomenon of nature to be able to observe. There is a great rental shop directly across the street and Brennecke's restaurant, a local spot with great food & drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great family beach spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Check the prevailing winds when you stay on the island.  It was quite breezy and drizzly on the east side at Kapaa where were staying so we loaded up the snorkel gear and headed to the south side at Poipu.  It was protected somewhat from the wind with plenty of sunshine.  Enjoyed the beach with 500+ other people and lots of chickens aka Red Jungle Fowl and a couple of sea turtles who ambled up onto the beach right among the beach towels and made their spot!  Snorkeling was great with fish almost to the shoreline.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy popular beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very pretty but crowded beach.  There was a monk seal resting on the beach and also several turtles. This is a common occurrence and neat to see. Some snorkeling and you can swim but there isn’t a large sandy entry to the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach area in Poipu is very pretty sandy beaches, surrounded by condo's. The beaches are all public, but sometimes parking is difficult. We saw a monk seal on the beach, which was really fun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy Beach with Amazing Sunsets
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed within walking distance of Poipu Beach nd would walk down to the beach every morning to check for Monk Seals and Turtles and to whale watch. Still whale season in March.A few mornings there were 2-3 monk seals bathing/sleeping on the beach. They actually rope them off when they come to shore so people cant get too close. Done by volunteers and they will answer any questions you have about the seals. We also saw sea turtles on the beach a few mornings as wellIf you drive, there is lots of free parking as well. Restrooms, picnic tables, all available. The beach does get extremely busy during peak hours 11-4. Lots of snorkelling in the bay as well...This is a great spot to come to watch the sunsets around 6:30pm. Spectacular ! Lots of people down here at the beach at this time of night. There is a great restaurant across the street called Brennekes and almost right it is Nukumoi surf shop. You can rent snorkeliing gear, surf boards, boogie boards, SUP boards and they have a nice gift shop as well.If you are staying on the island in a different area, you must come check it out for a day or half day

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkel heaven!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We rented snorkel gear and headed to Poipu Beach...it was great! Beautiful clear water and lots of fish. Somone told us we missed dolphins ... that would have been nice. There was also a monk seal on the beach...highly protected by a ranger and cool to see up cloae.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful fish, and even a few monk seals lounging
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very much enjoyed Poipu Beach. It is a lifeguarded beach that boasts occasional monk seals and the variety of fish was really colorful. Unfortunately, people have destroyed the coral so there was not much living coral to see. I would go there again!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most Fish Seen Snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is CROWDED for a reason. Lots of fish close to shore, lifeguard, protected cove (wear water shoes!), free parking, bathrooms, easy access. The crowds are the only negative on this beach but I can’t blame everyone. We even saw a seal sunning amidst the crowds (everyone knows about this beach).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice place to snorkel and see turtles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you don't want to drive to far and have a relatively safe place to snorkel then you have come to the right spot.  There are several parking lots near by.  The restrooms have a changing area and showers outside of them to wash off the salt after swimming or snorkeling.  We have seem plenty of fish on our trips and turtles on most trips to this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkeling gem
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Of all the beaches advertising good snorkeling, this is the better one.  Anini, Lydgate,etc are not worth the trip.  Poipu has a nice protective cove, plenty of fish, sea anemones to make the day a nice experience....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Surf and Turtles and Seals, oh My!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: From the coarse black and tan sand to the presence of Monk Seals and Sea Turtles every day that we visited, this beach held our interest for more than just sunning and swimming.  The wildlife is closely protected by a posse of volunteers who are very knowledgeable about the creatures who choose this beach as a place to sleep in the day. There are lifeguards, bathrooms and chair rental place nearby as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: perfect beach for all
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Play equipment and protected children area with  life guards, excellent snorkeling, swimming and whale watching.  Monk seals and turtles frequesnt beach area.  Brenecke Beach 100 yards away is trated best boogei board beach in Kauai. Deli and Restaurant and bar.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited the beach to do some swimming and snorkeling. It is a sandy beach along a cove with life guard. Saw lots of different fish while snorkeling. The bottom is mostly rock with a little bit of coral. It is one of the safer beaches in  Poipu.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Everything You Want a Beach to Have
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is our go-to beach since it is close to our hotel. This beach has all the amenities you need:1. Ample parking2. Picnic benches3. Bathrooms4. Life guard5. Great for snorkeling6. A side beach suitable for young children7. A coffee shop and a restaurant nearby to rest, get refreshed and relax with a meal or a drink8. Nice soft sand so you can lie down with simply a beach towel; or you can bring a lounge chair if you want9. Low waves so very safe

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to see turtles and whales!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked to the beach from our resort and it was a great place to see turtles playing and whales breeching!  It was best early in the day and not crowded at all

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice,Quiet Place to Have Coffee and Read
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Its nice but the beach is little rocky. Its far away from traffic and other noise if you want to sit and read. Lots of wildlife  (fowl) walking around. There are facilities open to the public including parking and bathrooms.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach and good snorkeling - parking was quite easy and really well.worth spending a few hours here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Monk Seals on the Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to Poipu Beach for the Snorkeling( it did NOT disappoint) I saw almost every Fish that was on the Flyer given out at the Snorkel shop~   But the Monk Seals were a fun Bonus....Beautiful Beach and not horrible crowded .....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great easy snorkeling breach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Tons of fish. There is a break water so lots of area with no waves that makes it easy get in and out of the water and snorkel without worrying about the surf. There are rocks, but you need that to have lots of fish. Just bring water shoes or wear trekking sandals. Highly recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too rocky
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is beautiful and full of fish and even sea lions but don’t forget water shoes.  Cannot enjoy water at all without them. This beach also has a ton families... so make sure to bring ear phones...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very for good for beginner snorkeling ! the fish we abundant to say the least. beach was quite crowed and due to Monk seals part of the beach was closed. there is of course plenty of grassy areas to sit as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not a huge amount of sand, but enough for walking, watch out for volcanic rock. Best to sit and enjoy the view!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sweet Little Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Located on the generally sunny south side of Kauai. Nice beach with great zero depth protected area for little kids and babies. Restrooms, showers, picnic tables, pavilions. Adequate parking. Restaurant (Bennecke’s, a local favorite), coffee shop/deli, and beach store across the street. Super family friendly, but fine for couples, too.  Come early to get a picnic table or prime spot on the beach. Good snorkeling around the small island connected (at times) to the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family Friendly Beach - Great Snorkelling!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This became a daily trip for our family as we were staying within walking distance! The water was perfect and I couldn’t believe how amazing the snorkelling is!You must bring a mask if you’re going to come and spend some time on this beach; so many beautiful fish to swim with!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Next to Waiohai
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great beach for sun or swimming.  Lots of people, but always room for one or two more.  Picnic tables near by.  Maybe a monk seal on the beach.  Water is calm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Surprisingly, there is great snorkeling here, even though the coral is all walked upon and dead. It looks like you are swimming in an aquarium with all the different fish. I liked the snorkeling right next to the little kids' swimming area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sunny Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love how sunny this beach is!  Great place to snorkel and lay on the beach.  Monk seals and turtles come ashore and rest.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were staying at a rental apartment in Poipu and could walk to this beach which is good since it's hard to park near the beach on a busy day. The beach is nice sand and the sand extends well out into the water with some exceptions. There's a protected area for children and during the winter the swells that come in are supposed to usually be pretty small. There's refreshments across the road.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Some pretty good snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, a bit rocky but par for the course for many Hawaii beaches. Always a treat to be able to snorkel a few feet from your beach chair so this is a place worth visiting!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A favorite place on Kauai
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large beach with plenty of sand, plenty of grassy area adjacent and close to public parking. Lifeguards on duty, and plenty of Kauai chickens. Swim, roast in the sun, paddle board or surf, even snorkel if you are ok with the water not being clear all the time. Every time we've been there we've seen seals or turtles. Plenty of room for fun, and nice views at sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best place to watch the sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach for snorkeling in the winter.  Lots of fish and usually a turtle or two!  Breathtaking sunset view as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkling beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for families. We enjoyed snorkling here. Terrific location to watch the sunset. Good parking too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plenty of action-lifegaurd also
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large beach, sand, and swimming.  With the public beach comes many people, lifegaurds on duty and limited space.    Plenty of fish to see and calm water to let the little ones play.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to this beach because the waves on the east side of the island were too big for swimming.  While the beach is small, there is a very large grassy area for sunning and picnicking and some shady areas if you need to get out of the sun.  The waves were a good size, but great for body surfing or using a boogie board. At times there were so many boogie boarders that one had to be careful where you were if you body surfing or just wave jumping.  Many people were snorkeling.  I jumped the waves with three sea turtles.  They seemed to enjoy being around people and would bump into me periodically!  It was so awesome. Parking is limited, so get there early.  It also limits the crowds of people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, great sealife!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great sandy beach, nice views but the best part is the wildlife: snorkeling in 10' of water just 40' from the beach had dozens of fish of at least fifteen species. We even ran into a 3' female sea turtle browsing on the bottom!Just across the street is a great snorkel equipment rental place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poipu Beach is busy but worth it!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to Poipu Beach two times over a week span as it was raining on the east side of the island and we wanted some beach time, so the south side of the island is the place to go during the winter months (or according to the islanders the "weeks" of their winter - which is January and February). It was very busy both times and hard to find parking, but we finally did and enjoyed watching the surfers and playing in the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice Beach! Great little spot for swimming, without the giant waves. The Monk Seals like to sun on this beach. We got to see them. The wife saw lots of fish and some Turtles. Great visit!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Huge Turtles!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We saw a turtle every time we stopped by. Total highlight for our kids! They're very careful about drawing boundaries around the turtles so you don't get too close and keep the turtles safe!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place to go with kids!I’m told monk seals hang out there but we did not see them.Sheltered area for kids but fight off a road so watch for runners.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overcrowded beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach that’s overrun with people. Inadequate parking from quite a distance away. Walking down the beach further doesn’t get ant less crowded because of all the resorts.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling spot!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you're looking for a good snorkeling spot on Kauai this is it! It can get a little crowded in the shallow areas with little kids but swim further out and it's perfect! We saw several turtles swimming around out there! Plenty of fish too. The park is nice, lots of bathrooms and showers. Very family friendly! Lot's of kids bday parties and family get togethers when we went. There is a snorkel and surf shop across the street where we rented our snorkel gear. Lots of options you won't be bored!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach with soft sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach has awesome sand compared to other places on Kauai. We ran into some rocks and coral but a little further out.Poipu sees more sun than other parts of the island so I’d recommend staying in the area or at least hitting the beach when you’re on Kauai. We saw Hawaiian monk seals resting on the beach multiple nights. This beach also makes for great sunrises.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good for family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Safe beach for kids and a nice new playground. Teens and adults can easily snorkel outside the kids area, too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poipu Beach Park
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Park is beautiful with great beach.  Water was clear enough to see fish swimming around.  Nestled on beach were 2 monk seals and turle.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very good beach for watching wildlife of allSorts both above the ocean and underwater .the snorkeling is great and you can see a wide variety of tropical sea creatures including eels,parrot fish ,clown fish ,kite fish ,butterfly fish,snappers,yellow tang,moorish idol,goat fish ,black trigger fish,trumpet fish etc.in addition to that we saw a pair of male Hawaiian monk seals beached on the sands and a huge green sea turtle was lazing around on the beach as well.there is also a small protected area for kids to play around in the water as well which is well protected by the ferocious waves.excellent place to chill out and enjoy time with your family of all ages.life guards are also present from 9 am-5 pm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, but ocean floor is very rocky. Sand rather course. Further down near the Sheraton the beach was a bit nicer. A little tough to believe this beach is touted as one of the top beaches in America. Maui beaches much nicer if comparing or making a decision between both islands.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Truly recommend this beach that has a lovely clean lagoon, showers and public restrooms, as well as life guards that makes it super safe , close by you can what hard surfers while enjoying beach of very soft and clean sand. Some people live it for snorkelling and spotted there turtles and loads of fish. Perfect for families with kids , alder people and less able as there is access point , in the grass part you can find public bbq’s and shelters with tables and benches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best variety of fish,  made me nervous though!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Plenty of signs about rip currents made me too nervous to just let me kids go wherever they wanted, only a couple spots that seemed really protected.   However,  I couldn't believe how many different kinds of fish we saw.  I also hadn't yet seen a seal or a turtle and I saw both here!!  I was swimming close to shore and looked up to see a big brown figure right in front of me- it was a gorgeous turtle!  May have been the same one we saw sunning earlier.   Give them some space, if you see a seal, you must give them a good 20 feet or you could be fined!!    Also saw a needle fish!  Worth checking out Poipu!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Trips to PoiPu State Park
reviewsWithKeywords.text: During our visit, we were able to make a short walk to this fantastic beach!  On the way, we could spot sea turtles playing in the surf and monk seals lying in the sun on the rocks!  The beach is perfect for young and old with an area protected from the surf and a beautiful sand bottom that the little ones could enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Local Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great location been here with the family and just my wife and I, great serene views, clear water and great for snorkeling, lots of fish to see, Locals teach their kids to surf here! Bring a picnic and enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent 2 days walking around and sitting on the beach. Fantastic. Both days a huge sea turtle showed up and came onto the beach to sleep. Also two Monk seals beached themselves to sleep as well. Very clean. Had a blast. Highly recommend.Jim from Chicago

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a gorgeous beach.  There are lifeguards.  I did not go in the water, so I don't know if currents are strong here.  There is an area that is rocky, which might make for interesting snorkeling and walking in amongst the rocks looking for fun artifacts.  I don't know if this happens year-around, but certainly in Feb, it is a common occurrence for an endangered monk seal to swim up on to the sand in the morning and spend the day resting and sunning.  that was, most certainly, a wonderful treat for us to see!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: TURTLES GALORE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The turtles come up on the beach at night here and as you walk the beach you can see them all piled together. This beach is also a great place during the day for families. Great sand. Great snorkling close to shore. We saw some people trying to surf out a ways but noticed there's not a lot of room where the surf is. Lots of hotels along this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Seals, Snorkelling and Surfing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu is a lovely, compact beach with a classic palm tree backdrop, and in late January was a lovely spot to swim in the surf on one side of the island divide and snorkel with the tropical fish in a child safe lagoon on the other.Given how thin the strip of sand is, and the resorts which back it, it easily fills up, though out of season there was plenty of free space on the sand.There were seals snoozing on the island and beach the days we were there, and the snorkelling is wonderful - step straight off the beach in to a fantastic array of tropical fish.But make sure you have reef shoes, even on the surf side, as there are rocks everywhere ready to cut open your hands and feet. The park behind has plenty of grass and covered picnic tables. Toilets and change rooms are dated but functional and there are showers on the beach to wash off after the surf and a cafe and takeaway store a short walk away.parking is plentiful and free right behind the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best place to see turtles and the Hawaiian Monk Seal
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing spot to see the Monk Seal and variety of turtles in the beach. Beach really rocky but worth the show for the seal and turtles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too much park, not enough beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not what we were expecting or looking for. Way too many people, lots of kids, and so many picnics. Not a relaxing beach atmosphere at all but more like a grassy park. Probably great if you have little ones and are looking for a spot to picnic and play - not great if you're looking to sunbathe and lounge.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Large park with good beach access.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place to spend time on the beach, but at times can get crowded.  Good place to watch the sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Follow the sun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We traveled south from Princeville to the only area not raining. Found easy parking and access to the beach. Although windy, the water was great for snorkeling. The monk seals and sea turtles were sleeping on the shore for all the tourists to admire. Great day at Poipu Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to be!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: To me and my family it was one of the best beaches of Kauai, just after the Salt Pond Beach. It is a nice place, little rocky on one side, but pretty good on the other. There is a place with lots of fish - great entertainment for kids. Little waves make this place kids friendly also.That dude on the pic below was chilling with us too :-)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Seals Sunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved the water, snorkeling, and hanging out with the adorable lazy monk seals who didn't seem to mind our company at all. Adults had tons of fun snorkeling while the kiddos (3,18 months, and 20 months) had tons of fun in the calm "baby beach" area and could wade in on their own while they played in the sand without us having to be directly next to them every second. Great place for the whole family.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Whales!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful section of the island. We had a great time walking and enjoying ourselves. Another great spot is Shipwreck Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went here to go snorkeling. Free parking, Sandy entry to water and very colorful and plentiful fish are very close to shore. Highly recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy and beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous spot. Not the best for swimming but good enough to cool off in. The beach itself is well maintained and clean! Great spot! Really enjoyed the protection of the seals as well!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to see the seals and sea turtles.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you go to the south shore of Kauai be sure to visit Poipu Beach Park early in the morning or evening. We saw a seal asleep on the sand in the morning and turtles come  in to rest at night.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtles, warm water, beautiful park with shade. Great Spot.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We could walk to this park and beach from our condo. It's a perfect combination of beach, and park. There are bathrooms, showers, chickens, shaded picnic tables and soft grass. There's a lifeguard on duty, kept busy having to remind tourists to give the big turtles their space. You can picnic or go into Brenneckes for food and adult beverages. We rented chairs and an umbrella for a week, best deal, next door at Nukumoi Surf Shop. Great family spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Has everything you would want.  Shade, sun, grass ,sand, smirking. Great for families. Has bathrooms which are not the cleanest. That's the reason I didn't give it a five star rating.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach review
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a pretty decent beach, except it has a lot of rocks and to many people for my liking. We prefer the beaches on the north end of Kauai

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and calming.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Po’ipu is on the opposite side of Kauai from where I stayed in Princeville. The actual vibe was also opposite to that of the north shore. Calm and relaxed, with a great shopping complex nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great little beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect sand, nice ledge about 10 out off the shore line. There are sections that has either rock or coral (Idk) that can make it a challenge to stand but those areas are pretty small.... Pro tip- wear water shoes and you can easily get around in the water and no one will be near you - - - because they don't have water socks! It's what I did to get some space from the other beach goers. The sunsets from this beach are absolutely stunning. Best on the island hands down!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Friendly Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful view as you walk down the Greenbelt walkway to this family friendly beach. One area is shallow and sandy for little ones and the other area is rocky but perfect for snorkeling. We saw so many fish without going very far into the water. The days we were there several sea turtles climbed on the beach. The park itself has play equipment, picnic tables and shelters and the beach has a lifeguard. A little farther down the beach is another swimming area in front of the Marriott and a sandbar for exploring. A restaurant, deli and beach store are right in front of beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling for beginners
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Decent beach but pretty rocky. Has lifeguards and bathrooms. Stone breakwaters help with waves. Tons of fish for snorkeling!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unforgettable Snorkling!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We started out finding a shady spot at the beach while my boys played in the water, there is a resort in the background and the beach can get a little crowded. When we were done with swimming, we saw some people snorkelling and we thought we'd give it a try. It was an incredible experience, there were SO MANY fish in clear water that you could see with your naked eyes...we were swimming with them. I don't know whey we bothered paying money at Hanuma Bay a fey days prior when we could enjoy unlimited fish time here :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Warm and clear waters.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went there two times during our trip.  Saw 3 turtles lying on the beach and one monk seal.  Pretty cool I'd say.  Also, the water is very warm and clear.  Many people were snorkeling but you don't even need that.  Just look down and colorful fish will swim right past you.  The water is shallow and gets chest deep farther in.I would suggest to wear swimming shoes since it's quite rocky but smooth in the water with some sand bars.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very Good Snorkeling and nice beacj
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited Friday late morning/early afternoon.  There were a lot of people there but we easily found a spot to sit.  The snorkeling was very good.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: NO WONDER IT WAS CROWDED
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited on a warm weekend in December. The soft sand, lifeguards, picnic tables, restrooms and beautifully colorful fish just feet off shore, made for a terrific day. We even got to see monk seals resting on the beach, one of which was pregnant. We met several super helpful people who shared their knowledge of the seals and the snorkeling. Became hooked on snorkeling and Poipu beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great protected beach to snorkel in especially in the winter when the surf is higher. Saw lots of fish and turtles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu beach is fabulous for families, couples, friends and gatherings.  Perfect snorkeling, life guards on duty, family friendly beach and swimming. Turtles, fish, and monk seals can be seen most days.  Walks along the beach and up the road are safe and you never know what you might discover.  Sand is gorgeous, perfect plac eto picnic and wath the sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family beach, great for snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We drove 70+ minutes twice from Princeville to enjoy this beach for the day. The snorkeling is excellent and easily accessible, plus there is a good-sized protected shallow sandy area perfect for children to play in safely. There are also two lifeguards, two bathrooms, a playground, and plenty of parking. If you forgot anything, there’s a beach rental right across the street. Plus, we saw sea turtles and monk seals resting on the beach both days! Great beach - worth the drive!! Highly recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Available to all
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is even a kiddie pool in the ocean! Who knew! This beach was within walking distance of us, and made a wonderful stopping place. Parking was across the street at a municipal lot, there were picnic tables under shade, bathrooms, and a wonderful beach. You could even wade out to the small island. Like all ocean beaches, currents must be watched for to keep everyone safe!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great location, easy access and wonderful facilities.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lifeguards on duty, easy access to snorkeling. Spent the whole day and had so much to see and do. Something for everyone. Saw 4 turtles on the beach, a Hawaiian Monk Seal, whales, so many fish, birds galore and of course Roosters and chickens.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Family Beach to Explore
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach is a great place to relax & enoy this wonderful family beach with locals & tourists alike...soft surf makes for easy snorkeling..long beaches with shallow water make it fun to explore for the whole family...Marine life can be seen from shore out to deeper waters for all to enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great little beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gentle surf, easy snorkeling. Average depth is about 4 foot through the whole cove. Great sand to sit on, and there’s a sandy area in the water for the kids, but 75% of the cove (in the water) is rock/coral so bring water shoes. There’s also a big Grady area with tables and shade. There are 2 restrooms, pretty clean for public beach restrooms, and here are a couple showers. 3 Hawaiian green sea turtles joined in on the beach as well as some monk seals. Very cool. Snorkeling is good/basic with a wide variety of tropical fish. Very shallow, but makes for an easy day of relaxing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pleasant surprise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beaches abound in the Islands.  Poipu was an unexpected surprise.  Low key beach town. Beautiful long beaches. Surf shops to reasonably rent all you'll need for a full day of snorkeling in crystal clear waters among plentifully fish to surround you. Bring chairs and an umbrella for shade. There are only a few tables and benches, and the shade is cast by scattered palms. Food was good but a bit pricy in a beachside restaurant. Go for the humongous desserts. All around good time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really Nice Views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great views.  Easy parking.  Lots of marine activity off shore including breaching whales and more.  Very nice quick stop.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach but strong surf.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is nice with a nice Park. The water is a little rough. There is a nice children beach area. We saw monk seals and sea turtles early every morning. What a treat!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Tons of fish which swim right by your faceProtected cove Reduces surf Recommend finding sand beds for entrance into surfLifeguard on beachWent 3 days back to back and easily found a spotFor suntanning Returned at sunset saw whales out about 1/4 mile

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach with lots of parking across the road. Lifeguards, pavilions, picnic tables, playground for the kiddies, restrooms. Lots of grass before you get to the sand/beach. Nice shady areas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to snorkel!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Saw a large sea turtle and a white eel. Last time we saw a seal and 2 turtles. Usually a seal laying on the shore. Sometimes a turtle. Lots of people, but that’s because there is a lot of sea life in the water here. Well worth the visit. Sometimes a Ukelele lesson at the pavilion. Haven’t had any current problems at this beach when we visited, but we follow the rules.  Pacific waters can be very dangerous though so don’t turn your back on the ocean when visiting Hawaii. Waves come in sets and then there are rogue waves, but if you are careful you will have a great time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved seeing the seals here and walking around the beach. Great snorkeling and saw turtles and lots of fish.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Public Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This public beach is very popular as it is tucked in next to the Sheraton and several other condo complexes. There is a lawn area and basic park facilities.  But parking can be tricky as there are only a very few public spots adjacent to the park. Many visitors seem to park down the public street aways.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the nice things about this beach park is that there is a lifeguard.  There are a couple areas great for toddlers and we also saw a lot of people snorkeling.  But there can be a lot of waves and rocks.  As someone said the beach extends to the Sheraton but not really-you have to climb through an area of rocks to walk all that way.  It seems to be popular with families.  There is quite a deep area of sand which is nice too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A very relaxed place to be.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in one of the condos just a few hundred meters from the park and used and walked through the park daily.   A good deal of care was given in the cleaning and general appearance in the park.  We were there at Christmas when the beaches were filled but the park remained open and not crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overcorwded and dangerously rocky
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came to check out this famous beach after lunch, and it was packed with people, like a can of sardines.  Parking was nearly impossible in the afternoon.  Once we found a spot we were stunned with how crowded the beach was.  There are large parking lots here and all spaces were taken.  The beach has showers, picnic tables, and bathrooms.  There is a protected cove for kids to swim, and the rest of the beach for adults.  The entry into the water is a solid piece of stone and the ocean bottom is incredibly rocky.  The beach area towards the large hotels was much less crowded.  We found a shady spot under a palm tree, on the grassy lawn facing the beach.  Getting a little peace here was not possible either because of the constant football throwing by guys showing off their machismo.  This place felt like a tourist trap.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wedding and vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach extends from Sheraton And is a beautiful stretch of sand to behold and which stretches to Shipwreck Beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice day with the teens and husband.  Beach not very crowded and surf great for boogie boarding and snorkeling.  Pack a lunch and coolers for drinks and enjoy the sun.  We also rent chairs by the week from the local surf shops for 15.00

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome! MUST visit.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place to spend the day. Currents can be swift between the beach and the island but there is plenty of areas to swim away from the current. Watchful Lifeguards on duty that are happy to show you where to swim away from the current. Great day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Snorkeling for Rookies!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of our favorite snorkeling spots.  You are guaranteed to see a number of colorful fish.  If your lucky, you will catch a Monk Seal an Green Sea Turtle resting on the beach.  However, DON'T get near them!  They are special and protected!  Just view from afar, as you won't see them much at home.  The bonus, is that there are lifeguards on this beach.  It is certain to be crowded, but if you are just snorkeling, you won't even notice!  Just hard to find a place to park and drop your gear!  Pack a lunch and make a day of it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for kids
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was the perfect place for a beach day with our kids. A great unexpected sight was seeing napping sea turtles and a monk seal on the beach. People could do a better job keeping their distance from the turtles. There are calm sandy areas perfect for wading through and playing. Also it’s a nice place for some beginner snorkeling with a variety of fish to see, no coral though. Another section in front of the Sheraton has smaller waves ideal for boogie boarding. Across the street there is a surf shop that had everything available for rent like beach chairs, umbrellas, and boogie boards.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A lovely park for all ages
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a perfect family spot for everyone from the surfers to a protected kids wading pool. It has nice white sand beaches with nearby shops for food and drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtles and monk seals
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Turtles and monk seals here every day! Be sure to give them the appropriate distance...also snorkeling here is good in the winter, there is a calm pool with many types of fish. Place to rent gear across the road. Not a fan of the boogie boarding beach to the left, it's called breakneck beach for a reason!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good place to enjoy the beach with your family and snorkel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came here to snorkel and to sit on the beach. The lifeguards were very attentive as some travelers were not aware of their lack of safety in the water. It was not overly crowded and it was a beautiful day. There were pavilions to have lunch in the shade.  Bathrooms were typical of beach bathrooms.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turtles, monk seals, easy snorkeling- and packed with people.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love Poipu beach for the snorkelling - my 10 year old son had the time of his life snorkelling alongside a turtle. We saw several turtles right up on the beach, which was amazing to see. Also, there are monk seals that frequently sunbathe here. This is an easy place for young kids to snorkel and see all kinds of fish. But be warned- this is a very popular beach and it does get crowded. There is a big parking lot across the street and we didn't have issues finding a spot either time we went, but we also arrived there in late morning, and it tended to get pretty full by mid-afternoon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved It!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a beautiful beach.  I walked the beach several days on our visit and each time I was struck by the beauty

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is second best beaches in Kauai next to Anini beach. Great for kids since there is reef area and no big waves there. We saw many turtles towards sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited many beaches in Kauai and Poipu is one of the finest beach we've been to in Kauai.Beautiful sand beach with picnic area, restrooms and close by restaurants , you dont need anything more than that.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and Very Crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely and very popular beach. Boogie boarding, snorkeling and swimming...with a thousand other people. This is a beautiful and very popular location. Still worth the visit but plan to fight for parking in high tourist season. Spotted several green sea turtles from the rocks away from the beach area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxed, good famil snorkling and body surfing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Park is open and available for short walk or parking.  There are two areas, on east side is good for body surfing and west is good for small children and easy snorkling

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very small
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The other side of the road is filled with hotels that only have a tiny patch of beach, so I imagine this also relatively small beach becoming easily packed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good for many reasons
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can snorkel, suntan, walk and see turtles and monk seals here every day.  We stay nearby, but it’s worth a drive here, especially with kids.  I’ve been here 4 times now, for a total of maybe 25 days, and I’ve seen sea turtles most days by Brennekes.  Just walk around the little cove, look into the waves and watch for them!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stay in Poipu every year.  It is the best beach - safe to swim, snorkeling is awesome, people watching, lots of monk seals - plenty to keep you entertained!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach for snorkeling!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of our favorite beaches on Kauai.  Awesome place to snorkel.  Calm waters due to the surrounding reef.  Clear water, even at midday.  Abundance of tropical fish as soon as you put your face in the water.  Even had a sea turtle and a Hawaiian Monk Seal on the beach.  Plenty of parking, but it can fill up on a busy day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful Warm Beach with Great Waves; wear beach shoes for optimal enjoyment!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited with our adult children we had such a good time we came back 3 days in a row. Would suggest beach shoes for optimal enjoyment. Sun is hot 🥵 beware of burning backs😅

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent family beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach. It’s a bit touristy, but there is an excellent protected area for small children and pretty good snorkeling. There are also life guards on duty, showers, reasonably clean restrooms, and covered picnic tables. The Poipu area is very nice with lots of shops and restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach ...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach covers everything.  Sandy, rocky, black rocks, rocking waves, gentle waves.  This trip we’ve seen MANY turtles and several Monk Seals, which rest on the beach.  If you go to the pond/in front of Brenneke’s at night, you may see a lot of turtles coming in to rest.  In and out of the water.  Bring a flashlight.  They are amazing.  We lucked out and saw 2 during the day — one right by a seal!  It’s always an adventure to go see what may be on the beach each day.  Sightings usually result in the seal/turtle being roped off for their, and the visitors’, safety.  For the seals they will have a sign stating the sex and age of the seal, sunning itself while many onlookers take pictures.  Usually there is a volunteer there also, answering questions.   Poipu Beach is also a great place for snorkeling and paddle boarding or surfing (or watching others do these things).  And there’s always the sunsets!  Love this beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very popular, get there early for parking, wading, swimming or snorkeling, this beach has it all. Check it out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach for all to enjoy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach, just keep in mind it can get busy and parking may be tricky during peak hours. Very family friendly!Across the street you can walk to get snow cones or snacks!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach to take a dip in a calm ocean.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I are in our 60s and found this to be a great beach to take a nice dip in a calm ocean setting. The beach is in a horseshoe shape so this cuts down on the big waves plus there's a lifeguard station there also. This would be a great beach to take little children to play in the ocean and not worry about any large waves or rip currents taking them out to sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Winter snorkeling salvation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: OK I admit it, Go all the way to Hawaii and leave my snorkel in the luggage in the hotel. Luckily I was saved by my husband who loaned me his so I could look at the fish on this beautiful beach. I must say I saw over 20 species of fish in knee-deep water here. I wonderful salvation to my vacation and I love this beech.  Not to mention my sea turtle that was sleeping here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach with Great Swimming and Snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach was recommended as the best beach in Kauai by a friend and it did not disappoint. We went to Kauai in winter and many of the beaches were not swimmable due to rough waters but Poipu's unique reefs make it an ideal beach for swimming and the snorkeling was phenomenal. Highly Recommended!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely spot at Sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach Park is a lovely spot..... not only a wide beach, but grass area with shade plus restrooms!  I went last evening and watched a beautiful sunset. Take a beach chair and a book and hangout for a while!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach but Crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach area about 25 minutes south of Lihue.  Heavily used by tourists from the many condos and other tourist havens in this area.  Fine white sand and there is plenty of beach for walks, sunbathing and building sand castles.  A good place to visit, if you are looking for a nice easily-accessible beach where you can spend some nice down time either alone or with your family – as long as you don’t mind the crowds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy Beach That's Great for Kids
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you're looking for a quiet, secluded beach, this is not for you. But if you're a family with kids of any age, it's ideal. A sheltered lagoon area is a perfect place to introduce little ones to water fun, and elsewhere, rolling waves provide plenty of excitement for older kids, teens, and adults. A playground and restrooms are readily available. As a senior couple, this wouldn't be our first choice of beaches on Kauai; but if we had been traveling with grandchildren, it would be perfect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach Fun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great little spot for family fun. Shallow protected pool suitable for kids. Some snorkelling can be done in this area. A turtle swam onto the beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Being in the center of a feeding frenzy of hundreds of fish is HILARIOUS!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We rented snorkel gear at the Nukumoi Surf Shop (no reefs but lots of fish – especially if you purchase fish food at the surf shop and then become the center of a feeding frenzy of hundreds of fish in the shelter of the rocks on the far left of the beach).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful calm beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We've been at Poipu a number of times and it is definitely one of our go-to spots! It tends to be a little bit busy due to the resorts situated close by. The waters are relatively calm and comparison to other beaches around the island... good for kids, boogie-boarding, snorkeling Etc. Beautiful beach for sunsets! Depending on the wind and surf Heights there still tends to be a strong current if you go into the deeper areas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great spot for snorkeling and people watching...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were on Kauai last week + a few - we stayed on Poipu at the Point.  This beach is a few mins drive and an amazingly beautiful place. Came here at night once looking for green sea turtles. No luck. Went snorkeling a day later and swam within a few inches (no kidding) of a humongus green sea turtle.  The only reason I didn't give a 5 was the facilities were dirty and in dire need of upgrading.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Snorkel where you can see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to lydgate first today to snorkel and visibility was sparse. We then went To Poipu and in shallow water were able to see around 15 varieties of fish in clear water at close range. Highly recommend,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply Amazing, Sea Turtle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of my favorite beaches on the Island of Kauai. There is great snorkeling here. Not only the water, but the view is fabulous. One of the best sunset beaches on the Island!  However my most favorite part are the Monk seals who come ashore to rest in the daytime and the amazing Green Sea Turtles who come ashore after the sun sets. A week ago, 8 turtles came up and 2 nights ago 9!!! Wow, what a sight. But please, please no flash photography as it can scare them back into the water where danger lurks at night. Just enjoy with no flashes or flashlights, respect them. Mahalo!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just a lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We grabbed an Uber to the beach from our NCL cruise for a relaxing afternoon.  It is perfect--white sand, protected cove, monk seals, and of course, chickens!  Grab a shave ice from the shop across the way and you've got a perfect day at the beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good snorkeling location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We enjoyed this beach three times while staying on the north shore and driving over to this location.  The beach was very good, but a bit tough to walk through where the sand was not packed.  The parking lot was full two of three times as the two were during the day and the last time in the early evening.  Get there as early as possible.  There are two lifeguard stations at this beach which was very welcome and indicated to us the importance of this beach.As I am not an experienced snorkeler, it was good to be here to practice and enjoy the 16 different types of fish that I saw on both days we were there.  So worth it to see the various types of fish, their colors, the shapes and what seemed like whimsical swimming.  My wife does not snorkel but she took the opportunity just to stand in the water and used my mask to look into the water to see some of the fish.It will be important to wear water shoes or socks as the there is a lot of rock just as you enter the ocean.  With this footwear, it was very easy to keep balance and prevent injury with scrapping from the rock.The washrooms were Ok based on the fact they need to be easy to clean and are used by hundreds each day.  We did go to the beach in an early evening and really enjoyed seeing a large turtle that came ashore.  During the other visits there were monk seals sunning and resting which was nice to see.  Loved it here and will be back next time we are in Kaua'i.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach close to Grand Hyatt
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is close to the hotel. It is probably not the nicest beach on the island. The sand is great, there is a lot of lava areas nearby, which are beautiful. The shore drops off to the water. The waves were pretty big, red flag warning all the days we were there, but people were able to surf and play in the water. A trail borders the water, is beautiful to see the coastline.There are some whale sittings at times!Public parking close by, no rentals available for gear, chairs, or umbrellas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love this beach and park. It does get crowded early so get here early. Pack a lunch, lots of picnic tables or purchase from the local restaurant. We come here every year.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to wake up
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach has a great view, great place to snorkel (very shallow, not much surf) and some friendly turtles in the morning. The turtles are sun bathing until it get's too hot then take off (slowly as you can imagine) into the water and off into the sea. The beach and park are great for all people, families, couples, solo travelers, etc. There is a lot of space on the grass to set up shop if the beach is full. It's a short walk to another beach to body surf too, less than a 5 minute walk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: GREAT SPOT ON KAUAI
reviewsWithKeywords.text: calm low key spot in southern kauai, condo was minutes away & family went here after a day site seeing on other key spots of kauai. easy snorkeling & turtle sighting

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Safe Snorkeling but watch your feet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is really nice. It is pretty safe even for less experienced swimmers. It’s great for snorkeling with lots of fish to see in the relatively shallow water. We even saw a sea turtle and a rare monk seal was resting on the beach. It is very rocky though and if you have sensitive feet, it’s best to wear water shoes or flippers. The park has nice, shaded picnic benches and restrooms.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We saw so many different kinds of fishes here, including eels! The fish aren’t even afraid of people. There were so many, some swam in schools. Great for little kids!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing and diverse
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Has it all.  Barbecue grills for public use, fishing, rocks, beach.  Little coves, so even though it was very busy, felt private at the same time.  Spotted a monk seal right by the rocks, and watched sea turtles for a couple of hours in the surf.  Loved this visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach for families
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Poipu Beach is a very nice beach to take your family to. It's lagoon is surrounded by a jetty keeping the water calm. The snorkeling is good and you never know when a turtle will show up.With two lifeguard stands it is very safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach for the family
