reviews.text: This is a lovely beach. It is very crowded and busy though. After sunset however,  green seat turtles come ashore and hangout.  So cool to get to see them upclose.

reviews.title: Great beach, great views, great wildlife
reviews.text: Love this beach, been coming since I was very little, very nice waves and swimming, but has gotten a lot busier over the years. Boogeyboarding at Brenneneckies next door is amazing, and make sure you check out the shave ice and deli! Saw lots of turtles too which was fantastic!

reviews.title: Difficult snorkel entry
reviews.text: Check it out first for snorkeling. There is just one less-rocky place to enter the water for snorkeling. But there are sea turrles hanging around at a big rock not far out.

reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: Great walk-in snorkeling!  So happy there were lifeguards at this beach, they were friendly, alert and attentive.

reviews.title: Whales right off of Poipu!
reviews.text: Plenty of parking, nice facilities and a gorgeous beach make this a perfect beach for families or large groups. We traveled to Kauai with our extended family (a group of 8 including 2 kids under the age of 10), and found Poipu Beach to be an excellent place for swimming and snorkeling for all ages. As an added bonus, we had our own whale watch- with multiple whales breaching and diving for about 15 minutes right off of Poipu Beach!

reviews.title: Sight worth seeing
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible place to snorkel, see the sea turtles and seals come onto the beach and watch beautiful sunsets.

reviews.title: Nice beach with wildlife
reviews.text: We made several trips here. Some of us went snorkeling which they loved, seeing urchins, turtles, etc underwater. I got to see three turtles on the beach, two trying to mate. Not sure if they did. Each day a monk seal was snoozing some where on the beach much to everyone's delight. The location was not far from our rental. It wasn't too crowded this time of year and people were considerate of each other.

reviews.title: Good for snorkeling
reviews.text: Good for snorkeling Life guards keep close track of all in the water and make announcements frequently to keep swimmers in their space . Life guards also protect wildlife in the water protected from swimmers who come too close . We saw seals and turtles . Restrooms are typical beach quality . Parking  is at premium during prime time hours .Family friendly for picnics . Restaurant across street for take-out if needed .

reviews.title: Turtles and Monk Seals
reviews.text: Since we were staying in the Poupou area, we managed to visit the beach a couple times.  We did snorkel here with the turtles but came back twice for the sunsets and to see the turtles come onto the beach in the evening.  My husband runs every morning and mentioned there were more turtles there in the morning than in the evening.One evening, we saw a Monk Seal resting and sunning on the beach.  Know that there are conservationists there to protect the turtles and seals from vacationers.  They will make sure you keep your distance and answer questions you may have about the species.Besides the wildlife, there are picnic tables and modern restrooms for the public.  Parking is also nearby and good.

reviews.title: Such a cool beach
reviews.text: We stopped here twice, to see the sea turtles and monk seals.  They are protected by volunteers but easy to see, and watch.

reviews.title: Bring your snorkel gear and come see the turtles!
reviews.text: This is a great beach to come with kids.  We arrived about 6:30pm (in Feb) to come see the turtles and would highly recommend this.  We also saw a monk seal on the beach and whales in the distance.  Bring snorkel gear - it's much calmer in this area.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling spot
reviews.text: Great beach with turtles sunning themselves on the sand! We snorkeled here and found it to be a great snorkel spot. The lifeguards are friendly and helpful and parking is good.

reviews.title: Great for snorkeling
reviews.text: We enjoyed the snorkeling there.  There are some rocks that have to be negotiated but well worth the effort.  There are life guards and a shallow area ideal for children.

reviews.title: Something for Everyone
reviews.text: Poipu Beach offers something for everyone!  There was amazing snorkeling area, a small beach shielded from the waves for the little ones, and surfing all within a short distance of each other.  The day we visited, we saw a Hawaiian Green Turtle, and a Monk Seal sunning themselves on the beach!

reviews.title: Too crowded
reviews.text: Nice enough beach but way too crowded for me.  Not as pretty as many other beaches but it appears to be a good place to snorkel.  Not too deep and well protected little Bay Area.

reviews.title: Make sure to go see the turtles at night!
reviews.text: Definitely worth seeing the turtles at night!   During the day was great in the Bay Area for little ones ! Playground too !

reviews.title: Love the Grassy Areas
reviews.text: Just a great beach to hang out. There’s shallow water for the kids, a nice snorkeling section, boogie boarding - though crowded - nearby restaurants and equipment rental, two lifeguards, and a coastal trail that takes you to the Sheraton and beyond. I especially liked the shady grassy area if you just want to hang out and read a book. Clean and well maintained, there seems to be plenty of parking, but go early on weekends!

reviews.title: Go at sunset to see the sea turtles
reviews.text: An excellent beach! I highly recommend going at sunset and you will see the sea turtles come onto the beach. It is very magical and something you will not be able to experience other places.

reviews.title: Crowded but good for everyone
reviews.text: There are decent snorkeling spots - we saw some sea turtles unexpectedly.  The snorkeling space is rather small and shallow - we found better snorkeling nearby but this would be good for young ones/novice snorkelers since it is patrolled well by lifeguards who keep you in the safe areas.

reviews.title: Excellent beach for playing and swimming in the water.
reviews.text: We saw lots of seals here, one laying up on the beach.  It's a large beach, good parking.  The Sheraton is nearby, so it had more people on the beach than  some of the others that we visited, but it was still a great beach to go to.  Multiple life guards, too.  Great for kids.

reviews.title: Great beach and snorkeling
reviews.text: Ample free parking just across from a beautiful Kauai beach.  Lifeguard on duty and areas for small children to adventurous adults.  A Hawaiian monk seal was sunbathing on the beach right in front of the lifeguard tower as if he owned the place.  Snorkeling to the west we quickly found a variety of fish including moorish idol fish and a large female sea turtle munching along the rocks.  Great place to enjoy all beach acetivities.

reviews.title: Busy But Spacious Beach with Plenty of Wildlife
reviews.text: Had a nice time snorkling here. It was pretty busy, lots of families. There are bathrooms and lifeguards. There was one main area that schools of fish were congregating and they got pretty close to you. It was pretty shallow. I saw a turtle swimming. Some areas are harder to swim since it can be rocky and shallow. There is another cove with a beach on the right side of the island that I did not walk down.I went out to the island, but it is very rocky so walk carefully and wear water shoes. Once on the island, there was a seal and 2 turtles sunbathing! Someone had put up rocks as a barrier to allow them some space. There is sand in the middle of the island, and rocks around the edges. You can watch the waves crashing on the rocks. Very few people go to the island because it is slightly difficult to walk to. I did scrape my knee slightly on a rock when heading back to shore but it was worth it.There is plenty of space at this beach. We sat under one of the trees to the far left near some picnic tables. There are lots of chickens and baby chicks running around losing their mothers.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Every morning around 6:30 the green sea turtles can be spotted. One morning there were 21! I was also lucky enough to spot a monk seal. The beach is clean and there is a grass area with picnic tables for lunch. There are many chickens that will try and join you for a snack. The snorkeling was good as well. If you time it right, you may spot a green sea turtle swimming back to sea. Sunset is also a magical time to visit this beach.

reviews.title: Crowded.  Not good for swimming- super rocky
reviews.text: May be good for snorkeling but NOT swimming. Very rocky. several kids got their legs cut up. Bathrooms are really disgusting.

reviews.title: Perfect beach for children
reviews.text: This tucked away little beach with its natural rock enclosure is the perfect beach for children, keeping them safe and well-protected from turbulent waters. It's safe feature also allows parents the comfort to relax as they watch their toddlers and young children play in the sand and water.   The water is calm, the sand is warm, and the grass is inviting for all ages to enjoy.

reviews.title: Great beach!
reviews.text: Stopped by here for a short day visit and we were so glad we did! Great snorkel spot, nice sandy beach, and seals!! Watching the seals lounge on the beach was a true highlight of our trip.

reviews.title: Perfect beach for families
reviews.text: We spent a couple of days at the beach. Go early before the crowds arrive.  Parking is easy and there is food to eat nearby. The snorkeling is surprisingly good on the larger side of the area. You may get to see a Monk Seal too. I'd return here again.

reviews.title: Family friendly beach with sea life
reviews.text: Rocky but nice beach! Seal was hanging on beach. Protected beach with minimal shore break. Nice food & shopping close by. Cute little island to walk over to

reviews.title: great beach!
reviews.text: Can be a bit crowded but very nice sand beach.  Bathrooms are awful.  Was able to see Monk Seals on the beach!

reviews.title: Nice Public Beach and a Good Place to Catch Sunset
reviews.text: We came here to try to catch sunset.  We got there in time, but there were clouds along the horizon--still beatiful.Seems like this is quite the spot for surfing.  Good facilities and looks like a great place to spend the day if you're looking to get away from your resort.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Good beach, has showers, restrooms and foot washing stations. Like most of the beaches here it is clean. Decent snorkeling overall.

reviews.title: Brennecke’s Beach
reviews.text: Way too crowded.  Too many tourists.   Which is why the turtles don’t come so if you want to see turtles don’t come here.   Sunset here was very nice.  Riptides snow cone or shredded ice place was super close but other than that not the best beach.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful Hawaiian beach with plenty of space and parking. Park includes playground and restrooms along with lifeguards.

reviews.title: Average snorkeling, awesome turtle watching at sunrise and sunset
reviews.text: Snorkeling is ok. Lots of fish in the area. We saw 2 turtles while snorkeling. A LOT more turtles right after sunset (about 10 turtles ~30 minutes after sunset), and 30min before sunrise (we saw at least 15 turtles one morning). Brennecke’s Beach Broiler is right on the beach. Great place for lunch and dinner after snorkeling or turtle watching at sunset

reviews.title: Good snorkeling
reviews.text: There are two areas to snorkel in...to the left is a secluded area which looked great for the kids and was full of families.  To the right was a more open area where we went.  The only caution is that there is a reef to the right fairly close to shore which we did not know was there until we went out.  It was sharp and hard to cross over without damaging the reef or cutting yourself.  I suggest entering on the secluded side and swimming around the reef if you want to move to the right. We saw quite an assortment of fish and then waited for the sunset.  Great day!

reviews.title: Good place to eat lunch, plenty of picnic benches and restrooms
reviews.text: We've eaten  our Puka Dog twice here and it is a nice place to eat.  There are plenty of tables tho weekend might be too busy.

reviews.title: Mediocre beach at best.
reviews.text: This beach is very small and very rocky for most of it. It wasn’t terribly busy when we were there, and there still wasn’t a lot of room. I can’t imagine going during  a busy season. Not one of the top 10 beaches in Kauai.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and setting
reviews.text: Lovely site for swimming-lots of turtles. Great grassy park, too. Brennecke's restaurant across the street.

reviews.title: Great snorkel spot!
reviews.text: Great snorkeling spot on the right hand side of Poipu beach.  We were able to walk directly from the Sheraton on the boardwalk in the morning.  We saw green sea turtles and a TON of beautiful fish in the surprisingly clear water near the rocks.  Also pulled up a Hawaiian reef crab that was really big :)LOVED IT

reviews.title: Great snorkeling
reviews.text: We saw several turtles on the beach each day we came. There are bathrooms and a few places to eat. The ocean floor is very rocky and not sandy, but it makes for great snorkeling. We saw tons of fish

reviews.title: Fun snorkeling!
reviews.text: Poipu Beach - 5 starsPoipu Beach is a great park for hanging out and snorkeling. It’s a bit busy, but has easy access to snorkeling with beautiful fish. We even saw an octopus and eels! Parts of the area are shallow for snorkeling, but it was easy to find deeper water. There were also 1 or 2 endangered monk seals on the small island beach. There are public restrooms and showers for rinsing off afterwards.

reviews.title: Great beach with view of sunset
reviews.text: This beach is lovely. Plenty of parking, washrooms and home of Puka Dog, another restaurant and a deli.There are picnic tables and a covered picnic area and a playground.  There are tons of chickens roaming around the grass areas.It is a great spot to watch the sunset.There is a shallow area almost enclosed by rocks and larger open areas of beach as well.After sunset you can see the turtles come on shore to rest…..but be respectful and stay far back and do not take flash photography as it hurts their eyes.

reviews.title: Beautiful place to watch sunset and see sea turtles
reviews.text: We went at sunset upon recommendation of someone we met while here. It was very crowded for sunset but beautiful views. If you stay after sunset, the sea turtles come up on the beach. We waited probably 10 minutes after sunset before they started coming up! Definitely worth it to wait and see!

reviews.title: Average tourist beach
reviews.text: Highly over rated, too many people, too many people snorkeling that have no idea what they are doing. If you want a quiet beach or a good snorkeling beach drive around a fund a place to have your solitude.

reviews.title: Go early to get parking!
reviews.text: Nice beach and area for kids to swim in.  Can get very crowded there, so parking can be an issue.  It is walkable from several of the Poipu resorts - some hills.

reviews.title: Poipu Beach , home to many hanu on island.
reviews.text: Poipu Beach is a lovely beach that many honu call home. Be mindful that they are sometimes hard to see when you are entering the water. Don't step an these beautiful turtles. In fact , you must give them space where ever they are on the beach or in the water. This is their home and laws protect them not the tourist in this case. Do not ever touch these beautiful creatures.  Your Zoom lense works beautifully to get upclose and personal. Its the only way.

reviews.title: Relaxing and family friendly
reviews.text: Relaxing family friendly beach. Busy with activities and people. Water entry an be difficult at certain times of the year.

reviews.title: Stopped to eat lunch
reviews.text: This beach was very crowded and small, but it was fine for hanging out on the grass long enough to eat lunch. It was hard to enjoy the waves with all the people crowding the small space, though. If you want to snorkel or swim, I recommend going down to Kuhio Shores.

reviews.title: Perfect for a day at the beach
reviews.text: If you want to spend a day at the beach, Poipu is just about as perfect of a place as can be. The sandy beach is large enough to not be crowded, even when there are a lot of people. The water is relatively calm and there's gentle slope providing a lot of enjoyable space for reluctant swimmers, like myself, who don't like not being able to reach the bottom. Snorkeling is great everywhere, even in knee deep water there are lots of different kinds of fish. You do need to wear either fins or water shoes as the bottom is all coral. There are shaded picnic tables. A number of food options just across the street, including funky Puka Dog, Deli, and ice cream place. And parking is free and sufficient, at least on a weekday.

reviews.title: Great Beach to Visit
reviews.text: No it’s not South Beach in Miami, but can certainly appear as such with the crowds of people, but most are respectable of each other’s space.  Going beyond the crowd you have a safe lifeguarded beach with solid surfing to the far right and additionally there are many wildlife sightings.  We we went here two days while in Kauai and saw five seals total sleeping on the beach (and saw two of those make their way to the beach), including a pregnant female, plus while snorkeling saw two giant sea turtles close to 30” long and many other small fish.  With lots of free parking, clean bathrooms and outdoor showers available this is a great beach to spend the day at!

reviews.title: Snorkel spot that won’t worry mom
reviews.text: Great spot for snorkeling. Lots of grass further back from the sand with a moderate amount of palm trees to offer some shade. Covered picnic tables. Showers. Rental shop across the street has snorkel gear, boogie boards, and surfboards. Deli shop with hot dogs and snow cones. Life guards. Lots and lots of fish, I even saw a turtle.

reviews.title: Beach day
reviews.text: What a nice beach. It’s a place to snorkel and swim if you want to spend the day. A little rocky when you are trying to get out snorkeling, but then if you want to swim you can just walk down a 100 yards or so. Definitely beautiful

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This beach is a bit rocky -  but absolutely delightful! Bathroom available for changing, too.  Food and ample parking.

reviews.title: This beach has it all.
reviews.text: This beach was excellent!  There were big waves at one end and very little waves at the other due to protection from rocks.  This made it great for my 4 year old to play in the water safely.  We even had a sea turtle come up and rest in the beach!  There is also a park with a play structure perfect for drying off.  Plenty of bathrooms and areas to picnic. There is a restaurant with carry out across the street. It wasn’t too crowded.  And it was beautiful. Also has lifeguards on duty at designated times.  We almost spent the whole day here. Definitely missing this beach now that we’re back on the east coast.

reviews.title: Not a lot of Shade
reviews.text: But wonderful beach.  It’s close to th main road.  There’s parking; picnic tables.  Across the street there’s a restaurant; surf; n a MUST hv Puka Dog.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling!
reviews.text: An easy access beach with fantastic snorkeling and boogey-boarding right off the beach.  The fish were colorful and plentiful.  You can rent snorkel gear right across the road.

reviews.title: Day at the beach
reviews.text: This is a great beach to hit the waves. Super clear water and awesome waves. Saw a few giant turtles. Bring a chair, food and drink as the lines are long at the shop

reviews.title: Great adventurous day at the beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach waves and rocks were a bit rough, all of us have some battle wounds. But worth the trip and experiece (Kids: 17-f, 15-f. 15-M, 12-F). Plus, 5 adults. The island was fun but challeging to tackle. We saw a full size sea turtle basking in the sun on the little island. Plus, a small one playing in the choral. Do not approach the island the shortest distance go over through the middle. At the end (shortest distances) is rough with waves hitting you from both directions and trying to navigate the choral. All of us have some wounds from the choral and learned our lessons the hard way. There is a very protected area for small children that is almost as calm as a swimming pool and swallow. Boring for the teens but great for the littles.Snorkeling was okay..but the day we were there was rougher than normal.

reviews.title: Crowded
reviews.text: Too many resorts, too many people for this small beach.  Rocky ground.  Nice sunsets. Visit early or late in day to find parking space and uncrowded beach.

reviews.title: Great beach, great snorkeling, have to walk over rocks to get to snorkel
reviews.text: Poipu is a great beach, with lifeguard, picnic tables, restrooms, and lots of fish.  Good place for easy snorkeling, although the rocks make it somewhat difficult to get into water deep enough to float and observe.   Best bet is to get a setup of water shoes and fins without a bottom that strap around the back of your heel.  While I didn’t see turtles swimming, there were three of them sunning on the beach.

reviews.title: A Must See
reviews.text: My only regret is that we did not have a lot of time to spend at this beach. It is beautiful and very well maintained. There were picnic tables in the shade and plenty of beach space (we were there early, but there was a constant stream of people coming in). It looked like a good spot for snorkeling. I think this would be a good beach for families with young kids as there are shallow areas with minimal waves. We did see one sea turtle on the beach. He was in an area marked off with rocks. I was told that there are more turtles earlier in the morning but once the beach starts to get a lot of activity they don't come on shore as much. All the better, get there early, see the turtles and stake out a spot for the day. This is a must see beach.

reviews.title: Well Maintained Beach
reviews.text: This is a very well maintained beach with attentive lifeguards who watch to make sure guests are not bothering the seals or turtles that sometimes beach on the island area near the beach.  The bathrooms are well maintained and there was plenty of parking each day that we went.  Nearby you can rent different beach gear to snorkel or boogey board.  If you have small children that want to snorkel here, I would recommend a snorkel vest or some type of floatation device because the waves can get strong.   While you will see some fish here and even some sea turtles, the Lawai Beach area has many more fish to see when snorkeling.

reviews.title: Turtles and snorkeling
reviews.text: Absolutely a must see if you are nearby. Shallow park water that is perfect for snorkeling. We walked up and marveled at the three sea turtle sculptures only to realize that they were REAL sea turtles on the beach. This was around 9:30 AM. There is a shallow sandy area perfect for young children. BRING WATER SHOES or flippers if you want to go further into the water it’s rocky but you will see the most beautiful fish and sea urchins and coral. There are lifeguards who make sure you don’t go too far because the current will make it difficult to swim back. When we resurfaced we were able to watch the final sea turtle return to the ocean. Absolutely a beautiful experience. We also watched a seal come up for some sun. People were mostly respectful but a few people needed some reminders to give them plenty of space.

reviews.title: Excellent Place to Snorkel for Beginners
reviews.text: Excellent beach within an enclosed cove for little kids.  There is excellent snorkeling even on the shallow part of the tidepools.  Saw a trash can lid sized Green Sea Turtle on the same.  Everyone was respectful and kept their distance from the turtle.  There are lifeguards on duty.  It can get very hot.  Bring lots of sunblock or an umbrella.

reviews.title: Nice swimming place
reviews.text: Was very crowded when we were there but nice little place to swim and snorkel. Protected by a reef so no waves.

reviews.title: Turtle & Sea lions
reviews.text: Our family stayed in the nearby Ocean facing condo. Poipu beach park was excellent. To our surprise, when we went to watch sunset we saw Sea Lions and Turtles crawling all over the beach. Wonderful place to watch sunset and amphibians.

reviews.title: Early morning to see the turtles!
reviews.text: We did not get a chance to visit at sunset - but early morning (10-15 minutes after sunrise) there were 10-15 turtles and got to watch them one by one head back into the ocean!  Easy to walk to from various resorts with nice paved path coming from both directions

reviews.title: Sun & Honu!!!
reviews.text: We enjoy this beach for sunbathing, people watching, snorkeling, and bobbing in the water. This is the place for spring sunsets. After the sun goes down, the Honu (green sea turtles) come out to sleep.  (KEEP YOUR DISTANCE)

reviews.title: Little sand, lots of people, and a monk seal.
reviews.text: After having spent the first half of our trip on the more isolated North Shore (as a result of the restricted access via the Kuhio Highway), Poipu Beach was a let-down.  Perhaps if it had been our first stop, we would have been more pleased.  The area is made up of small coves with limited and steep beaches against a backdrop of corporate resorts.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Very nice beach to hang out. We saw (up close) a sea lion and turtle sun bathing which was an unexpected and unique experience. Right across the street is puka dog which was delicious.

reviews.title: fun, beautiful beach
reviews.text: Such a beautiful and relaxing beach. We took our breakfast out there and ate with the chickens. Wonderful, clean beach

reviews.title: ❤️ oh yeah!
reviews.text: I love it there. In fact, it’s my favorite beach! (Tip: it’s pronounced Poi-poo.Altogether, Poipu! ;)

reviews.title: Huge sea turtles at night and monk seals during the day
reviews.text: We were close buy so we walked this beach many times. Public park here so parking and bathrooms. If you're on the south shore go place to walk, swim and see the animals

reviews.title: Crystal clear water
reviews.text: This crescent shape beach offers crystal clear waters. Very popular with visitors and locals alike however,  it has been empty since the pandemic.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: I’d recommend this beach always sunny even when rest of island is raining. So come here for the day stay for the week.

reviews.title: Nice snorkeling daytime and turtles at night !
reviews.text: Nice small beach- has a cute snorkeling spot for daytime and easy to rent snorkel gear at Koa Kea hotel and Marriott beach club nearby. During day, we saw a giant turtle or two.At night , we saw almost twenty turtles on the beach sleeping!

reviews.title: Fire ball sunset
reviews.text: Wasn’t a lot of people there tonight but normally I hear it is packed -the sky was beautiful fire ball and the beach is really nice

reviews.title: Eleven turtles this am
reviews.text: Perhaps because of the shutdown we were greeted by the most turtles we have ever seen on Poipu Beach.  Only a few humans on the beach and everyone was socially distant, except the turtles

reviews.title: Love this beach
reviews.text: This is a great beach--wonderful snorkeling, nice bathrooms, nice grass area, palm trees for shade, good showers.  The snorkeling is pretty good, and we had luck with monk seals and turtles.

reviews.title: Good beach for young children
reviews.text: This is a good beach for young children because the island/natural jetty creates a sheltered cover from waves that is very shallow. Snorkeling is okay not great. The beach is the most overcrowded beach on the island and not totally sure why.

reviews.title: Poipu Beach
reviews.text: Since COVID-19 it's been a pleasant beach to go being less crowded and safe for kids under the age of 5 to enjoy the water. While the side closer to Sheraton caters more toward juniors and adults who wants to snorkel, body board and surf. 2 life guard towers operates til 5pm daily. Ocean currents remains strong daily.

reviews.title: Wonderful family spot
reviews.text: Poipu Beach Park is a lovely park ideal for families as it has a beautiful, shallow lagoon that children can walk and swim in safely. There are very nice picnic tables plus a lifeguard station. Poipu is the sunniest side of the island, so beach days here are a great experience.

reviews.title: Rude lifeguards
reviews.text: not supper friendly lifeguards     day we were there it was red flag so not able to go in the water  did play on the beach and was still worth going

reviews.title: Fun beach with a lot of fish and a giant turtle!
reviews.text: This is a busy but fun beach with good snorkel opportunity and the day we were there, a big sea turtle came to the shore to visit.

reviews.title: popular place
reviews.text: it was busy w/lots of people, but manageable.  the water was very clear.  snorkeling was great.  we saw tons of colorful fish.  very protected beach from the surf.  we didn't need to snorkel too far out because the fish were all about us just a few feet into the water.  good facilities....restrooms, picnic tables etc.

reviews.title: Kauai Vacation
reviews.text: We rented a condo a walking distance from Poipu Beach Park.  It is a great place for families with a shallow water area, deeper area for snorkeling, an island and surfing areas.  There are two life guard towers, showers and restrooms.  This is a beautiful sandy beach to catch sun rays and to see turtles and monk seals.  Great place to sit and relax as well as get in the water.

reviews.title: It rained all day but a got a break for a quick stroll
reviews.text: It makes a very nice stroll after a big meal while enjoying the scenic views. There's a unique small area especially suited for young children to enjoy the beach safely.

reviews.title: wonderful beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach with not too strong of waves, we had a great time there. We were a family with 8 people ranging in age from 7 to 72.

reviews.title: Crowded, but great swimming and snorkeling
reviews.text: The beach is pretty narrow, so less sand for sitting or laying out on, and hence, a bit more crowded than some. It's great for snorkeling and nice for swimming. Wear swim shoes for the rocks under the water, although I didn't and found it was still easy enough to swim and float. I advise arriving earlier than 11am. Parking and a good beach spot were easier to find before that time.

reviews.title: Family friendly beach at the south end of Kauai
reviews.text: Poipu beach is widely known locally and among tourists as one of the best family friendly beaches in Kauai. This beach is excellent for families even with small kids. There are rocks forming a cove that protects the beach from the relentless waves of the Pacific ocean. Poipu beach is a good swimming and snorkeling beach. It is also a place to see monk seals and turtles sunbathing on the beach. Poipu beach is also know for its excellent sunsets.There are public restrooms and outdoor showers. There are lifeguards. There is sufficient parking. There are covered pavillions with tables. There are nearby restaurants for shaved ice and meals.I would recommend this beach while visiting Kauai.

reviews.title: Great Beach with easy access
reviews.text: We said just across the street of Poipu Beach park.  The beach and surrounding area is just beautiful.  We saw turtles and monk seals sunning themselves.  It’s a great place for kids and families.  We watched the waves roll in and crash for hours on the rocky areas of the park and played in the water on the sandy beaches.  We watched the sunset at night.  Loved the ares.

reviews.title: Crowded
reviews.text: This may be a great spot in the early morning but later in the day it was crowded. Maybe a mini Waikiki but still the snorkling was fun and you can see a lot of colorful fish

reviews.title: Snorkeling
reviews.text: Good place on Kauai for Snorkeling. Beach can be crowded, but if you go early you will not have a problem.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Large beach with lots of people. Not the place to go if you want to avoid crowds, but  great for snorkeling (SO many fish and we saw a HUGE sea turtle just offshore). Easy parking if you go early and multiple lifeguard stands, decent bathrooms, shady areas and a nearby spot for food help explain why it is so popular.

reviews.title: Go around the corner
reviews.text: Go around the corner to the beach in front of the Marriott Waiohai. Often, there is a monk seal on this beach. Do not snorkel near the island where most of the people are swimming. Go to the right, directly in front of the Marriott for the best snorkeling. Also, this beach, in the wintertime, is often the only one suitable for swimming with your kids.

reviews.title: Busy but Great
reviews.text: Fantastic beach located in a somewhat busy area. Great snorkelling with lots of seals and sea turtle to see. The primary swimming area is fairly shielded from the ocean so the waves are never too big, so it’s good for smaller kids. Absolutely worth your time!

reviews.title: Beautiful swimming beach with turtle and Monk Seals
reviews.text: We stayed near this beach and enjoyed walking, wading and swimming here. On the last day, we saw a monk seal and two turtles on the beach with two more turtles on the island. Lots of local families enjoying the beach. Clean grass and sand

reviews.title: Very crowded.
reviews.text: There wasn't much free space and the grounds are pretty worn down from all the use.  The surf was pretty high the day we were there, so the lifeguards had their hands full trying to keep everyone safe.

reviews.title: Mother Daughter Adventure
reviews.text: Very accessible beach. With beach chairs in hand we made our way to a nearby palm tree for the partial shade I was looking for. Hit the waves to cool off. Brought water shoes to cross rock areas to small island where we found a large turtle sunbathing. Brilliantly colored fish along the way. Clean restroom facility with enclosed changing area. Grassy areas and picnic tables nearby. Cool little store to grab water, candy and a sandwich.Went to Brennecke’s for Happy Hour.

reviews.title: Nice!
reviews.text: This is a nice family friendly beach with lifeguards on duty. We stayed nearby so we were able to walk right over. Lots of fish to see if you snorkel. If you go after sunset, you can see turtles relaxing on the beach.

reviews.title: Turtles
reviews.text: We went to this beach twice. The first time we snorkeled and enjoyed the sun. The second time it was quite windy with occasional rain showers and there was a bit of a rip current so we didn't snorkel as much. However we saw several turtles in resting from the high surf and also a monk seal!  A really nice beach with a lifeguard and usually good swimming.

reviews.title: The Beach With It All
reviews.text: Turtles, snorkeling, whales, monk seals, walking, sand for digging in, and lifeguards...what more could you ask for in a public access beach?

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Public and perfect. Walk between the beaches and enjoy the water. Safe to swim and fun to watch the surfers.

reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text: This is a great beach near Marriott Waiohai hotel. There is life guard as well. Good snorkeling area as well. Loved it

reviews.title: A definite favorite of ours.
reviews.text: We spent a lot of time here, walking, snorkeling, beaching.  Nice restrooms and wonderful showers.  Loved "doing" our beach thing here.

reviews.title: Great beach for snorkeling
reviews.text: The beach is known for snorkeling and it is a good place for that.   The parking is good especially if you arrive early, there are restaurants and stores across the street and the park has shaded picnic tables, restrooms, and lifeguards.  The fish are abundant and the water is shallow.  Recommend for snorkeling.

reviews.title: Waimea canyon
reviews.text: Great place to go. The drive up was great. Felt like a race course only slower. View outstanding, even when the clouds roll in. Go you won't regret it.

reviews.title: Great family beach
reviews.text: Easy fun snorkeling in shallow water.  Lots of fish, bot much coral.  Lovely sand. Probably not best for boogie boarding, wVes were too minimal.

reviews.title: Huge beach, crowded, & please leave the sea turtles alone!
reviews.text: Huge beach, very crowded, has lifeguards. We would recommend going early to get a good parking spot and a nice spot on the beach. Loads of sea turtles basking in the beach - but please LEAVE THEM ALONE!  We were so frustrated to see idiot tourists going up right next to them, petting them and even surrounding them blocking their return to the ocean. The lifeguards were directly in front of this; perhaps it is not their job to protect the poor sea turtles, so I had to ask people several times to PLEASE leave the sea turtles alone and to stop blocking their attempt to swim back into the ocean!

reviews.title: Nice Spot for Children to Enjoy the Water
reviews.text: This is what we call "baby beach".  There is a gentle protected shallow bay for kids to be able to play without the worry of waves.  This spot has gotten so much more crowded over the years.  Don't expect a quiet relaxing day at the beach!

reviews.title: Watched Sunset Here Every Night for a Week
reviews.text: I don't like to repeat things when I travel, but when things are this good, how could I not? Every evening at sunset, I would go to the beach with my kids, order shaved ice and (amazing) Kona Mud Pie ice cream, and drink a beer while watching the sunset--each unique, extraordinary.

reviews.title: The reviews are correct ! A fantastic beach- one if the best in Hawaii,!!!!
reviews.text: Lifeguard protected! Fine sand ,great for sunbathing!  lots of ocean frontage, reef protected, great for scuba and snorkel and swimming. Lots of ocean life - might even see humpbacks out in the deeper water. Lots of sun- worshippers, local and tourists. Nearby parking, nearby food. Come and stick an umbrella in the sand , park your cooler , swim, snorkel or whatever and enjoy life! The sun is intense, so bring the sunscreen.

reviews.title: Great place to watch the whales from the beach and relax!
reviews.text: This is a perfect beach for protected swimming and snorkeling and watching the whales from beach chairs.

reviews.title: Family Friendly
reviews.text: Fun place to take the family for some snorkeling.  It's a pretty beach that is clean and safe.  Some shade available. Parking available too.

reviews.title: Great beach with all you need to spend a day alone or with kids. And there are turtles!
reviews.text: My 7 and 10-year-olds enjoyed playing around the lava wall for crabs, fish and other creatures. They then spent hours playing in the waves and the sand. The beach has sheltered tables, great showers, and a changing room. It is also across from a nice restaurant and a bistro. Loved it! Some folks were also snorkeling, but we did not try it, so cannot say anything about that.

reviews.title: Calm waters
reviews.text: The water was nice and calm even though it was incredibly windy with a high surf warning at the time. The beach was a little crowded, but there was still plenty of space. Our toddler loved the playground next to the beach!

reviews.title: Poipu Beach is Kauai’s best all-around beach for tourists on the south shore.
reviews.text: Poipu Beach is Kauai’s best all-around beach for tourists on the south shore. Many would say the best beach overall (see photos). Nice wide and rather long beach with a grassy park next to it overlooking a beautiful post-card ocean scene. Because a reef protects it, normally the waves are small making it great for swimming, snorkeling, and safe for supervised kids. There is good parking and Brennecke’s is a nice restaurant there that also sells food, drinks, etc. for the beach. Try their smoothies – great. A better place for swimming at Kauai’s Poipu Beach due to fewer rocks is to the right (looking at ocean and before the Marriot). Do be careful because less doesn’t mean no rocks. Get some beach shoes and you can swim with much less worry. The best snorkeling is just to the right of the lifeguard station – you will probably see several other snorkelers right where you want to go.

reviews.title: Some of the best snorkeling in Hawaii
reviews.text: We visited Hawaii in December, so many of the northern beaches had waves too big for snorkeling.  Poipu Beach was the perfect alternative.  Great fish, good reef and excellent snorkeling.  Parking wasn't bad either!!

reviews.title: Good parking across the street
reviews.text: Ample Parking across the street and also at Brennecke’s Beach Broiler.  Some grass area and then beach.  Good people watching location.  Lots of people trying to snorkel in the cove and in deeper location.  It’s a little tricky trying to navigate the basalt getting-in-and-out of the water.

reviews.title: Baby beach
reviews.text: Great place with a sheltering break wall so the kids don’t get taken out by the waves. A little rocky but it’s still a great spot.

reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: Enjoyed this beach for sun bathing and snorkeling! Able to rent some chairs too. A couple of guys strolling the beach playing ukulele and small drum were entertaining.

reviews.title: Everything for everybody, young and old
reviews.text: This park is a jewel. While not huge it has a couple of lovely beaches for soaking up the sun AND many shady areas for not getting too much sun. It has both wading areas and waves that make for good body surfing. It has a lifeguard station and toilet facilities. As I said, fun for all ages (and conditions). The resident roosters are a hoot as well.

reviews.title: Little Gem of Poipu!
reviews.text: It's THE place to be - sunrise, daytime, or sunset! Great for kids, popular for snorkelers & SUP-ers, fun for just being in the sand & gentle surf. You can grab a drink & snacks from the Marriott bar, walk the paved beachwalk, and just relax.

reviews.title: Evening Walks!
reviews.text: Check out the sunsets and Poipu beach. You can hear luau is at all the different resorts and there are some fire pits people set up along the beach. Good fun.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Great beach and park, with easy snorkeling. Even on a bit of a rainy day, we had a good time. Grills and shelters are available for picnics. We saw a lot of cool ocean life, too!

reviews.title: Great craft fair
reviews.text: We went to a craft fair happening a Poipu Beach Park. It’s a nice park. Easy access to nearby hotels.

reviews.title: Kauai 2020
reviews.text: Raining in Princeville where we were staying so we headed for Poipu one day  in search of sun and found it! It was a bit windy but still nice. Small beach for Hawaii but a protected cove. The waves outside were a bit strong but the water on the left side of the cove were as still as a lake! Great spot for small children.

reviews.title: Snorkel Here all Day!
reviews.text: We just love everything about this area and this beach. We've met so many wonderful people from all parts of the world at it.  The snorkeling here is fun and easy. Not to mention, often times sea lions and sea turtles come on shore to nap. It's just lovely to see. Along with the beautiful sunsets. LOVE THIS BEACH

reviews.title: Our beach
reviews.text: We could walk from the Marriott so that was great. I brought my snorkel from home and the fish were amazing. I didnt even bother taking a snorkle trip as I saw so many fish just by stepping off the beach. Off the beach some 100 feet was a little island or sand bar that i swam out to and it was like i was away from the crowd even though there were other folks there checking it out

reviews.title: Popular
reviews.text: A very popular spot with locals and tourists. Safe swimming but parking was an issue. Some snorkeling in the bay and a fairly small sand area

reviews.title: Nice beach & snorkeling
reviews.text: We visited this beach multiple times, not only because it was close to where we stayed but also because we found it to be one of the most pleasant for snorkeling or just bobbing around in inflatable tubes.

reviews.title: Beautiful little gem on the Pacific.
reviews.text: Easy snorkel access at Poipu Beach Park. Lifeguards to ease any worry over your kids or even your own swim safety in the Pacific. Some wave and surf surge. Protected sandy beach with some limited coral growth. Numerous tropical fish, large and small, all colors, and a turtle beached itself the sunny day we were here. Chickens are abundant but not overwhelming. Good idea to take your own tent, chairs, towels and supplies. Surfers are off to the waves west the beach. Warm sun and dry beach even when it’s stormy on the north shore.

reviews.title: Clean and family friendly
reviews.text: We saw a turtle resting on the beach and most people were respectful of its space. The beach is extremely clean with beautiful golden sand. The snorkeling was relatively easy - we didn't see anything spectacular, but we did see a few colourful fish and an eel. The access into the water is easy. Good for beginner snorkelers and the water was not too rough when we went.

reviews.title: Very nice, Family friendly Beach
reviews.text: Within walking distance from several condo complexes & hotels in the area. Very nice family friendly beach with lifeguards, restrooms, rinse off showers, picnic tables & pavilions ( first come first serve) as well as a playground for the kids. Plenty of street parking & a parking lot across the street. Brenneckes deli also across the street for sandwiches & drinks to enjoy a picnic lunch. Saw a turtle sunning on the beach one day and lots of snorkelers with the calm surf. Very popular on the weekends, so get there early for your pick of spots !

reviews.title: Very nice beach for young children
reviews.text: This is the place to go if you want safe, secure and close to amenities.  It is crowded and unless you prefer to stay well within a comfort zone, there are better places to spend the day.  As an adventure couple, we walked in and promptly left going to Shipwreak instead.

reviews.title: Fun day out
reviews.text: Nice white sand beach right in  Poipu.Nice outing.Beautiful place to go and relax for a few hours.Very accessible .

reviews.title: Crowded and dirty
reviews.text: We have been to Poipu beach twice. Both times it was very crowded and dirty. If you go, bring some shade, there is not much shade to be had here. Good for snorkeling if you don’t mind the crowds. There are restrooms with changing rooms that are relatively clean considering the amount of use. We heard about Anini beach on the North Shore, and liked it much better.

reviews.title: Not really a beach
reviews.text: Worth driving to this part of the island but not worth a stop 'at the beach'. Very small and 20 people is too many, it was full. Water was rough and under floor was basalt and hurts when thrown onto it. Pleanty of other sights to see around there.

reviews.title: Nice but getting busy
reviews.text: We have gone to this beach now 4 times over the last 20 years and it continues to get more popular and crowded. This is a great beach in a good location but is losing its appeal as it gets more and more crowded. Still a great place if you have kids.

reviews.title: Kid friendly
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite spots for so many reasons. Probably the first is that it is child friendly with shallow wading area. Close to lodging and sometimes good for boogie boarding.

reviews.title: A Great Beach ... with parking!
reviews.text: We spent two days at this beach last week.  Nice sheltered area for little kids, lots of colorful fish to see while snorkeling in 2-6 ft of water, lifeguard on duty, washrooms and showers nearby.  We also saw green turtle and monk seal while there.  Recommended.

reviews.title: Beaches of Kauai
reviews.text: Loved all the beaches on south and west side of island. Not very crowed on the day we were there and waves were calm

reviews.title: Lots of turtles
reviews.text: Turtlemania.  We went there on our second day, liked the atmosphere and park.  On our third day we saw turtles resting on the beach.  Went back twice and saw more turtles.

reviews.title: Nice place to visit
reviews.text: Nice park with beach areas and rock areas.  Sea turtles and monk seals are common sights here.  Beautiful area.

reviews.title: Loved this beach
reviews.text: Be sure to pop by this beach for sunset - lovely view and a really nice spot to relax.  Not too busy. aLoved it.

reviews.title: Busy and beautiful
reviews.text: It’s a beach on the busy side. With all the hotels around, it’s understandable. We thought we might snorkel but felt like the water was a tad too cold to have an enjoyable experience. Saw a turtle which was really cool.

reviews.title: Beach Day Fun Day
reviews.text: There were 17 of us staying in 2 condos on Poipu. Ages ranging from 1-62! We all had a blast. Perfect beach for kids. Clean and safe. Bathroom facilities, picnic areas, playground, snorkeling, swimming without dangerous waves. Restaurant, small convenience store and beach shop right across the street. Perfect day in Poipu.

reviews.title: Amazing Sunset!
reviews.text: Went here on our first evening in Kauai and it did not disappoint.  The sunset was amazing but the seals were even better!  A mom and pup were sleeping on one side and a male on the other.  The caretakers had them roped off so no one could disrupt their slumber but lots of people were taking photos of them.  Beautiful sight.

reviews.title: Good and bad
reviews.text: Insanely crowded. Not good for swimming due to strong RIP tides, rocks, coral, and sea urchins. However, great for snorkeling. Saw 4 sea turtles and a monk seal.

reviews.title: Safe & Fun
reviews.text: Great beach for first time snorkeling.  Fish swim right next to you close to shore in 3 feet deep water and turtles can be seen just a little further out.

reviews.title: A gem
reviews.text: We had stopped for a “quick peek” at this beach and ended up staying over 4 hours. The beach was clean and beautiful, the snorkeling was fantastic and despite the crowds it didn’t feel crowded. The bonus of the day was the 3 turtles that swam up on the beach that we were able to view and admire. Tip: bring Kleenex or toilet paper as there was not any in the stalls.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, very crowded though
reviews.text: Poipu beach was said to be the best beach on Kauai. I would disagree with this. Although in the morning, it’s beauty truly is present, the amount of people that flood the beach make it a less desirable destination. It does have a nice beach bar with cocktails across the street however. In my opinion, the beaches on the north shore were far superior. If you do stay on the south side, check out the ocean kayak adventure as they will take you to beaches with monk seals that are truly beautiful.

reviews.title: Best Snorkeling
reviews.text: Best beach for snorkeling. Lots of fish and they are so use to people they swarm around your legs when standing and follow you when you are swimming. The water is clear and not very deep. The variety of fish was better than we've seen on other islands. There is a spot on one side that is the perfect kiddie pool. We didn't go there we snorkeled by the lifeguard stand. This is a must go to beach. Take a lunch and spend the day or there is a restaurant across the street.

reviews.title: Poipu Beach Park is Perfect
reviews.text: We enjoyed this spot so much we came back twice during our vacation. There were five sea turtles that came up on the beach and two monk seals were also nearby. There is a lifeguard on duty which was comforting as the currents were wild. We saw them go out on a rescue with snorkelers that went way too far out and couldn’t get back. Snorkeling was good and there are restrooms with a changing room for your convenience. It was a definite highlight for us.

reviews.title: Watch for Rip Tides
reviews.text: My husband and I wanted to do some snorkeling during our January vacation to Kauai  and were told Poipu beach was the place but the life guard warned us about dangerous rip tides so we didn't go into the water.  Parking is limited so go early if you want a spot.

reviews.title: Fantastic Fireworks
reviews.text: What a great place from which to view New Year's Eve fireworks. An excellent white sand beach that is an easy walk from many condos and hotels.

reviews.title: If you’re looking for turtles...
reviews.text: My daughter wanted to swim with turtles so badly-we asked the locals and were told Poipu Beach would be our best bet. It didn’t disappoint-we swam for about an hour, thinking we wouldn’t have any luck. But my daughter jumped up in surprise when one swam right next to her. She quickly put her head back down and swam side by side. It was great!! It is a very beach, so just plan for it.

reviews.title: Hawaiian Christmas
reviews.text: This beach was walking distance from the home we rented. Great surf and lots of sand. Grandchildren had awesome time on their bougy boards.

reviews.title: Something for everyone
reviews.text: We love the views from Poipu Beach Park during the day, and like seeing the turtles come in at night. It’s great that Kauai has saved this big piece of land next to some of the best beaches in the world so that everyone can enjoy it.

reviews.title: Great beach nice park
reviews.text: This is a great park and beach for families.  It does great crowded and parking can be a bit of a challenge.   We always have parked creatively and never received a ticket.  Nice aloha spirit.  Watch for monk seals.  They can be found sunning on the beach.

reviews.title: Busy beach
reviews.text: When we visited, it was a cloudy, blustery day and a little cold. Holy this beach was still jam packed so I can't imagine how busy it would be on a warm sunny day. The sand was really soft and there is a place where littler kids could play in the ocean without risk and some people with snorkel gear lolling about. Past that little inlet, looked quite choppy on the day we were there but there was a crazy weather storm just ending so I'm not sure if it's always like that. I'm glad we saw Poipu beach but I probably wouldn't go back.

reviews.title: Never Miss this Spot in Kauai Island, definitely a must-see
reviews.text: When we were at Kauai Island, we stayed at Lihue near Kalapki beach. Poipu Beach, being close to where we were at was a destination people were telling us we must see, but I was quite hesitant at first since they say this place wasn't for beginner snorkelers. Being an cautious intermediate snorkeler, we checked the place out. Man, I am so glad we did!Laying around the beach were five Hawaiian Green Sea turtles laying on the beach, basking under the sun. They were definitely a sight to behold. It is illegal to touch them and they are protected by federal laws. These majestic creatures in the wild were a definite reason to check this place out. There was also a Hawaiian Monk seal just relaxing there on the sand, with stakes poled on the sand with rope to keep people away. The park wasn't very crowded being a popular tourist destination. And they had good amenities like a shower outside and a bathroom. The snorkeling bay was pretty decent, though I personally think there are more underwater life at Hanauma Bay. But the water was really clear, and much marine life to be seen. Just be careful with some sharp rocks that could injure your toes if you don't have water shoes. The variety of fish and other creatures are really plenty. I almost had the chance to swim alongside a turtle, if I was just fast enough to put on my snorkel gear and cross the rocky terrain to the water. Overall, I recommend this place to any Kauai visitor.And IT IS ALL FREE!! YOU READ IT RIGHT, NO CHARGE!

reviews.title: Great beach for views
reviews.text: We went to the Poipu Beach for sunset a couple of times during sunset and sunrise during December. There was a good number of people on the beach each time, but you could find a good angle or two to get good photos.  The beach is clean. People come here for swimming, snorkeling, surfing, and body boarding. The sand is a little rough, but nice otherwise. There is a good-sized parking lot, some picnic tables, and a water shower for cleaning off sand. We were there 4 times during the same week and saw turtles AND monk seals on the beach each time. Most times, there was someone on the beach that defined a "do not cross" line to keep people from getting too close. There was also a lifeguard on duty.

reviews.title: Ordinary beach
reviews.text: An ordinary beach with strong currents and dangerous shorebreaks(dec) there was also some jellyfish there when we visited. There is a lifeguard on duty, toilets, Picnic tables, playground for children. The snorkeling area is very small but ok.

reviews.title: Small and crowded
reviews.text: This beach is very small, a bit dirty and overcrowded.  The only real highlight was the sleeping endangered monk seal who was resting on the beach and being watched by a volunteer.  The bathroom was filthy.

reviews.title: It was like swimming in a fish tank - amazing
reviews.text: We loved Poipu and I picked our accommodation due to its closeness to this beach.  You only had to get in knee deep and pop your head under and you saw the colourful fish.  It truly was like swimming in a fish tank.  Really safe for the inexperienced snorkeller as you can touch the bottom for quite a way out and not miss a thing with life guards over head.  Water shoes or flippers are a must as its rocky, but hey thats why the fish are there.  Take fish food too, its awesome watching them come charging at you.

reviews.title: A lot of nature in a small space
reviews.text: In less than 2 hours at this relatively small beach we saw a sea turtle, three monk seals sunning themselves, and countless tropical fish of all shapes and sizes. Wear water shoes as it's a bit rocky in places.

reviews.title: Another great little beach in Kauai
reviews.text: We hit many beaches during this trip to Hawaii - Poipu may have been up there among our favorites with Hamauna Bay in Oahu and Hanalei beach in Hanalei.  Poipu has plenty of parking in the 2 lots across the street.  It's relatively protected from the surf which makes swimming and snorkeling safe.  There are also 2 lifeguard stations so you can have a good time safely.  The sand is not the best we've ever seen but it was nice nonetheless.  The park has a couple bathrooms (the one by the front pathway was dirtier, the one closer to the Brenecke Beach Boiler was cleaner and had soap).  There's an outdoor shower to help rinse the sand off of you.  As you walk along the beach heading west, you'll see some of the resorts that are right on the beach.  We also saw turtles and sea lions on the beach.  Turtles tend to come out en masse at night but we were lucky enough to see one during the day and 2 during the twilight hours.  The sea lion also came on shore during the day.  Be mindful of them and give them their space - don't be one of those stupid tourists who walk right up to the turtles to take selfies.  Some of them are tired or even injured and are looking to recover or to get rest.  We also were lucky enough to see a glorious sunset the second night we were in Poipu (pic of that attached).  Additional but not personally verified tip - I overheard one couple say snorkeling was clear and they saw a lot of fish.

reviews.title: Beautiful, safe, family-friendly beach
reviews.text: Poipu Beach Park is a beautiful beach. The grassy park has play equipment, tables, restrooms and outdoor showers for removing salt and sand.  The bay itself is protected, so calm and safe for swimming, especially with life guards present, and great for snorkling; I saw a variety of colorful fish and an eel.  We also saw sea turtles sunning themselves on the beach. Overall, a great experience!

reviews.title: Great beach for family and snorkeling
reviews.text: Found this on our last day. While all beaches on the island are great, this was a great find. Cool park with picnic tables, food across street.

reviews.title: Spectacular beach—Poipu
reviews.text: Poipu Beach is the most amazing g beach with its spectacular views!! Poipu is a family friendly beach for all to enjoy the water.  I have a 11 and 9 year old boys. They enjoy boogie boarding and jumping the waves!!Take timeout of you trip to visit Poipu Beach!! It is a must!!

reviews.title: Turtles and seal on the beach
reviews.text: So neat to see a seal resting on the uncrowded beach.  A limitless further down the beach, the turtles come into the beach at night.  They are protected by ropes so people don’t disturb them.  Volunteers are there to tell you about the sea life.

reviews.title: I COULDN'T BELIEVE IT
reviews.text: Going just to see what the beach was,as we were anticipating to go for snorkeling there a few days later.What we saw was unbelievable,Green Sea Turtles,and Monk Seals between the people.The animals just seem to go through their daily lives amongst the swimmers without any stress.The beach itself has various pools there to snorkel.

reviews.title: Nice but crowded
reviews.text: A good overall beach area but typically crowded.  I suggest trying a few of the other smaller beaches up and down the coast.  Plenty of parking available here as well as chair/umbrella rentals.

reviews.title: People beach
reviews.text: It's crowded by Kauai standards.  I like Kauai's beaches because there are not a lot of people, so this is not one of my favorites.  That said, it's a nice beach that's great for families and close to restaurants.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Good beach it is crowded and too sunny,  need to go in the evenings when its pass 4.30, washrooms is available.

reviews.title: MUST GO TO POIPU BEACH
reviews.text: This is a must go to beach. Amazing clear, warm,  beautiful water. I typically don’t swim in the ocean but this beach is way to inviting. Perfect for snorkeling and kids. We had a blast with our granddaughters.

reviews.title: Beautiful place to enjoy the beach
reviews.text: Really a beautiful beach. The only issue is everyone else knows it's beautiful. We've been there twice and both times it was really crowded. It is a protected water playground, but waves are still about 1 - 2 feet high. It's worth the time and drive, but don't expect a quiet, lone, romantic time.

reviews.title: Family Favorite
reviews.text: Best beach experience for us. The calm waves were so nice for my 2 year old granddaughter to play and have fun. The adults enjoyed the beautiful fish swimming around us. The water is so clear and calm that you could just stand in the water and see all the beautiful brightly colored fish swimming around you! We used our snorkel gear and it just took our breath away. We seen the sea turtles up close because they came up on the beach. Also, we seen the seals everyday as they lay on the beach soaking up the sun. One evening on the beach there were 8 or 10 sea turtles laying on the beach for our enjoyment. We had so much fun just watching the seals, turtles, and dolphins. Amazing to be that close to them in their natural environment. Great beach for the entire family guaranteed! Don’t forget to bring your Go Pro because the snorkeling videos are amazing in this clear water. A+ adventure

reviews.title: Great Family Beach
reviews.text: Sandy, easy for kids, lots of seals and turtles to watch also.  Tuesday, Thursdays and Saturdays they also have Water Aerobics in the ocean to the north, it is free and taught by a nice lady called Charlotte.  Lifeguard is a nice bonus here also.

reviews.title: Great swimming and snorkeling
reviews.text: This is an amazing beach!  Worth the walk, drive or however you get there! Lots of fish to look at! Don't forget about to ask about the turtles!

reviews.title: Morning Swim
reviews.text: Due to our packed travel schedule, we only have the chance to swim here in the morning. We were glad we did it!

reviews.title: Poipu
reviews.text: Gorgeous but small beach...Sheraton hotel is right here but skip it..horrible service all around except the valet folks.

reviews.title: Beach never disappoints
reviews.text: Went on our second day in Kauai as the north was overcast. Spent the day listening to the beautiful waves. Today a Male monk seal was sunning on the beach a sight to see and later a female also showed up. Also a huge turtle was in the area to see. Would never miss this beach if visiting the island.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful and really clear.  Having been around the island, I think this is definitely the best beach.

reviews.title: Favorite Beach In Hawaii - Great Location - Sea Turtles - Beautiful Sunset - FUN
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with great shallow water near the shore and deep water further out.  The scenery is amazing and there are lots of locations for picnics or just hanging out at the beach. At the end of the day, sea turtles exit the water and land on the beach for an evening nap. So much fun watching them swim in to shore! On most recent visit, there were 7 sea turtles by the time darkness had set in. Great for pictures, and everyone was being respectful and not touching or bothering the turtles. Lots of fun in the sun!

reviews.title: Too nice
reviews.text: This is a great beach, nice sand, calm water, lifeguards.  And that's its problem.  It's too popular and crowded.  We prefer the more expansive beaches up north.

reviews.title: Turtles!!
reviews.text: Great spot to walk to. We saw at least 6 huge sleeping Hawaiian Green Sea Turtles which was awesome and mesmerizing! Beautiful bay with a great park area to have a picnic at right next to it. Definitely a perfect spot to spend a day!

reviews.title: Loved the beach! And would return over and over again.
reviews.text: Our family loved this beach. There is something for everyone here. Small children area with minimal waves. Great snorkeling area. My 9 year old loved seeing the fish. On the other side of the beach, there are bigger waves for boogie board surfing. And there were people surfing in the distance. This area was our favourite. We also saw turtles and monk seals too on the beach. So amazing!

reviews.title: Nice spot to take your lunch and enjoy the waves
reviews.text: We grabbed a shave ice and sit and enjoy the view. Soaking up the sun here was one of our favorite lunches!

reviews.title: Busy place
reviews.text: Pretty beach with a lifeguard but with two parking lots and a protected lagoon it's a little too crowded for my taste. However I would definitely say make a stop here because it was the only place we saw monk seals during our entire stay in Kauai. Plus it's a Southside Beach so more than likely it's going to be dryer then the other areas that might be raining during your visit.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling!
reviews.text: We came here in the afternoon and the snorkeling was awesome. Tons of fish and pretty shallow cove. Lots of other snorkelers which helped us feel safe.

reviews.title: So Much to See
reviews.text: This beach is always a great visit. There is a ton of activity and the turtles arriving at sunset is now a must do with the grands each year. The play park is perfect for small children and the beach is sandy and calm. Go any time of day and enjoy, walk, swim, play and see the sights.

reviews.title: Sunny spot!
reviews.text: We went to the beach when it was raining on the east side. Poipu gets the least amount of rain on the island. It was beautiful weather!! The beach was full including a sleeping Hawaiian Monk Seal who was enjoying his nap. The water was rocky so we went further down where it was less so. Floating on the waves was excellent and so relaxing. There was a private house facing the beach that we were salivating for. Lol! But then you would always have a crowd of people just outside your yard. By the time we left there was a total of 3 seals on the beach taking a siesta. What a sight and remarkable that Hawai’i has created a system where people and wildlife can coexist.

reviews.title: One of our favorite beaches.
reviews.text: This beach has it all - a swimming area protected from the big waves, waves off to the side, a "sandbar" area that you can walk or swim to and fantastic snorkeling and reef viewing. As you walk to the sandbar, 100s of tropical fish surround you and many follow along.

reviews.title: Snorkeling rocks
reviews.text: Grab a mask and snorkel and dive in! Fish are friendly and abundant. Plus there’s a resident monk seal hanging out close by.

reviews.title: it aint hanalei bay, but the honu's make it close....!
reviews.text: a great snorkel spot, especially when its raining in the north,  easy waters, lots of humunuku's and other fishies, small but playful atmosphere, and the honu's (big sea turtles) come out to warm themselves on the beach, as long as we dont bother them!  .

reviews.title: Ahhh, the Pacific!
reviews.text: Popular beach with visitors and locals. The surf was running quite high the entire time we were here so lots of surfers, but a bit too much wave for a relaxed swim. Guess I'm too old😁

reviews.title: Poipu Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sand beach with lots of great restaurants and resorts all along Poipu. Great for swimming, long walks, great food and drinks.

reviews.title: Snorkeling better than expected
reviews.text: The cove looked small and dark, and I did not have high expectations for snorkeling. However, I was able to see a lot of fish and felt very safe in the protected cove. Unfortunately I did not see turtles or seals the day I was there. Free parking, beach rentals across the street & easy access.

reviews.title: Great beach for people and sea animal watching
reviews.text: A great public beach with easy access and cool spots on the beach to park it for the day. Lots of rocks in the water close to the shore create fun little rock pools that are great from kids to explore. Lots of good people watching, but also saw some Hawaiian monk seals and sea turtles cruising around in the surf not too far from the people!  A very special and exciting thing to see! A busy beach, and it tends to get quite crowded in the hottest part of the day. Lifeguards on this beach, so a good place to go with kids and feel safe.

reviews.title: Wildlife
reviews.text: This park is the place to visit for a great sunset photo or if you have children for a swim. Plenty of fish to see whilst snorkelling. We went for daily walks along the beach and saw turtles basking in the sun and a monk seal arrived on shore one day. Plenty of parking and it is a sandy beach

reviews.title: Best Beach to see Turtles and Monk Seals
reviews.text: Small to Medium size beach on the south side of the island.  Turtles and Monk Seals like to sun themselves in the afternoon on the beach of this reef protected beach.  Some of the waters are very shallow and calm for small children, HOWEVER, bring their water shoes because small rocks and broken coral are EVERYWHERE.  The beach is soft golden sand with restrooms and covered tables available.  This was our # 2 beach on the island behind Salt Pond Beach Park where the snorkeling is just Incredible.

reviews.title: Nice snorkeling
reviews.text: The relatively free of surge beach and a location with a long sand approach makes it easy even for novices to enter the water.  Nice place just to lay in float tubes and just relax while watching nearby surfers, too.

reviews.title: Best Beach In Kauai?
reviews.text: This is up there as possibly one of the best beaches in Kauai.  There are many beaches you can't swim at, but here you can on most days.

reviews.title: Sunset perfection
reviews.text: Not all beaches are good for snorkeling but this one was the best that we visited. Safe for kids and easy to snorkel there, the other beaches were very difficult with the undercurrents. We stayed for the sunset and it was amazing. The life guard says that early in the morning when the sun rises you will most likely see sea turtles warming in the sun. We did see some swimming in the deep water beyond the reef with the help of a big camera lens. We were staying in Princeville so we weren't able to see them on the beach.

reviews.title: Best Beach ever!
reviews.text: We love this beach,  we swim and snorkel here every couple of days when we visit Kauai.  It is safe, there are 2 life guard stations.  We typically swim and snorkel in front of the Marriott.  We see beached monk seals almost every time we are there.  There's plenty of fish to see and variety of fish is really good,  humu's, wrasse's, moorish idol's,  puffer fish, trigger fish, tang's trumpet fish and more, we have occasionally seen turtles and eels. The waves are sometimes a little large but it's usually pretty easy to get in the water.  There's also covered table area's if your spending the day and bathrooms and showers as well. There's lots of free parking.

reviews.title: Small Scenic South-shore Beach
reviews.text: This beach was much smaller than I thought it would be. There is a sand spit that you can walk out to a little rocky island. We saw a monk seal and turtles here up close. Lots of people were snorkelling and there is a part of the beach that is protected from the waves by a rock wall, which is good for swimming. There are life guards here and it is rather busy. If you want to swim and snorkel amongst the crowds, then this is the perfect place for you. If you want secluded sunbathing, then find another beach.

reviews.title: Best Winter Snorkeling
reviews.text: Lots of people don't realize it but the surf and swell conditions vary greatly from summer to winter on Kauai.  In the summer, the north shore is the best hands down for snorkeling but in the winter you have to head to Poipu Beach for easy entry and perfect conditions.  We tried out other nearby locations like Koloa Landing and Spouting Horn but getting in and out was too challenging.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling!
reviews.text: Beautifully maintained public beach with life guards, picnic pavilions, and restrooms.  There is a very shallow, calm area perfect for families with young children.  Rent some snorkeling equipment across the street for a very reasonable price.  There were many fish to see in a concentrated area.  The only issue is there is no good place to really swim, as the bottom is rocky and, at some points, barely deep enough to snorkel.  Regardless, we had an awesome time.  There is a boogie boarding beach right next door.  Be sure to visit at night to see the green sea turtles that are on the beach resting.  We saw 15 one night!

reviews.title: Favorite beach
reviews.text: This is by far our go to place in Kauai. Since we had a 5 months old baby with us the beach is perfect. Due to the reef protecting even babies can go in the water. Every time we went we saw a monk seal or turtle which is amazing

reviews.title: Great Snorkeling - Wear Water Shoes!
reviews.text: My husband and I decided to stop at Poipu Beach because we heard it was one of the best beaches on Kauai, which definitely proved to be true. Parking is ample and free. We rented snorkel gear from Nukumoi Surf Shop just down the street past Brennecke's Beach Broiler. The snorkel gear only cost $15 total for a full day rental.Poipu Beach is a lifeguarded beach, which makes it very popular with families. The snorkeling was amazing. You didn't even need snorkel gear to see some of the fish! The water is very clear. The waves were a little rough, but that's to be expected in late October. Just a word of warning - wear water shoes. A wave knocked me into some coral and I got a few pretty deep cuts - one on the bottom of my foot. I didn't realize how bad it was until I got out of the water and it required medical attention. So, do yourself a favor and just wear water shoes!

reviews.title: Tons of Turtles
reviews.text: Great beach to visit at sunset! Beautiful beach to watch the sunset AND tons of turtles start coming up on the beach to sleep. So cool!

reviews.title: Seals
reviews.text: Love Poipu beach. Every year there are seals. This year they are funny! One spitting sand at the other. This beach is always clean and clear. Great snorkeling and sand.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: With plenty of options of beaches on Kauai we seem to enjoy the perfect sunsets at Poipu beach more. The location is beautiful, lots of people sitting and enjoying and it’s quite lively. Plenty of restaurants and bars around with beautiful views as well. Definitely a nice beach and area to visit.

reviews.title: Best Family Beach
reviews.text: We have been coming to Poipu for 20 years. We greatly enjoy the snorkeling at Poipu Beach Park. There is a great children’s beach here. Be sure to get some fish food (available across the street at Nukomoi’s). See sleeping sea turtles on the beach in the early morning. Monk seals often rest here as well. Be sure not to disturb the seals or turtles.

reviews.title: Loved seeing lots of fish but very rocky here
reviews.text: Lots of different kinds of fish and nice to see a more than one or two together. However this is very rocky shallow water and I saw more than one child snorkeling with scrapes on their shins from the rocks that are just below the surface. There is an area on the left that is all sand but when the tide went out people stood ankle deep (nice for the little ones though).  Lucky enough to see a monk seal (of course I didn’t have my camera but didn’t see any turtles which I was hoping to). Found some shade, stayed for sunset, got a picture of a full rainbow. All in all a pleasant day.

reviews.title: Day at the beach
reviews.text: This beach is so beautiful and a great place to spend the day. This beach also has a shallow spot for younger swimmers and good place to snorkel. Across from the beach is a restaurant, shower and wash off the sand.

reviews.title: Good swimming beach
reviews.text: A good, relatively safe swimming beach. Lots of turtles to see if you go later in the day, but if they're out at night, please don't shine lights on them, it hurts their eyes.

reviews.title: Poipu!
reviews.text: Went to Poipu as the sun was setting. We were told the titles come in. We did se a sea turtle but then got a surprise. Just a little further down the beach a monk seal had come in to sleep. Had a great time   Didn’t swim there but others were swimming and snorkeling.

reviews.title: Amazing for snorkeling
reviews.text: Safe beach with life guards and bathrooms. Excellent for families and beginner snorkeling. So many variety of fish in water less than 2 ft deep! Free parking.  Best beach for safety, easy water entry and snorkeling! Bring water shoes there are rocks.

reviews.title: Watched the Sunset from here. Bonus Turtles to the beach after Sunset
reviews.text: Watched the Sunset from here. Didn't swim but looked to be great place to do so. To the west a number of surfers were riding the waves. And a seal attempted to come up on the beach but was scared away by the people who rushed to it.
