Another bonus was after the sunset about 6 turtles of various sizes either beached themselves or were in the process of doing so.

reviews.title: Mainly a shallow pond area.
reviews.text: The beach is nice, (all of them are on the island).  It doesn't compare to the beaches in the North Shore.  Mainly a giant kiddy pool.  Very shallow but has a good amount of fish to see if snorkeling.  They say a lot of turtles are around but didn't see any.  Was crowded with kids and adults in the water.

reviews.title: Great place to snorkel
reviews.text: Most beaches in kauai are very rough and have dangerous rip tides. Poipu beach is blocked off by rocks and is good for swimming and snorkelling. Sand Turtles can been seen here to.

reviews.title: Great for snorkeling, beware of the shallow whater tough
reviews.text: Good beach park in the south shore of Kauai. Poipu beach is good for snorkeling, especially for kids, because of the shallow water. However, you should also pay attention, because you can also easily cut yourself on the reefs. There is quite a variety of different fish.Recommended

reviews.title: Has everything
reviews.text: Great parking....sandy beach....lava area of beach....pavilions...restrooms....etc  I actually went to this beach twice since if you are coming off the main road across southern Kauai, you approach it through the Tunnel of Trees road.  Also, it is only 30 minutes or so from Lihue.

reviews.title: A great spot for snorkling
reviews.text: Definitely rent an umbrella and snorkel equipment before heading to this beach. Very easy snorkeling on one side and swimming on the other. Also a great place to spot (from a distance of course!) turtles and a monk seal in the morning.

reviews.title: Sea Turtles and a great beach!
reviews.text: This beach was clean and family oriented! The water is perfect and the scenery can't be beat...I mean...you're in Kauai!! This was walking distance from where we stayed so very convenient.

reviews.title: A little something for everyone
reviews.text: This park offers soft, warm sand that embraces water suitable for young waders and swimmers to casual snorkelers, to more adventurous types who venture past the jetty. Marine life is plentiful, as sea turtles frequent the beach from sunset to sunrise, and are often joined by Monk seals, looking for a respite in the warm sand. On occasion, Spinner dolphins might also be spotted just to the north off Brennecke’s Beach, jumping and playing in the surf. Snorkelers are treated to a plethora of colorful tropical fish, sea cucumbers, and other aquatic life in water calm and shallow enough for beginners, yet enticing enough for the advanced explorer. Just south of this cove, known as “Kiddie Pond”, breakers create playground for surfers and boogie-boarders alike. Lifeguards are on station at 9 AM. Several picnic tables are available, but may not be shaded, as the palm trees do not provide much sun block. A “sand shower”, for rinsing the beach from your feet, is located near the restrooms. Be aware, soap and paper towels appear to be a rarity in the restrooms. If you have questions about the seals and turtles resting on the shore, ask one the volunteers. They help provide a safe space for the marine residents, and I found them to be gracious and willing to answer my questions. Don’t forget to stay for the sunset! You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.title: Great local beach
reviews.text: This by far is one of the nicest beaches on Kauai, it's definitely perfect for a family with kids.  It offers a bay type beach without breakers to knock people over, while on the other side there is a bit of a shore break to play around in  Lots of sea life to experience along with a peninsula that gets visited by turtles, monk seals and other arbitrary sea life.

reviews.title: Ok public beach
reviews.text: This was the busiest beach we have been to in Kauai so far.  Not very scenic as it’s crowded and surrounded by buildings. Calm area for swimming and easy snorkeling. Fair amount of fish but nothing dramatic.

reviews.title: Definitely Worth the Trip to Poipu
reviews.text: Poipu Beach Park is considered to be a “Top 10 Beach” in Kauai on multiple websites and in numerous publications, and deservedly so!  The snorkeling and swimming are magnificent due to the reef which keeps the water calm, also making this the perfect beach for children.  And...for added safety, there are two life guarding stations.  We were able to wade out to the sandbar and explore the numerous tide pools teeming with ocean life.  If you go to one beach on Kauai, Poipu Beach Park is the one for you.

reviews.title: Poipu Beach
reviews.text: Out of all the beaches I visited in Kauai this was the most touristy.  It has all the amenities including good restaurants and bars. The mainly sandy beach west of the parking area (in front of the Radison resort) was best for swimming while the beach in front of the parking was fair for snorkelling with the sea bed being mostly coral.  The beaches are largely protected from the surf by a reef so good for families.  There is a narrow, shallow, stretch of sandy beach running from the shore to a small island about 100 ft off shore where can be found Turtles and Monk Seals.  The day I was there, I saw four Monk seals asleep with wildlife watch volunteers having the are roped off to protect the seals.  If you want a family style beach then this is a good option.

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: Free parking across the street.  Choose sand or grass to sit on. Many options for shade. Picnic tables, bathrooms,  showers to rinse sand and saltwater.  Decent snorkeling.  Warm water. Store across the street to purchase drinks and snacks. The day we visited,  a couple  sea turtles  came ashore for a nap.

reviews.title: Great Beach to take the Family
reviews.text: I love Poipu, and the beach is an awesome spot to take the family. It is ideal for snorkeling, swimming and skimming. The area is scenic, clean and lots of fun. Visitors will also have an opportunity to see monk seal(s) napping on the beach!!!

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Protected area for kids. Waves for adventurous.  OK snorkeling close to shore. What more could you want in a beach. Yes there are showers and restrooms. There are life guards. A Delia, good restaurant, deli, and beach gear rentals steps away.  It secluded but everything else is there

reviews.title: Family friendly beach
reviews.text: It was a breezy day but the water was warm. There were two seals to see at about noon! And adult on the main beach and a baby on the sand bank a short swim away. Someone shared their fish food with us to attract schools of fish to delight the kids. About half the beach is sand and the other coral and rocks which is best snorkelled over. We liked having the grassy areas nearby, fresh water showers and lifeguard service. There was enough parking when we went also.

reviews.title: Sea Turtles Delight
reviews.text: Great experience here. Lots of fish, clear blue water, and of course, saw a couple sea turtles during an early morning swim. Great beach to lounge but so much to look at and see.

reviews.title: Awesome beach!
reviews.text: One of many great beaches on the south side of Kauai, Poipu is a great place to swim, bodysurf and snorkel.  The adjoining park is also a great place to have a picnic.  Last time we visited we saw a monk seal lazing on the beach. Sunsets are beautiful too!

reviews.title: Go at sunrise
reviews.text: If you go early, like 5:45 Hawaii time, you’ll see the sunrise and loads of sea turtles on the beach. Don’t bug them, just observe them before they crawl back into the water when the sun comes up.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling
reviews.text: Visited here twice the week we were in Kauai. Snorkeling is great. Protected bay with lifeguards. Saw lots of colorful fish. Easy access to the water.

reviews.title: Decent beach
reviews.text: Nice beach but does get crowded.  Not an enormous amount of sand but it does have a lifeguard and shower with good restrooms.  Sand is fairly soft

reviews.title: Busy and beautiful!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Snorkeling can be good or just okay. Good and safe area for little ones to enjoy the water. Seals and turtles frequent the beach which is fun. Downside is beach can be very busy (nothing like Waikiki) but busier than others in Kauai.

reviews.title: This is hands down the best snorkeling...
reviews.text: ...location. Amazing tropical fish among the swimmers and shallow water. We returned several times to this location! Beautiful snorkeling!!! Lifeguards, restrooms, wash off stations, seating. A+ for Poipu!

reviews.title: Must see
reviews.text: Great park with beautiful beach where early in the morning the sea turtles and seals come onto the beach to rest and sun themselves.  Great for snorkling with gear available right across the street. Beautiful scenery but don't forget about the chickens

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, great for kids!
reviews.text: Very clean and calm beach, ideal place for families. Also marine life seems to like it as we saw a turtle and a seal resting on the beach right next to the snorklers and swimmers. Not a lot of natural shade though so you have to bring your own umbrella if travelling with kids.

reviews.title: Beauty with adventure, great snorkling
reviews.text: In the summer the south poipu side can be a bit rough, so check with locals.  Snorkling was amazing--not just fish but a sea turtle swimming right beside you.  Also a monk seal sunning on the beach.  Not overcrowded, and two lifeguards make it a safe, fun time for the family.  Gorgeous! Can shower off the sand and salt, too.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is one of our favorite beaches. We always see turtles and on occasion a monk seal. Great place to snorkel and people watch.

reviews.title: You can do just about anything you want at Poipu Beach Park
reviews.text: We rented a house just around the corner from Poipu Beach Park. We were there in August for 2 weeks. Moderate and sometimes busy crowds populate the beach area most days from about 11am to 4pm, Not as crowded early or late.. Large parking area with direct access to beach. Large grassy area with picnic shelters and restrooms behind beach and restaurants within a short walk. 2 low rise hotels at the west end of the park. The beachfront is good sized and there are reef protected areas good for snorkeling. Bring your water shoes as the swimming areas are a mix of rocks, coral and sand. Although the coral is mostly bleached there is quite a variety of fish. Also large turtles and occasional monk seals visit the beach areas.Lifeguards protect the beach most days. There is interesting topography, with an small sand and lava rock island a short "wade" offshore. Just outside the reef there are popular surf spots ( Get oriented at the beach road surf shop.). On the east side of the beach there is a shallow area protected from waves great for families with small children. Nearby is a playground. Just east is Brennecke's Beach which is great for the very adventurous boogie boarder.. Of interest up the road from the beach is a large archaeological site. There are markers explaining the centuries of local history under investigation. We found Poipu Beach to be a great vacation spot. It is on the dry side of Kauai. Most of the time when it was raining elsewhere on the island it was sunny at Poipu beach! Oh I can't forget to mention the fabulous sunsets!

reviews.title: Snorkeling hot spot
reviews.text: This beach was literally a 10 minute walk from where we stayed.  It's also a great spot for seeing lots of fish while snorkeling!  It doesn't disappoint on that front. Bring your underwater camera for sure.  It also has a large lawn area and lifeguards.  There is a tidepool that's perfect for the kiddos.  But because of all these factors it can also get a little busy.  Although the beach is sandy, the swimming area has  a rocky bottom, we found that we would wear our water shoes into the water while snorkeling.

reviews.title: Another beautiful beach
reviews.text: Though the water is pretty here and if you stay close to the break water barrier the water is nice to be in. But if you go west just a little there is an spit of sand that makes the water collide with the other current. Lots of people were in it but it looked so dangerous. We were there later in the afternoon an it was packed. With so many places to access the water this would not be one I would recommend.

reviews.title: Nice beach but crowded
reviews.text: Nice beach but crowded. Go early and beat the crowds.Rip tide in front of lifeguard house so read the signs and avoid it.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We visited Poipu Beach 3 times during our week long stay. First visit was good, decent snorkeling for being in a small area. Second visit it was too windy and couldn’t see much while snorkeling, was also pretty wavy. Then we came back in the evening to see the turtles come ashore which was amazing and also sad. So many tourists get so close to them as they’re trying to get up onto the shore that they block the pathway of the turtle. We also saw a lot of people getting way too close for photos. There were signs up but clearly were being ignored. One lady who I’m assuming was local to the area began asking people to back up, explaining that if the turtles don’t like the environment with all the people getting close that they will stop going to that beach.

reviews.title: Waimea Canyon
reviews.text: Breath taking.  There were so many different colors all in one place.  You could see waterfalls from the lookout points.

reviews.title: Little small, but nice
reviews.text: Great little beach, but it is on the smaller side. Massive turtle was on the beach when we were there which was very neat to see.

reviews.title: Best beach we visited
reviews.text: This beach is ridiculously sunny.  Definitely busier than other beaches.  The swimmable area of the beach is on the smaller side, so it seems crowded when everyone crams in that one area.  However, the sand part of the beach is plenty big for everyone to spread out.  Blazing sun, which I loved!

reviews.title: Really nice beach!
reviews.text: A little more crowded compared to Salt Pond Park, but still worth checking out. There’s a cool sand bar you can swim out to and walk on. Bring snorkeling gear!

reviews.title: Great Beach with Fantastic Ocean Aqua Class
reviews.text: Love this beach which has lovely soft sand and great for swimming. Very clean and water is so clear. Always take part in the fantastic ocean aqua class which is free of charge and courtesy of Charlotte who kindly runs this class. It is a great class which gives you a great workout. I think this is one of a kind and have never heard of another ocean aqua class in the world.

reviews.title: Super nice!
reviews.text: There are clean bathrooms and a life guard on duty. There were two sea turtles resting on the beach. That was fun to see. They took time to post signs to keep your distance because they are protected. This beach was great for kids and was quite protected from the main surge of the ocean. Nice sandy beaches with plenty of room for everyone. Nice!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We were here when the winds were high so the ocean was pretty rough. The beach is beautiful! There is a life guard so it’s one of the safer places to swim.

reviews.title: Great Snorkeling
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful! Great snorkeling, cool little island you can walk to and perfect for kids. the waves were not too big and the restrooms were close

reviews.title: Mother Daughter trip
reviews.text: We stayed 3 days in Poipu/Kola.  The sunsets were wonderful.  We also saw a monk seal and three sea turtles early in the morning.

reviews.title: Good place to walk, quiet in the morning
reviews.text: Lovely place to walk with the chickens, get there before too many people show.   It is a lovely beach, safe and not much surge.

reviews.title: Gorgeous clean beach
reviews.text: This stretch of beach is absolutely beautiful! There is so much to see in the park like the big turtles and monk seals sleeping in the morning.  Get there early (about 7am) and watch the turtles slowly go back into the water very slowly. It’s not easy for them. At least it doesn’t appear to be until they are buoyant in the water. The rest of the beach is lovely. Great waves, surfers, lava, soft sand and strong rip currents. So strong that just walking at the edge I was swept off my feet. The water is nice and warm, just really strong. To the east of Poi’pu Beach, right next to the Grand Hyatt there is a hike- it’s fairly easy, right along the cliffs. It was great! Another wonderful way to see the island and hike at the same time. Where hiking boots or good sneakers for this walk.  If its very sunny you will be warm, but it won’t matter bc it’s an amazing walk.

reviews.title: Wow!!!!!  Must see
reviews.text: This beach was perfect for snorkeling that we came twice with our 7yr old.  So much to see and the sea turtles were amazing!  Make this a must stop on your list

reviews.title: Snorkeling, Wildlife, People Watching
reviews.text: This beach is one of our favorites on Kauai! Each time we go, there has been at least one seal and turtle napping on the sand. It does get crowded and parking can be hard to find, so I recommend getting there in the morning. The snorkeling is great for beginners, and even for not-beginners (like my husband and I)! This beach has a lifeguard and is family friendly, too! People of all ages hang out at this beach.

reviews.title: Great community amenity
reviews.text: A local gem that’s ideal for picnics and spending an hour or two on the beach. It’s not a particularly protected cove so the water can still get a bit rough. If so, try boogie boarding. There’s some good snorkeling on rock beds. When we were there we had a couple of sea turtles keep us company which is always nice. Good facilities and a bar/restaurant close by.

reviews.title: 5 star fun
reviews.text: It seems to be a beach that has it all! Although popular, there is plenty of room on this long, clean,sandy beach. Great for families with kids (stay to the left side of the sandbar where the two currents meet and swirl). Fun to snorkel there before high tide because it becomes rough to swim in and the water becomes cloudy. Still great for bobbing in the waves close to shore. If you walk a couple minutes or so to the right you see the surfers and boogie boarders catching waves!As a bonus in the late afternoon, a large green sea turtle swam/crawled up toward our blanket resting 25 feet away. Everyone was excited to see and photogragh this sighting.Since this is a state beach there were lifeguards, restrooms and ample parking. Enjoy!

reviews.title: Clean and inviting
reviews.text: Perfect for kids, this beach is calm and inviting. Occasionally a monk seal is sunbathing (none this trip), but mind your manners and leave them alone. Great little places to eat within walking distance.

reviews.title: Still beautiful on a rainy day
reviews.text: The seals love to bask here. It was a rainy day, but it was still a beautiful beach. Many restaurants all along the beach.

reviews.title: Great place for lots of activities
reviews.text: Great place to swim, snorkel or have fun at the beach.  Can get crowded, so go early if you want shade.  Also, waves can get crazy so just keep an eye on the swell forecast.  Lots of good fish viewing as well as turtle sightings.

reviews.title: Love this beach!
reviews.text: Free parking close by. Grassy area. Little shade though; need to bring pop ups or umbrellas if you don’t want to sun bathe. Great snorkeling but when we went in the afternoon it was pretty crowded. Love the underwater walkway to the resting area for the monk seals. Must give them room to come ashore. Lifeguards will warn you. My 7 year old liked exploring all the tide pools to check out tiny sea life. The water was beautiful blue shade at the time we went. Really enjoyed our time here.

reviews.title: I found the turtles!!
reviews.text: I had been to my entire trip "the turtles are on Poipu Beach" but apparently since I was going at night I was on the wrong beach. They come out on the side with the lifeguard. I saw them at night and then took a solo trip before sunrise the next morning and watched them wake up and head back to sea! Turtles are my favorite animal and I was in AWE just being that close to them! Check them out but remember to give them their space and do not touch them!

reviews.title: Beach park for picnic lunch
reviews.text: We enjoyed a spacious table in the shade as we watched the waves break over the rocks and the children flying kites. Handy parking. Clean bathroom

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: It was a good beach beautiful. Enough parking if you go early. Bring an umbrella for shade. Bathrooms available.

reviews.title: Great Beach Park
reviews.text: This beach park has everything you can ask for: close, fairly large parking lot; bathrooms; showers; lifeguards; pavilion with picnic tables; some palm trees for shade; sand areas, but also areas with grass if you don't necessarily want to be in the sand. In the water, there is a shallow, sandy area which is great for kids, but the rest is pretty rocky in the shallow water. The snorkeling was actually pretty great - lots of different fish, clear water, and lifeguards just in case. There is a little island you can get out to if the conditions are right (if they aren't the lifeguards tell you not to go because the waves crash into each other right were you swim through to the island). We saw two monk seals sleeping on the little island. There are chickens roaming around so be careful with food, I had one try to take a granola bar out of my hand.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach park
reviews.text: Setting is stunning.  2 lifeguard stands.  There was a very strong current the day we went which made it difficult to snorkel.  Bring fins or surf shoes as the bottom is very rocky.  There is a protected area that is very shallow for the kids, we even saw a turtle

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: Have been here a few years back and have been nowhere else since that rivals Poipu's quaint majestic beauty!

reviews.title: Most Wonderful Memories of This INCREDIBLE Beach~!
reviews.text: My husband and I had our belated honeymoon on Kauai awhile back..and visited Poipu Beach nearly every day during our 10 day vacationthere.  The water was sparkling clean and clear, always warm but not too warm,PERFECT!  Lovely white sand beach...clean and often it was just "we two" aswe went early in the morning!  What a way to start *or end your day~don't missthis beautiful beach...the stuff of your dreams of Hawaii and how it "should be"!

reviews.title: LOVED this beach!
reviews.text: This beach is perfect for families! There is a protected area for the kids and a lifeguard on duty. We loved the snorkeling. There were a lot of fish and a great variety. Getting in and out of the water wasn't hard once you learned good entry/exit spots so watch for those before entering.  NIce sandy beach.

reviews.title: Beach, please
reviews.text: Wonderful beach with great sand and clear water. The waves were enough for boogie boards and general fun. We saw sea turtles eating on the lava rocks and even saw an Hawaiian monk sea resting there. Great day to be had.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Poi’pu beach was a great place to relax and enjoy different activities. Snorkeling was great. Walking out to the little natural sand point with seals and titles there was fun. Even just a relaxing float in the “kiddie” pool area was so pleasant. Walking over to Brenneckes for lunch was an added bonus!

reviews.title: Beautiful view rough tide current
reviews.text: Poipu Beach was a feast to the eyes with its different shades of blue extending to the edge of the reminding me of the Indian Ocean I had seen in Rottnest Island in Western Australia. It would be ideal for us to just sit under the umbrella and enjoy the view.But we went snorkeling instead which was not a very sound idea even though there were a lot of other people snorkeling around.The Lifeguard kept on warning us about the current I understand why now. The reef is located at the tip point of two adjacent beach leading to a small island. There was strong rip current. Even with my best effort I was swept and pushed off the cliff again and again with deep scratches on my toe and ankle and legs. As a result, I was not able to swim in the ocean for the rest of my vacation.The lady at the beach rental told us a better place to go is the Kiahuna beach next to Poipu Beach park for surfing and boogey boarding.A better place to snorkel would be the Lawai Beach next to the Beach House Restaurant. We did snorkel there too. The bottom are made of mostly rocks but we saw so many colorful fish there.

reviews.title: Like Queen Liliuokalani & Princess Kaiulani, the Majesty of Po'ipu Beach Park is a Beautiful Memory!
reviews.text: Once, not even 1 generation ago, Hawaiians, and locals of all naionalities could walk the beach of Poi'pu with their "throw nets" on their shoulders looking for fish of all kinds to catch for ohana dinner or luau. They would dive for He'e or collect limu from the bountiful ocean on the South shore of Kaua'i. The men would dive with 3 prong spears to catch their fish solo or team up to lay their nets and surround Large piles of Akule that would feed many families from miles around P{oi'pu and Koloa. Now I see an over crowded beach where the Honu and the Monk Seal come ashore in mass to rest. Not a natural occurance like 20 - 30 years ago. The sky even look different. The sun is too big and too hot. Different from the time of my youth. Less than 1 generation ago. The sunsets are more intence. Not peaceful and calm. The crowded beach of Poi'pu of 2019 has changed dramaticlly from the 1970's. No place to park. Smells like Waikiki beach. Their is a film of lotion and oil in the keiki pond. I feel very sad for the malahini that saved for that 1 great trip to Nani O Kaua'i just to finf himself and family next to another tourist insted of eatting fresh caught fish and talking story to the locals at their fireside. Poi'pu WAS and IS a Very Special place! Just changed, like all special, lovely places on our planet. Only, to me, being a Hawaiian wahine, I have the knowledge to explain to future travlers toPoi'pu Beach how it once was. Not to bring them down, but to encourage our island visitors to close their eyes and imagine how it once was! A good read on the island of Kaua'i is: "The story of Koloa" "A Plantation Town". Another one I recomend highly for Kaua'i visitors is:" Kauai As it was in the 1940s and 50s by Mike Ashman. " GREAT BOOK! Very Accurate! E komo mai! Hele on to Kaua'i and Enjoy. "Go Gentley" Times and senery change. The Aloha Spirit is alive and well. Aloha e pumehana! Malama Pono! ALOHA!

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: If you want to dive straight into the water by snorkel or dive take a dip at Poipu beach park, we snorkeled with plenty of fish and a wonderfull turtle. Clear water and easy to swim, not to far from all ammenities and easy to get too.

reviews.title: Monk Seals!
reviews.text: My dream came true, as one of my many wishes to fulfill while in Hawaii was to see a Monk Seal.  While we stopped by Poipu Beach, there was one up on the shore!  It was fascinating to see and the volunteer was very sweet & knowledgeable.  We enjoyed our short time there & splashed in the water a bit to cool off.  We went to Brenneck's Grill across the street & enjoyed some delicious food and drinks for Happy Hour.  Loved Poipu area!

reviews.title: Lots Of Sea Life!
reviews.text: This was the first beach we went to. Saw a seal, Eagle Ray, and tons of beautiful fish. Not bad for the first day! It’s a little busy, but as a guy who has lived by Galveston his whole life, this was everything I wanted in a beach. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with decent snorkling
reviews.text: We enjoyed this beach as a good place to get in a quick swim and see some decent snorkling.  There's plenty of parking, a nearby restaurant, public restrooms, warm water, and it's close to a lot of the hotels and towns in the area.  The only downsides are the snorkling (much better elsewhere on the island) and that it's quite busy.  There's a Marriott vacation club nearby and its proximity to Poipu resorts and homes probably makes it popular.  All told, though, it's a good beach.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling spot
reviews.text: Very nice beach, great snorkeling spot, lots of fish too see, they have life guards on duty as well, the beach was pretty crowded though. We also seen 3 huge sea turtles sunning themselves on the beach during our visit there.

reviews.title: Great beach, good facilities
reviews.text: We arrived about noon, no problem parking or finding a shady spot. Lifeguards on duty. Surfing for those who can, paddling and swimming or snorkelling for everyone. Safe for children, playground too. Lots of fish but no turtles or seals while we were there. Great cafe for sandwiches, shave ice etc. Place to hire seats, umbrellas, boards and snorkels - $8 a day average. Toilets and shower on beach. Wear rock pool shoes in the sea.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We're still here and it's still amazing.  Lovely and clean, chickens wandering around everywhere, turtles up on the beach and Hawaiian monk seals!  Lovely to see the local people protecting their wildlife too.  The Hawaiians really are very passionate about their culture and creatures.  The beach itself is lovely but you must be respectful of the sea and beware of the very strong current.  Turtles actually swam around us and we were only waist high in the water! Beautiful place to be!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We stopped on our way back from the falls to cool off and see another of the amazing beaches of Kauai.We loved the area that was a natural swimming spot when you could snorkel if you were not as experienced.My gdaughter is a bit scared when their are no sides to reach for and she loved it.

reviews.title: What a beach!
reviews.text: This is a beach which has something for everyone!  The little kids can enjoy the sheltered kids area.  (Often green sea turtles come here at twilight.  Don't disturb them!!!)Snorkelers can often find good snorkeling on calm days near the tombolo.  Lifeguards are present during the daytimes.  Heed their warnings as sometimes there is a rip current.  A nice, sandy area perfect for swimming or just treading water is over at the right side in front of the Waiohai hotel. There is a fresh water shower there and several at Poipu Beach Park.  In the spring there are often several very endangered monk seals who choose Poipu Beach Park as the place to give birth.  Local citizens will then post yellow ropes and signs to keep the public back from disturbing the endangered seals.  A huge fine can be levied for disturbing them!  Throughout the year the rare seals can sometimes be found on beaches in Kaua'i.  They often appear to be dead, but they are only resting.  If they feel threatened they will retreat into the ocean, where unrested, they become prey for sharks.  Please stay well away from them!  (Also, they have been known to bite...hard!)

reviews.title: Most crowded beach on the island
reviews.text: It's okay. Worth going to check out. But is crowded due to the hotels right there.  And the currents are pretty strong in parts...especially for the inexperienced.  Go for a bit, do some snorkeling and check the box. Then explore the rest of the island's beaches.

reviews.title: Very Rocky Shallows
reviews.text: It’s beautiful, of course. It’s a Hawaiian beach after all. But the shallows are very rocky, paved with roughly 8” or so diameter rocks which are quite slippery too. August unfortunately brings stronger currents than usual and even in the shallows, my husband got dragged a bit, and he is a strong swimmer.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Nice beach park.  Great for snorkeling, and for children since there is a natural rock barrier that breaks the waves.  We saw a sea turtle come up on the beach here as well.

reviews.title: Breathtaking views, but crowded
reviews.text: Everyone seems to know that this is one of the best beaches on Kauai.  Get there early to claim your spot!  Great protected area for small kids to play in the water, soft sand beach, and restroom/shower facilities.  Food within walking distance.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: The current and waters were quite rough the day we were there.  The beach can get very crowded so expect to be sitting quite close to others.  Snorkeling was ok and did see a very large turtle!

reviews.title: Great Snorkeling
reviews.text: We walked a few minutes down the beach to this park to snorkel.  Saw the most colorful fish, and some eels too!  Not too crowded, and the Baby Beach allowed for a sandy bottom where you could get in and out of the water easily, then swim over the snorkeling part.  Enjoyable!

reviews.title: Rough surf, strong tides, wild turtles
reviews.text: Simply amazing!Swimming with wild turtles - bucket list item ticked off the list.The current is strong, very strong. Rocks in the beach, but there is a smallish area with a sandy bottom. Be careful with kids and floaty devices.Approx 20 wild turtles swim there every day and come ashore each night , just breathtaking. No lifeguard at the turtle beach.Lifeguard at the next little inlet, over the road from Brennekes.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful spot! But for those of us who are tourists, remember there is little shade. Try to rent an umbrella if you plan to stay for a while. There is a lifeguard and changing area. Bring water - you will want to hydrate. Take some fish food to get the fish to surface. Good spot to snorkel.

reviews.title: Best Snorkeling Spot!
reviews.text: Poipu Beach was hands down the best snorkeling location we found on the Island. The water was clear and the colors of the fish were vibrant!  We saw what looked to be like a family of Sea Turtles, which we all went nuts over. We’d recommend Poipu Beach to anyone of all ages, even for little kids. It was an awesome experience.

reviews.title: So many roosters, so little time
reviews.text: This is a lovely beach/park. The waters welcome turtles, the park is a great spot for the roosters. We loved relaxing in this area. The ocean views are unbelievable.

reviews.title: Nice beach for families!
reviews.text: This beach was very nice and the waves were not too strong. It is perfect for snorkeling.  They have built in bbq pits if you want to throw something on the grill.  We even saw a sea turtle.

reviews.title: Day at the beach with the family
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful and not too crowded.  There was parking close by and easy to access the beach. There seems to be good snorkeling here.  Bring your water shoes as there are rocks below the surface.

reviews.title: Great Beach and Monk Seals!
reviews.text: This beach has life guards! We saw monk seals. They were further out on the sandbar so I did not get a good picture. The day we went the surf was very high, but in the area sheltered by the rocks, the water was perfect. There are changing rooms with restrooms at this park and plenty of picnic tables. There is some shade in the grassy area. There is no cost to park across the street from the park. There is playground equipment for the kids.

reviews.title: Fun for all ages + turtles!
reviews.text: The whole family, from 3 years old to 70, enjoyed this park and beach. Playground was fun. Kiddie pool area was protected from waves. Great snorkeling without going far into water. Good trees for shade. Plenty of close parking. And lots of sand for castles. There is also an island you can swim out to and snorkel from that was more adventurous for the teens. Favorite part was visiting the sea turtles in early am and late evening that hang out on the beach.

reviews.title: Snorkeling
reviews.text: Rent  or buy your snorkel equipment be sure to get fins. This spot is loaded with all kinds of colorful fish. This is a perfect place to snorkel it has facilities and a lifeguard, also you may see a Monk Seal.

reviews.title: Classic Hawaiian beach
reviews.text: We loved coming here. You can swim, body surf and snorkel. The beach is very Sandy without a crazy amounts of rocks, but you'll still want to wear water shoes in the ocean because even though it's still sandier than others, it still has sharp rocks in some parts. Restrooms and parking are available. Very warm water too. We loved it!

reviews.title: Love it here
reviews.text: Always a favorite spot. Poipu Beach park is beautiful. Two life guard stations these days. Relaxing place for little kids.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach, loved it!
reviews.text: Our family loves Hawaii....who doesn’t! We try to escape at least twice a year. This time it was really special with a new baby on board! So much fun, sharing memories, reminiscing.....perfect! Lots to give thanks for. ❤️

reviews.title: No place to body-surf
reviews.text: This beach is a very good place to take small children. Nice wadding pool and safe but the surf is not safe for regular swimming.

reviews.title: Perfect for us
reviews.text: This beach was closest to our resort so we spent most of our time there. The sunset is awesome from this beach, something not to miss.

reviews.title: Nice location with two lifeguard stations
reviews.text: It is nice that there are two lifeguard stations in this area.   It was really busy at 10:30 on a weekday morning with lots of families since it’s summer.  The tide was out so it was kind of rocky getting into the water.  The baby area was full of kids and nice since it was so shallow for little ones.  The snorkeling area is protected by a reef but there is a sign indicating where you should not go.  There is plenty of sand to share for sitting around and fairly easy to put an umbrella into the sand.  There are some picnic tables under trees in the shade.

reviews.title: Nice beach for all ages with good snorkeling
reviews.text: We visited on a day when the seas were stirred up by a distant storm. The lava breakwater that protects this beach allowed for good swimming overseen by lifeguards in two stations. There is an even more protected swimming area for children. We were there to snorkel and were pleased with a large number of different types of fish. A restaurant and deli are across the street and there are restrooms in the beach park. Parking is much more plentiful and easier to obtain than at other Kauai beaches and it's free.

reviews.title: Great for snorkeling and sun bathing
reviews.text: My husband and I loved visiting this beach while on our honeymoon. Great snorkeling for any level, crystal clear water, and lots of room to relax on the beach. It is pretty rocky so wear water shoes! Prepare to see lots of fish and maybe even a turtle or monk seal!

reviews.title: Stunning! Go early
reviews.text: We arrived early and easily got parking and a great spot on the beach. The water wasn't to choppy when we arrived which made snorkelling more enjoyable. We saw three giant sea turtles, lots of tropical fish as well as a sea lion. An incredible day.

reviews.title: Loved the beach and the turtles/seals
reviews.text: I really liked this beach. The water is beautiful, the only downside is that the waves can be a little rough and there is a lot of rock underneath. We swam out to the little sandbar area but I was careful not to put my feet down until I got up on the side where there wasn't any rock. My husband did cut his feet a couple of times so you have to be careful. But once we got to the sandbar there was a seal on it sleeping. It was so cool. While we were standing there but far away from the seal so as not to disturb it a sea turtle came up on the beach by the seal. It was really cool. We only stayed a few minutes because we didn't want to disrupt them and more people were coming out but I would definitely come to the beach again. They do have lifeguards there and since the water was pretty choppy, it was nice to have them there. There was a calmer area over to the side if you had smaller kids that would be safer as well.

reviews.title: Great Sand. Ok waves. Rocky.
reviews.text: Looks great but we left after everyone in the family cut their feet on rocks while swimming. We preferred the part of Poipu Beach that are close to the Marriott and Sheraton.

reviews.title: Beautiful sandy beach.  Frequently you can see sea turtles and seals on the beaches there.
reviews.text: This is a great beach for relaxing in the sun or swimming with the family.  You will frequently see sea turtles and seals relaxing on the beach.

reviews.title: Turtles
reviews.text: Go in the morning around 5:30 am. It will be worthy!You will have an amazing experience that will last forever.

reviews.title: Love this beach!!!
reviews.text: Very nice beach with tons to do we swam to the sandbar and sad sea turtles and fish galore and monk seals basking in the sun. Plenty to do here and good for all ages to enjoy

reviews.title: Lovely but often crowded
reviews.text: This beach has something for everyone. There is a sandy “kiddie pool” area for small children. You can snorkel and swim. We saw turtles and monk seals. There are picnic tables and plenty of shade. As to be expected at such a nice beach, it’s usually very crowded. Snorkeling is best on weekdays early in the morning, before all of crowds begin to make the water cloudy. I found snorkeling to be much more pleasant at nearby Lawai beach, where there were fewer people.

reviews.title: Very touristy and crowded, but sunny, great facilities and a nice spot
reviews.text: Most of the beaches in Hawaii are pretty relaxed and rustic.  Poipu seems like a beach you might find in California, with the facilities and lifeguards and crowds.  That's not bad, and it is probably the beach that gets the most sun and the facilities are nice.  But if you're looking for something a bit less crowded, go elsewhere.

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: This was a short visit to this area but beautiful to say the least. Immediately we saw 3 sea turtles that had come into the cove, my sons went back the next day to snorkel and hang out and saw a sea turtle on the beach. It was too busy to snorkel and there were life guards on duty. The picture is the sea turtle they saw on the beach.

reviews.title: Great for kids
reviews.text: There are showers there too, and while it's first come first served for beach space, it was great to get the kids started on snorkeling.  Lots of fish to see and if you are lucky a sea turtle or seal to add to the adventure.  There is a store nearby in case you forget anything.  Be careful about how far you go out, as there are rip tides.  I was very careful to keep me & the kids closer to shore to ensure we could always swim back easily.

reviews.title: One of the greatest beaches!
reviews.text: Love this area! Family friendly with the best beaches! Great for toddlers too! Monk seals and turtles are here often! We love Poipu!

reviews.title: Poipu Busy Beach
reviews.text: Definitely a lot of people, but didn't feel crowded. Parking is easy, big lot available nearby. There was a Turtle on the Beach and I was happy no one was disturbing him. We also saw a few chickens (surprise surprise), saw some people snorkeling but we just relaxed and took a nice stroll.

reviews.title: Selfies with Turtles and Sea Lions..lifeguards on duty to keep wildlife safe..lol
reviews.text: This is an amazing beach to see sea life must visit! You can get very close but no touching. Lifeguards play guard for giant turtles and sea lions and will scold you on the microphone if you get to close. Loved the experience! It's free as well!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Best swimming on the island. Reef protected and lifeguard beach. Beautiful sunsets.  Bathrooms, picnic area and children's playground

reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: It’s really cool to see the water rise and fall with the tide. The lifeguards are very good about warning people when the waves are high. Unfortunately, we didn’t see any marine life, but, as is common all across the island, we saw plenty of chickens! There’s not a lot of shade and it gets very hot, but it’s easy to cool off in the water. Bring a lot of sunscreen. Bathrooms had toilet paper but no soap, so bring hand sanitizer too!

reviews.title: A favorite beach
reviews.text: We always visit this beach, when staying on island, because it has fun for everyone!  There are bars and restaurants a short walk down the beach.  There are waves.  There is snorkeling.  Sometimes there's even a sandy bar to a little sand island of rocky tide pool fun.  Theres a playground and grass stretching to Brenneckes. Sometimes the surf is too big though.  But the moonlit turtle beaching is an awesome experience, keep your distance and no flash.  We watched a tourist snorkeling early morning in their bay, she blocked the turtles from leaving and a monk seal threatened her multiple times to back off without any awareness of herself.  Many locals watched in horror. Luckily she wasnt hurt and exited (crawling over the reef even)... please dont be that person.  Respect the locals.  Of land and sea.  There is a lot of beauty at this beach.  I swam with 2 spotted eagle Ray's in the surf about 3 or 4 feet deep. Lotsa fish! Seals!  Turtles! Amazing!!!

reviews.title: lovely beach
reviews.text: Poipu Beach is an quite lovely. It is a great place to snorkel, surf and paddle board. Picnic tables were abundant, however, I believe that they are first come first served.

reviews.title: Monk Seals and  Turtles but if red flagged be careful
reviews.text: We went there in the afternoon, which was a mistake for amateur ocean goers like us. Red flags were up. We did see two monk seals and a gorgeous Honu. Lifeguarded beach, great parking across from it. wash off station, rest rooms. so a plus for all of that. We went to get in the water and the surf was really rough we tried snorkeling but the current was taking us to the right side, the waves kept crashing so it was not very safe for us. I mean it is shallow but we got pretty beat up trying to maneurver around and getting out. some rocky bottom. If you stay to the left by the kiddie area and snorkel against those rocks it was better. We used the sign in the middle as a guide, if we stayed to the left we were ok, but as soon as we got to the right of the sign the current moved us over the shallow area and then had to try to get back. I would try it again, early morning to see if that makes a difference, as I said we are amateurs and that was our experience. We know our limitations and we heeded them.

reviews.title: VERY BEAUTIFUL
reviews.text: We loved this beach!! Grass and sand, picnic tables and bathrooms. Different  areas to swim. Lots of lifeguards. Easy parking and deli across the street. Overall amazing beach.

reviews.title: Great beach, saw seals sunning in the sand!
reviews.text: We stayed in Poipu and drove to this beach.  It was so unique with the lava rocks creating a barrier to the ocean so the kids could swim.  We saw seal laying on the sand and they had them roped off as they are protected.  Great views, good bathrooms and there were life guards!

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: a great little beach with easy parking. Sand and water is very nice but it gets a little rocky once you get out into the water. Very good for snorkeling. there's even a little tide pool area for the kiddies! good signage all around to show you where to avoid for rip currents and plenty of lifeguards. And chickens roaming around to keep everything interesting. Keep an eye on your food or the chickens will get it.

reviews.title: We loved this spot!
reviews.text: Found this Beach and loved it.  We would highly recommend you finding it.  All of the beaches on Kauai are wonderful.  So beautiful.

reviews.title: Best Beach for Snorkeling, Turtles and Monk Seals!
reviews.text: The wildlife is here. Amazing sightings of Hawaiian green turtles and Monk Seals. Snorkeling is best on the island. Life Guards on duty. A portion of the beach has a sandy bottom and is calmer than that part of the beach where the snorkelers are.  Referred locally as baby beach. We used full face snorkeling rentals. I found I had less water in my mouth and a clear view.   Chickens walking all around. Very enjoyable experience.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Poipu is a great beach for the snorkeler who doesn't want to do a lot of work to see a lot of beautiful fish.  It has ample parking as well so you don't have to search long or walk far.  It's right next to a great spot for boogie boarding so you can accomplish a lot with just one stop!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, great facilities
reviews.text: This beach had so many pluses going for it.  Plenty of lifeguards, covered picnic tables, reef-protected swimming areas for children as well as separate areas for adults, a surfing area right next door to Poipu beach, an outdoor shower, restrooms, and a great restaurant across the street.  Gotta visit this beach!

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: This is a great Beach within walking distance from Many Condominiums or rentals. Brennecke’s Beach Broiler restaurant is right there. It’s a great body surfing beach. Has life guards in certain areas and areas of water are protected. Great for smaller children. There are shelters and big green spaces. Great place just to sit back and watch the Ocean 🌊

reviews.title: Crowded
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach for families with kids. There is a protected area where littles can play safely and even do a bit of beginners’ snorkeling. For those looking for a quiet or peaceful day at the beach this is not it. It is very crowded compared to other beaches in the general area so just be prepared to search for a while before finding a spot to relax.

reviews.title: Poipu Beach Park
reviews.text: Nice beach. Saw Hawaiian Monk Seals and Sea Turtles. This is one of the beaches with lifeguards. There are washrooms and outdoor showers to clean off before going to your vehicle. Lots of parking also.

reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: People seem to love this beach but I don’t really see it.   It’s crowded, hot, rough and surrounded by buildings.   Way to commercial.   I prefer the north shore beaches by far.

reviews.title: Best Part of Island
reviews.text: Love Poipu, the area is beautiful the beaches are the best and I the sun is always shining, even if it had just rained.  We love to be able to watch the surfers and it is very very clean.  All the shops around there are very accessible by walking if you like to walk.

reviews.title: good place for snorkeling, especially  if you  are not  a  strong  swimmer
reviews.text: The other reviews have covered it ell,  plenty for all  ages here.  if you are a beginning snorkeler,  or have little ones, this is a good  place to let them see fish in a  relatively safe location. An outer  reef keeps  a portion of the  water near the beach protected  from strong tide  action.  But PLEASE always remember the power of the ocean, check  with  the life guards   before  entering water  to get the latest  info on currents.There is not a lot of shade along the beach, I recommend an umbrella if you are  going to stay very long. We managed  to  find  shade it  was just a bit back  off  the water, but still  had  GREAT views.We had NO  issues  swimming  both days  we snorkeled at the park. I could  touch  bottom 99% of the time and I am average height. The monk seal are something  to  behold.  We had a nice picnic  at one the tables.

reviews.title: Crowded...but monk seals!
reviews.text: Nice area with some shade available during the day. We were there on 2 different days and saw a monk seal basking on the beach each day. There was a volunteer there that we talked to about the seals' habits and behaviors. The current is strong in places, but there is a little inlet with calmer water. The park also has picnic pavilions and a playground. We walked from our rental house in Poipu along the beaches and walking paths. Several hotels have bars right on the beach for a nice stop.

reviews.title: Good beach
reviews.text: Parking can be a little tricky if you do not get here early enough.  Plenty of beach space to lay out, build sand castles, or go snorkeling.

reviews.title: Poipo Beach Kauai
reviews.text: Great family beach. It has something for every age. Beautiful views with park tables and playground on grassy area on the beach. Beach water shallow enough for babies and small children. Animal life comes up onto the shore. Only disadvantage is you need water shoes if you want to go beyond the shallow water because there are a lot of rocks as you adventure out into deep waters. Great for snorkeling. Local deli near by too.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is a popular beach, many people but didn’t feel really coward. We were there memorial weekend so it may have been the reason for so many people. Was one of the nicer beaches we were at, was high waves most of the time we were on Kauai. We saw a seal as well while there

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Love this beach!! A variety of beach suitable for babies through surfers. Loved snorkeling there! So many beautiful fish that come right up to you. The 2 times we went, monk seals were up on the shore sleeping as was a turtle. Sunset there was gorgeous!! Definitely recommend!

reviews.title: Great Beach but Watch out for Riptides
reviews.text: We visited here to spend the day at the beach. The beach is lovely with people being very considerate and giving everyone their own space. You can snorkel along the beach but be careful to the right as you face the ocean as there are riptides that develop there depending on the tide. There are lots of signs posted but make sure to pay attention. There were two resting Monk Seals both times we came to the beach which were really cool to see. Not much shade on the beach but the sun wasn't too hot. Didn't use the facilities other than to rinse off our feet but they are there!

reviews.title: Favorite beach in Hawaii
reviews.text: After seeing very little fish on other beaches, at Poipu you could stand in water 2-3 feet deep and through the crystal clear water see hundreds of fish swimming all around you without even putting on a snorkel mask.  A monk seal was on the beach for a suntan and a large sea turtle crawled out for a little while.  Go out across from the lifeguard stand to see the fish.  There are restrooms and showers.  There is a very shallow area for toddlers.  We had fun here.

reviews.title: Fun in the sun
reviews.text: Love this beach, something for everyone. A calm area for the little ones, snorkeling and waves. Lifeguards and bathrooms a bonus!

reviews.title: Not to be missed
reviews.text: This beach has the look of a Hawai’i beach. Surrounded by palm trees and turquoise water. There is tons of stuff for the whole family. The little rocked out swimming area for the kids was great. It was a few feet deep and protected from the waves. The water was fairly warms and the kids loved it. To the right of this was a very rocky area in the water. This was awesome snorkeling. We saw tons of colored fish and eels. Bring water shoes as this place will cut you up. Well worth the effort though. There was a seal sunning on the far end of the beach that was a huge hit with the families. The views were beautiful. I would absolutely come here again and would recommend traveling for this beach. They have showers, bathrooms, lifeguards and a playground.

reviews.title: Crowded beach, but safe and swimmable
reviews.text: Rocky shoreline, but kids were fine.  Bring your umbrellas, as there are no shade trees.  You cannot boogie board at this beach-no waves.

reviews.title: Good place
reviews.text: Saw 7 turtles and a beautiful sunset. We also saw two monk seals on the beach. We walked around and enjoyed the beautiful beaches. There is a playground for the young ones and good amounts of parking. Restaurant across street. Pricey. Shopping center close by with amazing ice cream and Puka dog. We are going back again tonight t

reviews.title: Great beach for photo ops but rough water
reviews.text: The waters here are rough for sure. The will crash you onto the lava rock just bearly under the water , Ouch. So pictures and beach towel time are best here. Currents are strong. Surfers like the large waves though.

reviews.title: Monk seals!!
reviews.text: Got to see two of these rare beauties! They were cordoned off to keep people from getting too close. But still pretty close! Great public beach. Clean facilities. Lifeguard on duty.

reviews.title: Great beach spot on Kauai
reviews.text: This is a great spot to come with your family to spend some quality beach time. Not too big but very nice. Close to food and shopping.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with easy access across from Lawai Beach Resort.  Lots of surfers to watch, big waves.

reviews.title: Lots of turtles, and perfect for small kids.
reviews.text: We visited the Beach Park with our 2 and 5 year old and couldn’t get them to leave. The protected pool was perfect for the kiddos, and we saw tons of fish, turtles, and other sea creatures. It was the best beach we visited. There was also a great playground that worked for both ages.

reviews.title: Safe beach, beautiful sunsets, awesome place to snorkel!
reviews.text: Poipu Beach offers you a beach patrolled by a Life Guard, sheltered areas to swim and snorkel, sandy beach areas, and AMAZING picture perfect tropical sunsets...We found 2 protected areas to swim, one for little ones and right next to it a larger area.  Both are surrounded by large rocks which act as a breakwater that "tone down" the heavier surf.There was an interesting mix of fish including the triggerfish whose Hawaiian name is humuhumunukunukuapua'a, please don't ask me to say it  :)There are sheltered picnic areas in the grassy area about the beach.  I stayed in the more sheltered areas and watched people surf in the open areas.  Pretty cool!Sea turtles come to the beach after sunset to rest...please let's be loving spectators and remain out of their space and not use flash which upsets them...sorry not trying to be preachy but just respectful.  It was amazing to witness their exhausting struggle to heave their very heavy bodies out of the sea onto the beach.I just hope that I can come back...we LOVED it!  Hopefully you can come too!

reviews.title: Overall great sandy beach! water was a bit rough when we were there
reviews.text: Nice long, easy to access beach. Good sandy area. Water seemed to be a bit high or rough while we were there, but overall clear, nice water. Just have to watch out for rocks!

reviews.title: Pleasant park, with space for Kids to run around
reviews.text: Beach - protected and narrow, but good for Kids.Waves can get rough and break on to rocks - counsel care with non-swimmers.Life-Guard was On Duty when we visited.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Wonderful sandy beach with shady trees if desired. We snorkeled here & saw lots of fish. There was a Hawaiin monk seal that came to shore. There's also an area with less wake for little kids to enjoy. We parked at Brenneke's beach grill & walked right across the street.

reviews.title: Nice daytime beach with resident monk seal and morning sea turtles
reviews.text: Family friendly beach with lifeguards, waves, snorkeling and wildlife.  Warm water and swallow areas for all to enjoy.

reviews.title: Best snorkeling and wild life viewing!
reviews.text: I went there twice during my stay and both times I got to see Monk Seals and Sea Turtles!  Snorkeling I saw many different colorful fish as well as sea urchins and eels too!  With the protective barrier, it's easily snorkeled!

reviews.title: Snorkeling!
reviews.text: We enjoyed snorkeling at Poipu Beach Park. One day a big sea turtle came in and landed on the beach, climbing his way out of the water. That was really cool to see! There can be some challenging currents in these waters so be careful, but enjoy! There are bathrooms at this locations, which gives you the opportunity to change in/out of swimming gear so you can go on to enjoy other adventures nearby.

reviews.title: Good Beach
reviews.text: This is not your normal beach there is limited beach area and you won’t be walking Oceanside. However  you’ll find plenty of space to sunbathe and the water is great. Bring water shoes if you don’t want to bust your foot on a rock. Great for sunsets!

reviews.title: Great protected. South shore beach
reviews.text: If you are looking for one of the safer & protected beaches - this is it. Often visitors can see the green sea turtles and the monk seals resting on the beach sand near waters edge.The park features benches and restrooms along with grass areas and manned lifeguard stations. Very friendly family with restaurants and a few rental and shops near by. The adjacent beach to the East is great for boogie boarding.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: What a stunning beach! Perfect place to snorkel, swim, surf and watch sea turtles. You can rent snorkel gear from the shop just steps from the beach. The beach is very clean, the water is clear, and there’s a public restroom across the street. Beautiful place for watching sunsets.

reviews.title: Great place to snorkel
reviews.text: This a great place to snorkel and get some beach time while in the Poipu area. Saw lots of fish and few turtles while there. Water is calm and is a good to place if learning to snorkel

reviews.title: Beautiful beach at sunset!
reviews.text: I was told that Poipu beach has one of the prettiest sunsets on Kauai and it is the truth. We went just before sunset and watched surfers ride the waves as the sun went down.

reviews.title: Awesome fish during snorkeling - wear water shoes
reviews.text: We enjoyed our day here as a first snorkeling experience for our adult daughters.  Once you venture out of the kids sandy area, fish were plentiful.  We grabbed a vacant picnic table under a palm so even got shade.  We brought beach chairs and found those very helpful.  It was busy -- not the place to go for seclusion.

reviews.title: A nice family beach
reviews.text: This is a rock protected beach with decent snorkeling and a space between breaks for some beginning to intermediate surfing.  The shallow beach is great for small kids.   We saw both turtles and monk seals up on the beach as a bonus.  There are picnic areas with grass that were nice to get back up away from the sand and sun under a palm. Overall, a very nice beach.

reviews.title: Poipu Beach Park
reviews.text: This is a great beach to go to.For sunbathing or if you like to snorkel.We went on a snorkeling boat cruise but saw more beautiful fish here.So just bring your own gear or rent it.You can find places to rent all around and it’s pretty cheep.You have to be cautious of the current however and the reefs are a bit rocky.We even saw a sea turtle resting on a reef that you can swim to.But please look from a distance.Some guy was trying to sit on one for a picture...stupid.There are life guards on this beach.I would highly recommend this beach.

reviews.title: Safe for swimming, not the prettiest
reviews.text: Pros: Good parking, public bathrooms and safe swimming-life guards and few waves. Cons: It’s crowded and not that pretty. If you are looking for a quieter mire idyllic beach (but no life guards) you can head down the road to Shipwreck beach.

reviews.title: Great place to swim and turtle watching
reviews.text: We parked over by the Kaneiolouma heiau (nice restoration work in process, so some signage) public park - they had some sea turtles parked on the beach to get some sun in (stay 10 feet away from them for their safety).  We walked around the beach to the next cove over on the right, and that had perfect swimming water.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Day and Night
reviews.text: This was our favorite place to snorkel. Saw a turtle and a seal and tons of tropical fish. At night, the turtles come up on shore to catch some Z’s.

reviews.title: A Must-See beach
reviews.text: Living in the Lihue area, this beach is very accessible.  Great area on the left for small children.  Snorkeling in Poipu is really great on the right side.  You can just stand in the water and look down to see fish all around your legs.  If you're not comfortable snorkeling, you can still see the fish through the very clear water!

reviews.title: Next Door to hotel
reviews.text: Great public beach with a lifeguard during the day.  Public restrooms, sheltered picnic areas, grills available.  Small Deli/Store/Restaurant across the road from park.  Had the pleasure of seeing visiting Monk Seals sunbathing for HOURS on the beach! 😍

reviews.title: Snorkelling
reviews.text: This was a go to safe snorkelling spot, (but I liked Koloa Landing more).  Usually calm and shallow on the east  side.  More rugged on the west side, but more fish.  Seemed to be a cross current on the west side that could be problematic for some coming back to beach.  Nice sunsets and nice facilities to grab some water time during your travels back and forth on the island:

reviews.title: This was a perfect intimate beach to visit
reviews.text: We loved the Poipu beach and spent several hours playing in the water and sand. The two huge Hawaii seals that call this beach home were amazing to watch as they laid on the beach. Signs say they are regular tenants!!

reviews.title: Beach visit
reviews.text: My wife and I along with another couple recently went on a cruise vacation to numerous exotic islands in the Pacific. While on this cruise, we visited Poipu Beach on Kauai. The beach was very nice and there were great views of the ocean and surrounding area. We had a great time on this beautiful beach and got a special surprise when a sea turtle came onto the beach to sun. we would recommend this beach highly.

reviews.title: Best snorkeling for children
reviews.text: This has got to be one of the best beaches for snorkeling for beginners and children.  Many shallow areas that you can see a variety of colored fish easily.  Sea turtles laying out on the beach, just keep your distance as required by law.  Low tide in the morning leaves you with an even more shallow beach yet many fish still visible.  There is a breaker so waves are not as rough as other open beaches, but still tides and currents can be unpredictable so always be cautious in the ocean with children.

reviews.title: Kid friendly beach, fish in 5 feet of water, lifeguards and bathrooms
reviews.text: This beach is a perfect swimming spot for young families. There are a couple of protected coves with one sandy spot having no more than a foot of water for the youngest toddler to safely enjoy the ocean.  However, it’s not all about babies here. There is a rocky cove that invites snorkelers to enjoy our fishy friends in a lifeguard protected area. If you are a gung-ho snorkeler, this is not the beach for you, but if you want a leisurely look-see, this is your place. A huge benefit of this area is that sea life love it. A seal came close into shore and was checking out the crowd. A sea snake was captured. ( The lifeguards are on game here, as well as being friendly and knowledgeable. ) And finally a sea turtle came to visit. All this on a sleepy Tuesday when we visited the beach for 4 hours. There is a shower to wash off and clean bathrooms. There is a kids play structure and grassy areas with picnic tables. What more could a young family want?

reviews.title: Great Snorkeling
reviews.text: Make sure you wear water shoes, but this was a great spot for snorkeling! There was even a giant turtle chilling on the beach. Wish I had more time to explore the island you can swim out to, but we only had a couple of hours to stop. Showers to rinse off, and seemed to be plenty of parking. (we didn't arrive until 10ish) Will be sure to come back when we visit again!

reviews.title: Great snorkelling
reviews.text: Very good smoking with lots of =varieties of fish and size of fish.Very easy as the bay is vey protected.Wear reef shoes or flippers as the water is quite shallow and very rocky

reviews.title: Good snorkeling
reviews.text: limited parking, not really a swimming beach, two monk seals joined the sunbathers on the sand, has amenities

reviews.title: Moderate surf and right left ultra shallow made it hard to keep clear of coral....
reviews.text: Right has shallow coral too but a nice pathway beginning near the center.  Lots of fish, and saw a beached turtle on both of our visits!

reviews.title: Really great beach!
reviews.text: It's a popular beach, but with good reason. It's a lot of fun and well taken care of with lifeguards so it's perfect for families.

reviews.title: Beautiful at Sunset!
reviews.text: Make sure you are outside to watch this beautiful beach settle in for the evening and if you have a Special Someone with you take a stroll along the path or sit by a fiirepit to gaze at the sun setting. Just gorgeous!

reviews.title: Poipu Beach
reviews.text: Best spot for snorkeling by far. Filmed a turtle swimming right next to me. Best snorkeling in Kauai

reviews.title: Great Family Beach
reviews.text: This is a great beach to bring your family to. There's a large in-let for the kids to swim and on the other side there are big enough waves to boogey board as well.

reviews.title: Great beach for everyone - beautiful, calm water, snorkeling, swimming
reviews.text: Our accommodations were very close to this beach so we walked down multiple times during our week-long stay in Poipu. One of our favourite things about the beach were the number of sea turtles that come up for a rest on the beach. It is equally infuriating to see the number of beach-goers who crowd the sea turtles. GIVE THE SEA TURTLES LOTS OF SPACE. On plenty of occasions we saw a poor sea turtle turn around and leave the beach area when faced with aggressive tourists. The beach itself is guarded by lifeguards and the waters are calm, which made it very safe for snorkeling and swimming. The waters are full of colourful fish and the beach itself is a beautiful one, although it was not the loveliest one we saw on the island.

reviews.title: It’s a nice park
reviews.text: Public park with parking. Pretty clean. Dogs not allowed—lots of dogs. Several pavilions. Many roosters and chickens. Sit and watch the waves.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling, swimming and turtles too
reviews.text: This is a wonderful beach if you are not a strong swimmer but you want to snorkel. In just a few feet of water you can float above the surface and see  such wonderful sea life.   This is also a great place to swim or hang out in the ocean and I feel safe.  They also have lifeguards nearby.  When we were there a turtle was on the beach.   The beach can get overcrowded as the day goes on so it's better to come early rather than later.

reviews.title: Great place for families
reviews.text: Nice shallow protected cove with restrooms, playground, lifeguard, gazebos and some shade.  Lots of little children at this beach. Nice snorkeling.  Chair and snorkeling rentals nearby. We bought our chairs, snorkeling gear and umbrella at Costco, then donated them to the local church when we left. A little way to give back to the community.

reviews.title: Definite top beach choice
reviews.text: Public beach ideal to keep lots of different people happy with lifeguard station, bathrooms, grass area with shade, close by deli mart for snacks or beverages, etc. There are two beaches side by side. One is. Rey small cove with no lifeguard and great snorkeling. Another has the lifeguard station and huge area for snorkeling. The big perk for those with little children is the cove that’s one big kid “pool” built into shoreline. Sandy areas are in sunshine & clean. One down side is limited parking. And certain sections of where you walk in have rocks.

reviews.title: Snorkel day
reviews.text: Great area to snorkel, lots of people and a bit crowded. If you head over closer to the Sheraton hotel side the soft rolling waves will remind you of the waves in a wave pool.Highlight was the monk seal swimming around in between swimmers!!!@

reviews.title: VERY crowded...be prepared
reviews.text: This place is a fun place for kids to play but man ALL the people!!  SOOOOO crowded.  Lifeguards are in place and we saw seals on the beach.  Be prepared for walking to your car and hauling all of your stuff.  I much prefer a beach with less people.  I'm talking almost shoulder to shoulder.

reviews.title: "Our" beach in Poipu
reviews.text: Just few minutes from our Air B&B apartment... White sand, quite big waves but there was a shallow area good for snorkelling. And our neighbour on the beach was a big seal, just resting during the day. Very clear water, close to main accommodations and Brennecke's Restaurant ;-).

reviews.title: Great beach for beginner surfers
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach that has relatively shallow waters quite far out with smaller waves so it is great for beginner surfers.  Enjoy!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and area.
reviews.text: Located on one of many south shores, a must see if you like swimming, snorkeling, relaxing on the sand, watching the surfers try to stay on their boards or a little something different. Giant sea turtles sunning themselves in the sand, especially on the little island you can walk to. Just make sure you wear water socks or wet shoes, the rocks are very jagged to walk on barefoot.

reviews.title: Best spot to watch the sunset
reviews.text: This was my favorite place to watch the sunset! And turtles will come to shore to nest around that time too, its a good place to spot them.

reviews.title: Great beach for snorkeling
reviews.text: Sheltered cove with huge amounts of tropical fish, turtles, and sea lions. Snorkeling was great. Good beach for families.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: One of our favorite beaches in Kauai. A little kid side and a more mature side for swimming. Normally it has a cool land bridge that you have to see to appreciate. A lot of sea turtles on the area. And an occasional sea monk. Showers, restaurants and shopping nearby. And roosters in trees. Just go.

reviews.title: Fabulous experience.
reviews.text: Poipu beach  was probably the best beach we had been to in Kauai especially if you want to snorkel. Though it gets a little crowded.  But We got to see some beautiful marine life and lots of fishes.  You won’t be disappointed if you want to snorkel.

reviews.title: Great wading area for kids
reviews.text: Nice busy beach with great wading area for little kids, good snorkelling in shallow water. Food, shaved ice and rentals across the road.

reviews.title: The best snorkeling we had on the island.
reviews.text: This wonderful beach had great snorkeling. The current was relatively calm and I felt better knowing there was a lifeguard on duty because some beaches on Kauai can be dangerous.

reviews.title: Turtle
reviews.text: Beautiful seeing the turtles come up on shore to rest in the evening and watch the sunset. Very family friendly shore

reviews.title: Turtles and seals
reviews.text: Poipu is a beautiful beach where you can usually see turtles or Hawaiian monk seals. There does tend to be a lot of families with kids so if you’re looking for a quiet beach this probably isn’t your place. But if you’re interested in seeing some sea life it’s a good place to stop by.

reviews.title: Top Sunny Beach
reviews.text: If you have clouds or rain, go to Poipu. Most likely sunny. Good place to snorkel, see seals and large turtles. Another Kauai treasure. If you go to Kauai, don't bother staying at the resort, get out and see all the beaches and Poipu is a not miss.

reviews.title: Great public beach park
reviews.text: Truthfully the beach here is better than at many of the nearby resorts.  Parking is plentiful though if you come later in the day you will have to walk a ways.

reviews.title: Perfect day
reviews.text: Perfect day at this extraordinary beach. Awesome waves to practice surf and paddle surf. Best for snorkel.

reviews.title: Top Choice!
reviews.text: We were on Kauai for 8 days and stopped at Poipu Beach Park on the last day.  It's a good thing we didn't stop here on day 1, because we may not have gone to any other beach!  This beach is big.  It has restrooms.  It has picnic pavilions.  It has surfers.  It has seals.  It has turtles.  It has lots of free parking, palm trees, and rainbows, and lifeguards, and restaurants across the street.  It has it all!  By all means, visit every other beach you can while on Kauai, but don't miss this one!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Had the best time playing in the surf. The sunsets were a thing of beauty. If you are in Kauai you got to make it to Poipu beach

reviews.title: Great place to see turtles and seals
reviews.text: The area has much to offer.  There was surfing and boogie boarding on the beach.  We sat on volcano rocks by the shore and were treated to views of sea turtles and seals.  There are play sets for the kids, shelters, and picnic areas.  It rained briefly, so we saw a rainbow too.   Definitely a nice park/beach.  Go to eat at Bubba Burgers a few blocks away if you aren't picnicking on site.

reviews.title: Spotted two sea turtles and a seal. Nice beach if you have toddlers
reviews.text: Someone told me that seeing a sea turtle completes a trip to Hawaii. If you share the same sentiments, Poipu Beach is the place to be. We saw not one but two of these beautiful creatures hanging out on the sand getting some sun. Folks would stop by and take photos while keeping a good distance respecting the turtles' personal space. We even watched one of them crawl back and swim in the water. Such a fascinating thing to witness!Have small kids? The west side of the beach is perfect for your little ones as there are huge rocks blocking the waves forming almost a kiddie pool. Lifeguards were also on duty and you know they are doing their job as you hear them on megaphones warning swimmers or stubborn people trying to approach a seal on a little island several meters from the shore.The beach can be crowded for good reason but if you like swimming and being able to touch your feet on smooth sandy floor, you're not going to like it here. I would swim in the deeper end to avoid that, however, the waves can also be a challenge - just be careful. We got to see lots of fish here so bring your snorkeling gear or goggles.

reviews.title: One of my favorite beaches in Hawaii
reviews.text: A long beach with enough depth to accommodate the many users that appreciate it. Lots of parking (although I have seen the lot entirely flooded after heavy rains), plenty of hens with chicks for entertainment and often a resting spot for turtles and monk seals. Snorkeling is decent in spite of the number of swimmers. Obviously the better the beach the more the people. Take your pick.

reviews.title: best place we snorkeled
reviews.text: A bit crowded in the snorkeling area, but saw more fish there than any of the other places we snorkeled.

reviews.title: Too crowded!
