reviews.text: Nice beach but way too crowded for me. I did some snorkeling there and it was ok, but not great.  When I got out I left rather than sit around with the crowd of people on the shore.  Way too many people for such a small area.

reviews.title: Me the turtle and the fish on spring break + chickens
reviews.text: A great little beach with a touch of everything. Easy snorkeling close to the beach edge for beginners and families. It changes all day. Early morning you may catch a turtle or two. Late afternoon a whale in the horizon. But all day gosh to view. Nice vistas. It can get a little crowded but well worth the effort.

reviews.title: Rainbow blessing 2 days before wedding in Poipu
reviews.text: You tell us if we loved this beach!! Kid friendly. No coral for them.     Adults? Snorkeling great but you need shoes to go into water because it is over dead coral and slippery and sharp.

reviews.title: Busy, but nice sand beach
reviews.text: We went to Poipu Beach a couple of times during our stay on Kauai and enjoyed snorkeling and checking out the monk seals. The parking lot was pretty much full by 10 am. This was a good place to go to escape the rain from the north and east side of the island (they say it's usually sunny on the south side!).

reviews.title: Small beach
reviews.text: Using San Diego standard this is a small but nice beach. It can get very crowded. Parking can also get tough so it really depends when you are visiting.

reviews.title: Sweet snorkeling spot!!
reviews.text: We snorkeled here for hours on end, took naps on the beach and saw so many animals from sea turtles to monk seals and so much more!! The fish are beautiful and exotic...so much fun to swim with!! Found ourselves here multiple mornings to catch the sunrise which is when the turtles are just hanging out on the beach. Can get a little crowded here but all and all a great place to hang!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, great snorkeling
reviews.text: Great beach for snorkeling and monk seal sightings! Wear your water shoes as it is pretty rocky in areas.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Very family friendly beach - water is calmer compared to other beaches.  Most resorts are off this beach however so can get a bit packed

reviews.title: A great place to relax with picnic tables and restrooms
reviews.text: If you are in the Poi Pu area and don't want to travel too far to find a beach, go here.  There are restrooms, Clean by Kauai standards!  Picnic tables and Brennecke's bar and grill for some drinks and food.  Beautiful palm trees to lay out a blanket and enjoy the Hawaii sun and surf.  There is also a large area with shallow water and a lifeguard for the children to safely play in the ocean.

reviews.title: Beautiful parm
reviews.text: Beautiful beach that has a calm area for snorkeling. It also has a large grassy area that is nice. The snorkeling is good and you will see a variety of fish. You may also see sea turtles or monk seals. Only downside is on weekends you may not find parking.

reviews.title: GREAT SUN AND SNORKLE
reviews.text: Found a corner of the beach with minimal traffic (human) and a few curious chickens.  Snorkeling was better than most of the beaches we’ve frequented over our 10-day stay.  Would recommend to anyone looking for a good beach with easy access and snorkeling.

reviews.title: Nice beach, ok for swimming, great for snorkeling with fish
reviews.text: There were a lot of big rocks preventing full swim use of the beach.  There was a portion with no rocks that had lots of snorkelers in the nearby rocks due to tons of fish.  It’s great for snorkelling

reviews.title: An amazing beach but way too many people!
reviews.text: A beautiful beach and park.  We saw turtles and a seal up close on the beach. Very touristy and hard to find parking. Fairly clean, nicely landscaped grounds.  Roosters are abundant here and are jumping on the picnic tables while you consume food but are easily shooed away and are not aggressive.  We spent a lovely afternoon here and would go back.

reviews.title: Crowded, but beautiful
reviews.text: This beach is a beautiful, soft sand beach with very calm waters and an awesome sand bar you can get to by a short, but rocky wade across the water.  Snorkeling here was ideal with lots of fish to see. On our visit there was even a sea turtle hanging out on the beach.  There are showers and bathrooms on site, as well as a lifeguard, which makes it a great place to go for families.  Located just across the street was a restaurant, coffee house and shave ice shop.  Plenty of parking.  The only negative thing about this beach is it is very crowded.  We visited twice, at two different times and both times it was hard to find a place in the sand to call our own.

reviews.title: Watch out for the rocks
reviews.text: I like Poipu Beach. It has something for everyone--a wading area for kids, covered picnic tables, grass, restrooms, snorkel area, etc. However, if you enter the water near the wading area, there are quite a few slippery rocks and it is hard to get into the water, even with water socks on. I slipped getting out and gashed my knee. Move to the farther edge of the beach where there are less rocks and more fish. If you're lucky, you'll also see large turtles and monk seals.

reviews.title: Best Family Beach!
reviews.text: This beach is a must if you are vacationing with kids.  Shallow salt pool (aka "baby beach") was perfect for our 4-year old granddaughter.  She could have a beach experience without worrying about waves knocking her down.  One day we saw 3 sea turtles sunning right on baby beach and had to make a short walk to the other side to see a monk seal!  Easy place for young ones to snorkel, use their boogie boards or just play in the water and sand. Lots of shade, covered tables, and lifeguards on duty so pack a lunch and enjoy a great day.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Great beach with paddle boarding & snorkeling, the Mariot Resort is right there so food & drink nearby.

reviews.title: Quite crowded, could be cleaner.
reviews.text: This beach is heavily used by locals, which is fine, especially on holidays and weekends. The whole area could be kept cleaner. There are two lifeguard towers now and that's a huge plus.

reviews.title: Beautiful! Amazing snorkling
reviews.text: My favorite place to visit in Kauai! I could snorkle here for hours! beaches were kept up- has rinse off area and close parking.

reviews.title: Family friendly beach experience
reviews.text: The beach park is well maintained and has some nice amenities, including good restrooms and covered picnic facilities. The bay is terrific for snorkeling because it is somewhat protected. We were able to see large turtles come ashore nightly to sleep on the sand, a wonderful phenomenon of nature to be able to observe. There is a great rental shop directly across the street and Brennecke's restaurant, a local spot with great food & drink.

reviews.title: Great family beach spot
reviews.text: Check the prevailing winds when you stay on the island.  It was quite breezy and drizzly on the east side at Kapaa where were staying so we loaded up the snorkel gear and headed to the south side at Poipu.  It was protected somewhat from the wind with plenty of sunshine.  Enjoyed the beach with 500+ other people and lots of chickens aka Red Jungle Fowl and a couple of sea turtles who ambled up onto the beach right among the beach towels and made their spot!  Snorkeling was great with fish almost to the shoreline.

reviews.title: Busy popular beach
reviews.text: This is a very pretty but crowded beach.  There was a monk seal resting on the beach and also several turtles. This is a common occurrence and neat to see. Some snorkeling and you can swim but there isn’t a large sandy entry to the water.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach area in Poipu is very pretty sandy beaches, surrounded by condo's. The beaches are all public, but sometimes parking is difficult. We saw a monk seal on the beach, which was really fun!

reviews.title: Busy Beach with Amazing Sunsets
reviews.text: We stayed within walking distance of Poipu Beach nd would walk down to the beach every morning to check for Monk Seals and Turtles and to whale watch. Still whale season in March.A few mornings there were 2-3 monk seals bathing/sleeping on the beach. They actually rope them off when they come to shore so people cant get too close. Done by volunteers and they will answer any questions you have about the seals. We also saw sea turtles on the beach a few mornings as wellIf you drive, there is lots of free parking as well. Restrooms, picnic tables, all available. The beach does get extremely busy during peak hours 11-4. Lots of snorkelling in the bay as well...This is a great spot to come to watch the sunsets around 6:30pm. Spectacular ! Lots of people down here at the beach at this time of night. There is a great restaurant across the street called Brennekes and almost right it is Nukumoi surf shop. You can rent snorkeliing gear, surf boards, boogie boards, SUP boards and they have a nice gift shop as well.If you are staying on the island in a different area, you must come check it out for a day or half day

reviews.title: Snorkel heaven!
reviews.text: We rented snorkel gear and headed to Poipu Beach...it was great! Beautiful clear water and lots of fish. Somone told us we missed dolphins ... that would have been nice. There was also a monk seal on the beach...highly protected by a ranger and cool to see up cloae.

reviews.title: Beautiful fish, and even a few monk seals lounging
reviews.text: Very much enjoyed Poipu Beach. It is a lifeguarded beach that boasts occasional monk seals and the variety of fish was really colorful. Unfortunately, people have destroyed the coral so there was not much living coral to see. I would go there again!

reviews.title: Most Fish Seen Snorkeling
reviews.text: This beach is CROWDED for a reason. Lots of fish close to shore, lifeguard, protected cove (wear water shoes!), free parking, bathrooms, easy access. The crowds are the only negative on this beach but I can’t blame everyone. We even saw a seal sunning amidst the crowds (everyone knows about this beach).

reviews.title: Nice place to snorkel and see turtles
reviews.text: If you don't want to drive to far and have a relatively safe place to snorkel then you have come to the right spot.  There are several parking lots near by.  The restrooms have a changing area and showers outside of them to wash off the salt after swimming or snorkeling.  We have seem plenty of fish on our trips and turtles on most trips to this beach.

reviews.title: Snorkeling gem
reviews.text: Of all the beaches advertising good snorkeling, this is the better one.  Anini, Lydgate,etc are not worth the trip.  Poipu has a nice protective cove, plenty of fish, sea anemones to make the day a nice experience....

reviews.title: Surf and Turtles and Seals, oh My!
reviews.text: From the coarse black and tan sand to the presence of Monk Seals and Sea Turtles every day that we visited, this beach held our interest for more than just sunning and swimming.  The wildlife is closely protected by a posse of volunteers who are very knowledgeable about the creatures who choose this beach as a place to sleep in the day. There are lifeguards, bathrooms and chair rental place nearby as well.

reviews.title: perfect beach for all
reviews.text: Play equipment and protected children area with  life guards, excellent snorkeling, swimming and whale watching.  Monk seals and turtles frequesnt beach area.  Brenecke Beach 100 yards away is trated best boogei board beach in Kauai. Deli and Restaurant and bar.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: We visited the beach to do some swimming and snorkeling. It is a sandy beach along a cove with life guard. Saw lots of different fish while snorkeling. The bottom is mostly rock with a little bit of coral. It is one of the safer beaches in  Poipu.

reviews.title: Everything You Want a Beach to Have
reviews.text: This is our go-to beach since it is close to our hotel. This beach has all the amenities you need:1. Ample parking2. Picnic benches3. Bathrooms4. Life guard5. Great for snorkeling6. A side beach suitable for young children7. A coffee shop and a restaurant nearby to rest, get refreshed and relax with a meal or a drink8. Nice soft sand so you can lie down with simply a beach towel; or you can bring a lounge chair if you want9. Low waves so very safe

reviews.title: Great place to see turtles and whales!
reviews.text: We walked to the beach from our resort and it was a great place to see turtles playing and whales breeching!  It was best early in the day and not crowded at all

reviews.title: Nice,Quiet Place to Have Coffee and Read
reviews.text: Its nice but the beach is little rocky. Its far away from traffic and other noise if you want to sit and read. Lots of wildlife  (fowl) walking around. There are facilities open to the public including parking and bathrooms.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Great beach and good snorkeling - parking was quite easy and really well.worth spending a few hours here.

reviews.title: Monk Seals on the Beach
reviews.text: We went to Poipu Beach for the Snorkeling( it did NOT disappoint) I saw almost every Fish that was on the Flyer given out at the Snorkel shop~   But the Monk Seals were a fun Bonus....Beautiful Beach and not horrible crowded .....

reviews.title: Great easy snorkeling breach
reviews.text: Tons of fish. There is a break water so lots of area with no waves that makes it easy get in and out of the water and snorkel without worrying about the surf. There are rocks, but you need that to have lots of fish. Just bring water shoes or wear trekking sandals. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Too rocky
reviews.text: Beach is beautiful and full of fish and even sea lions but don’t forget water shoes.  Cannot enjoy water at all without them. This beach also has a ton families... so make sure to bring ear phones...

reviews.title: great beach
reviews.text: Very for good for beginner snorkeling ! the fish we abundant to say the least. beach was quite crowed and due to Monk seals part of the beach was closed. there is of course plenty of grassy areas to sit as well.

reviews.title: Pretty water
reviews.text: Not a huge amount of sand, but enough for walking, watch out for volcanic rock. Best to sit and enjoy the view!

reviews.title: Sweet Little Beach
reviews.text: Located on the generally sunny south side of Kauai. Nice beach with great zero depth protected area for little kids and babies. Restrooms, showers, picnic tables, pavilions. Adequate parking. Restaurant (Bennecke’s, a local favorite), coffee shop/deli, and beach store across the street. Super family friendly, but fine for couples, too.  Come early to get a picnic table or prime spot on the beach. Good snorkeling around the small island connected (at times) to the beach.

reviews.title: Family Friendly Beach - Great Snorkelling!
reviews.text: This became a daily trip for our family as we were staying within walking distance! The water was perfect and I couldn’t believe how amazing the snorkelling is!You must bring a mask if you’re going to come and spend some time on this beach; so many beautiful fish to swim with!

reviews.title: Next to Waiohai
reviews.text: A great beach for sun or swimming.  Lots of people, but always room for one or two more.  Picnic tables near by.  Maybe a monk seal on the beach.  Water is calm.

reviews.title: Great Snorkeling
reviews.text: Surprisingly, there is great snorkeling here, even though the coral is all walked upon and dead. It looks like you are swimming in an aquarium with all the different fish. I liked the snorkeling right next to the little kids' swimming area.

reviews.title: Sunny Beach
reviews.text: Love how sunny this beach is!  Great place to snorkel and lay on the beach.  Monk seals and turtles come ashore and rest.

reviews.title: Excellent Beach
reviews.text: We were staying at a rental apartment in Poipu and could walk to this beach which is good since it's hard to park near the beach on a busy day. The beach is nice sand and the sand extends well out into the water with some exceptions. There's a protected area for children and during the winter the swells that come in are supposed to usually be pretty small. There's refreshments across the road.

reviews.title: Some pretty good snorkeling
reviews.text: Nice beach, a bit rocky but par for the course for many Hawaii beaches. Always a treat to be able to snorkel a few feet from your beach chair so this is a place worth visiting!

reviews.title: A favorite place on Kauai
reviews.text: Large beach with plenty of sand, plenty of grassy area adjacent and close to public parking. Lifeguards on duty, and plenty of Kauai chickens. Swim, roast in the sun, paddle board or surf, even snorkel if you are ok with the water not being clear all the time. Every time we've been there we've seen seals or turtles. Plenty of room for fun, and nice views at sunset.

reviews.title: Best place to watch the sunset
reviews.text: Wonderful beach for snorkeling in the winter.  Lots of fish and usually a turtle or two!  Breathtaking sunset view as well.

reviews.title: Great snorkling beach
reviews.text: Great beach for families. We enjoyed snorkling here. Terrific location to watch the sunset. Good parking too.

reviews.title: Plenty of action-lifegaurd also
reviews.text: Large beach, sand, and swimming.  With the public beach comes many people, lifegaurds on duty and limited space.    Plenty of fish to see and calm water to let the little ones play.

reviews.title: Great Beach!
reviews.text: We went to this beach because the waves on the east side of the island were too big for swimming.  While the beach is small, there is a very large grassy area for sunning and picnicking and some shady areas if you need to get out of the sun.  The waves were a good size, but great for body surfing or using a boogie board. At times there were so many boogie boarders that one had to be careful where you were if you body surfing or just wave jumping.  Many people were snorkeling.  I jumped the waves with three sea turtles.  They seemed to enjoy being around people and would bump into me periodically!  It was so awesome. Parking is limited, so get there early.  It also limits the crowds of people.

reviews.title: Nice beach, great sealife!
reviews.text: Great sandy beach, nice views but the best part is the wildlife: snorkeling in 10' of water just 40' from the beach had dozens of fish of at least fifteen species. We even ran into a 3' female sea turtle browsing on the bottom!Just across the street is a great snorkel equipment rental place.

reviews.title: Poipu Beach is busy but worth it!
reviews.text: We went to Poipu Beach two times over a week span as it was raining on the east side of the island and we wanted some beach time, so the south side of the island is the place to go during the winter months (or according to the islanders the "weeks" of their winter - which is January and February). It was very busy both times and hard to find parking, but we finally did and enjoyed watching the surfers and playing in the water.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: Nice Beach! Great little spot for swimming, without the giant waves. The Monk Seals like to sun on this beach. We got to see them. The wife saw lots of fish and some Turtles. Great visit!!

reviews.title: Nice beach with local wildlife
reviews.text: We walk along the beach front which is fairly easy at low tide, a bit harder at high tide as the walkway goes through some hotels.We also came across a monk seal sunning itself on the beach, they put cones around the seal so people don't get to close to it.

reviews.title: Huge Turtles!
reviews.text: We saw a turtle every time we stopped by. Total highlight for our kids! They're very careful about drawing boundaries around the turtles so you don't get too close and keep the turtles safe!

reviews.title: Awesome beach
reviews.text: Great place to go with kids!I’m told monk seals hang out there but we did not see them.Sheltered area for kids but fight off a road so watch for runners.

reviews.title: Overcrowded beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach that’s overrun with people. Inadequate parking from quite a distance away. Walking down the beach further doesn’t get ant less crowded because of all the resorts.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling spot!
reviews.text: If you're looking for a good snorkeling spot on Kauai this is it! It can get a little crowded in the shallow areas with little kids but swim further out and it's perfect! We saw several turtles swimming around out there! Plenty of fish too. The park is nice, lots of bathrooms and showers. Very family friendly! Lot's of kids bday parties and family get togethers when we went. There is a snorkel and surf shop across the street where we rented our snorkel gear. Lots of options you won't be bored!

reviews.title: Great beach with soft sand
reviews.text: Poipu Beach has awesome sand compared to other places on Kauai. We ran into some rocks and coral but a little further out.Poipu sees more sun than other parts of the island so I’d recommend staying in the area or at least hitting the beach when you’re on Kauai. We saw Hawaiian monk seals resting on the beach multiple nights. This beach also makes for great sunrises.

reviews.title: Good for family
reviews.text: Safe beach for kids and a nice new playground. Teens and adults can easily snorkel outside the kids area, too.

reviews.title: Poipu Beach Park
reviews.text: Park is beautiful with great beach.  Water was clear enough to see fish swimming around.  Nestled on beach were 2 monk seals and turle.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: This is a very good beach for watching wildlife of allSorts both above the ocean and underwater .the snorkeling is great and you can see a wide variety of tropical sea creatures including eels,parrot fish ,clown fish ,kite fish ,butterfly fish,snappers,yellow tang,moorish idol,goat fish ,black trigger fish,trumpet fish etc.in addition to that we saw a pair of male Hawaiian monk seals beached on the sands and a huge green sea turtle was lazing around on the beach as well.there is also a small protected area for kids to play around in the water as well which is well protected by the ferocious waves.excellent place to chill out and enjoy time with your family of all ages.life guards are also present from 9 am-5 pm.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice beach, but ocean floor is very rocky. Sand rather course. Further down near the Sheraton the beach was a bit nicer. A little tough to believe this beach is touted as one of the top beaches in America. Maui beaches much nicer if comparing or making a decision between both islands.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Truly recommend this beach that has a lovely clean lagoon, showers and public restrooms, as well as life guards that makes it super safe , close by you can what hard surfers while enjoying beach of very soft and clean sand. Some people live it for snorkelling and spotted there turtles and loads of fish. Perfect for families with kids , alder people and less able as there is access point , in the grass part you can find public bbq’s and shelters with tables and benches.

reviews.title: Turtles and seals, oh my
reviews.text: Great local beach.   Seems to be a gathering place for locals, but of course, many tourists, like me.  Easy access.  Nice snorkle spot.  Went there almost every day.

reviews.title: Best variety of fish,  made me nervous though!
reviews.text: Plenty of signs about rip currents made me too nervous to just let me kids go wherever they wanted, only a couple spots that seemed really protected.   However,  I couldn't believe how many different kinds of fish we saw.  I also hadn't yet seen a seal or a turtle and I saw both here!!  I was swimming close to shore and looked up to see a big brown figure right in front of me- it was a gorgeous turtle!  May have been the same one we saw sunning earlier.   Give them some space, if you see a seal, you must give them a good 20 feet or you could be fined!!    Also saw a needle fish!  Worth checking out Poipu!!

reviews.title: Trips to PoiPu State Park
reviews.text: During our visit, we were able to make a short walk to this fantastic beach!  On the way, we could spot sea turtles playing in the surf and monk seals lying in the sun on the rocks!  The beach is perfect for young and old with an area protected from the surf and a beautiful sand bottom that the little ones could enjoy!

reviews.title: Great Local Beach
reviews.text: This is a great location been here with the family and just my wife and I, great serene views, clear water and great for snorkeling, lots of fish to see, Locals teach their kids to surf here! Bring a picnic and enjoy!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Spent 2 days walking around and sitting on the beach. Fantastic. Both days a huge sea turtle showed up and came onto the beach to sleep. Also two Monk seals beached themselves to sleep as well. Very clean. Had a blast. Highly recommend.Jim from Chicago

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviews.text: This is a gorgeous beach.  There are lifeguards.  I did not go in the water, so I don't know if currents are strong here.  There is an area that is rocky, which might make for interesting snorkeling and walking in amongst the rocks looking for fun artifacts.  I don't know if this happens year-around, but certainly in Feb, it is a common occurrence for an endangered monk seal to swim up on to the sand in the morning and spend the day resting and sunning.  that was, most certainly, a wonderful treat for us to see!

reviews.title: Pretty little park!
reviews.text: A great little area to walk to from the Hyatt hotel.  Saw some turtles on our way, and ate at the restaurant across the street!

reviews.title: TURTLES GALORE
reviews.text: The turtles come up on the beach at night here and as you walk the beach you can see them all piled together. This beach is also a great place during the day for families. Great sand. Great snorkling close to shore. We saw some people trying to surf out a ways but noticed there's not a lot of room where the surf is. Lots of hotels along this beach.

reviews.title: Seals, Snorkelling and Surfing
reviews.text: Poipu is a lovely, compact beach with a classic palm tree backdrop, and in late January was a lovely spot to swim in the surf on one side of the island divide and snorkel with the tropical fish in a child safe lagoon on the other.Given how thin the strip of sand is, and the resorts which back it, it easily fills up, though out of season there was plenty of free space on the sand.There were seals snoozing on the island and beach the days we were there, and the snorkelling is wonderful - step straight off the beach in to a fantastic array of tropical fish.But make sure you have reef shoes, even on the surf side, as there are rocks everywhere ready to cut open your hands and feet. The park behind has plenty of grass and covered picnic tables. Toilets and change rooms are dated but functional and there are showers on the beach to wash off after the surf and a cafe and takeaway store a short walk away.parking is plentiful and free right behind the beach.

reviews.title: Best place to see turtles and the Hawaiian Monk Seal
reviews.text: Amazing spot to see the Monk Seal and variety of turtles in the beach. Beach really rocky but worth the show for the seal and turtles.

reviews.title: Too much park, not enough beach
reviews.text: Not what we were expecting or looking for. Way too many people, lots of kids, and so many picnics. Not a relaxing beach atmosphere at all but more like a grassy park. Probably great if you have little ones and are looking for a spot to picnic and play - not great if you're looking to sunbathe and lounge.

reviews.title: Large park with good beach access.
reviews.text: Great place to spend time on the beach, but at times can get crowded.  Good place to watch the sunset.

reviews.title: Follow the sun
reviews.text: We traveled south from Princeville to the only area not raining. Found easy parking and access to the beach. Although windy, the water was great for snorkeling. The monk seals and sea turtles were sleeping on the shore for all the tourists to admire. Great day at Poipu Beach.

reviews.title: Great place to be!
reviews.text: To me and my family it was one of the best beaches of Kauai, just after the Salt Pond Beach. It is a nice place, little rocky on one side, but pretty good on the other. There is a place with lots of fish - great entertainment for kids. Little waves make this place kids friendly also.That dude on the pic below was chilling with us too :-)

reviews.title: Seals Sunning
reviews.text: Loved the water, snorkeling, and hanging out with the adorable lazy monk seals who didn't seem to mind our company at all. Adults had tons of fun snorkeling while the kiddos (3,18 months, and 20 months) had tons of fun in the calm "baby beach" area and could wade in on their own while they played in the sand without us having to be directly next to them every second. Great place for the whole family.

reviews.title: Whales!
reviews.text: A beautiful section of the island. We had a great time walking and enjoying ourselves. Another great spot is Shipwreck Beach.

reviews.title: Whale Watching!
reviews.text: Everyday we saw 15-20 whales pass by along with being serenaded with clucking chickens!  Nice place to stop and enjoy the Pacific Ocean!

reviews.title: Great snorkeling
reviews.text: We went here to go snorkeling. Free parking, Sandy entry to water and very colorful and plentiful fish are very close to shore. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Busy and beautiful
reviews.text: Gorgeous spot. Not the best for swimming but good enough to cool off in. The beach itself is well maintained and clean! Great spot! Really enjoyed the protection of the seals as well!

reviews.title: Great place to see the seals and sea turtles.
reviews.text: If you go to the south shore of Kauai be sure to visit Poipu Beach Park early in the morning or evening. We saw a seal asleep on the sand in the morning and turtles come  in to rest at night.

reviews.title: Best place on the Island!
reviews.text: Have been to Kauai many times and always stay in Poipu. Great beach, love seeing turtles and seals daily. Very friendly part of HI. Ready to book another vacation here.

reviews.title: Turtles, warm water, beautiful park with shade. Great Spot.
reviews.text: We could walk to this park and beach from our condo. It's a perfect combination of beach, and park. There are bathrooms, showers, chickens, shaded picnic tables and soft grass. There's a lifeguard on duty, kept busy having to remind tourists to give the big turtles their space. You can picnic or go into Brenneckes for food and adult beverages. We rented chairs and an umbrella for a week, best deal, next door at Nukumoi Surf Shop. Great family spot.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Has everything you would want.  Shade, sun, grass ,sand, smirking. Great for families. Has bathrooms which are not the cleanest. That's the reason I didn't give it a five star rating.

reviews.title: Beach review
reviews.text: This is a pretty decent beach, except it has a lot of rocks and to many people for my liking. We prefer the beaches on the north end of Kauai

reviews.title: Beautiful and calming.
reviews.text: Po’ipu is on the opposite side of Kauai from where I stayed in Princeville. The actual vibe was also opposite to that of the north shore. Calm and relaxed, with a great shopping complex nearby.

reviews.title: Bring swim shoes
reviews.text: The shoreline is extremely rocky so you’ll need foot protection. Enjoyed seeing the monk seal snoozing on the beach.

reviews.title: Great little beach
reviews.text: Perfect sand, nice ledge about 10 out off the shore line. There are sections that has either rock or coral (Idk) that can make it a challenge to stand but those areas are pretty small.... Pro tip- wear water shoes and you can easily get around in the water and no one will be near you - - - because they don't have water socks! It's what I did to get some space from the other beach goers. The sunsets from this beach are absolutely stunning. Best on the island hands down!

reviews.title: Friendly Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful view as you walk down the Greenbelt walkway to this family friendly beach. One area is shallow and sandy for little ones and the other area is rocky but perfect for snorkeling. We saw so many fish without going very far into the water. The days we were there several sea turtles climbed on the beach. The park itself has play equipment, picnic tables and shelters and the beach has a lifeguard. A little farther down the beach is another swimming area in front of the Marriott and a sandbar for exploring. A restaurant, deli and beach store are right in front of beach.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling for beginners
reviews.text: Decent beach but pretty rocky. Has lifeguards and bathrooms. Stone breakwaters help with waves. Tons of fish for snorkeling!

reviews.title: Unforgettable Snorkling!
reviews.text: We started out finding a shady spot at the beach while my boys played in the water, there is a resort in the background and the beach can get a little crowded. When we were done with swimming, we saw some people snorkelling and we thought we'd give it a try. It was an incredible experience, there were SO MANY fish in clear water that you could see with your naked eyes...we were swimming with them. I don't know whey we bothered paying money at Hanuma Bay a fey days prior when we could enjoy unlimited fish time here :)

reviews.title: Warm and clear waters.
reviews.text: We went there two times during our trip.  Saw 3 turtles lying on the beach and one monk seal.  Pretty cool I'd say.  Also, the water is very warm and clear.  Many people were snorkeling but you don't even need that.  Just look down and colorful fish will swim right past you.  The water is shallow and gets chest deep farther in.I would suggest to wear swimming shoes since it's quite rocky but smooth in the water with some sand bars.

reviews.title: Very Good Snorkeling and nice beacj
reviews.text: We visited Friday late morning/early afternoon.  There were a lot of people there but we easily found a spot to sit.  The snorkeling was very good.

reviews.title: NO WONDER IT WAS CROWDED
reviews.text: We visited on a warm weekend in December. The soft sand, lifeguards, picnic tables, restrooms and beautifully colorful fish just feet off shore, made for a terrific day. We even got to see monk seals resting on the beach, one of which was pregnant. We met several super helpful people who shared their knowledge of the seals and the snorkeling. Became hooked on snorkeling and Poipu beach!

reviews.title: Good snorkeling
reviews.text: This is a great protected beach to snorkel in especially in the winter when the surf is higher. Saw lots of fish and turtles.

reviews.title: Perfect day
reviews.text: Poipu beach is fabulous for families, couples, friends and gatherings.  Perfect snorkeling, life guards on duty, family friendly beach and swimming. Turtles, fish, and monk seals can be seen most days.  Walks along the beach and up the road are safe and you never know what you might discover.  Sand is gorgeous, perfect plac eto picnic and wath the sunset.

reviews.title: Family beach, great for snorkeling
reviews.text: We drove 70+ minutes twice from Princeville to enjoy this beach for the day. The snorkeling is excellent and easily accessible, plus there is a good-sized protected shallow sandy area perfect for children to play in safely. There are also two lifeguards, two bathrooms, a playground, and plenty of parking. If you forgot anything, there’s a beach rental right across the street. Plus, we saw sea turtles and monk seals resting on the beach both days! Great beach - worth the drive!! Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Available to all
reviews.text: There is even a kiddie pool in the ocean! Who knew! This beach was within walking distance of us, and made a wonderful stopping place. Parking was across the street at a municipal lot, there were picnic tables under shade, bathrooms, and a wonderful beach. You could even wade out to the small island. Like all ocean beaches, currents must be watched for to keep everyone safe!

reviews.title: Great location, easy access and wonderful facilities.
reviews.text: Lifeguards on duty, easy access to snorkeling. Spent the whole day and had so much to see and do. Something for everyone. Saw 4 turtles on the beach, a Hawaiian Monk Seal, whales, so many fish, birds galore and of course Roosters and chickens.

reviews.title: Great Family Beach to Explore
reviews.text: Poipu Beach is a great place to relax & enoy this wonderful family beach with locals & tourists alike...soft surf makes for easy snorkeling..long beaches with shallow water make it fun to explore for the whole family...Marine life can be seen from shore out to deeper waters for all to enjoy.

reviews.title: Great little beach
reviews.text: Gentle surf, easy snorkeling. Average depth is about 4 foot through the whole cove. Great sand to sit on, and there’s a sandy area in the water for the kids, but 75% of the cove (in the water) is rock/coral so bring water shoes. There’s also a big Grady area with tables and shade. There are 2 restrooms, pretty clean for public beach restrooms, and here are a couple showers. 3 Hawaiian green sea turtles joined in on the beach as well as some monk seals. Very cool. Snorkeling is good/basic with a wide variety of tropical fish. Very shallow, but makes for an easy day of relaxing.

reviews.title: Pleasant surprise
reviews.text: Beaches abound in the Islands.  Poipu was an unexpected surprise.  Low key beach town. Beautiful long beaches. Surf shops to reasonably rent all you'll need for a full day of snorkeling in crystal clear waters among plentifully fish to surround you. Bring chairs and an umbrella for shade. There are only a few tables and benches, and the shade is cast by scattered palms. Food was good but a bit pricy in a beachside restaurant. Go for the humongous desserts. All around good time.

reviews.title: Really Nice Views
reviews.text: Great views.  Easy parking.  Lots of marine activity off shore including breaching whales and more.  Very nice quick stop.

reviews.title: Nice beach but strong surf.
reviews.text: The beach is nice with a nice Park. The water is a little rough. There is a nice children beach area. We saw monk seals and sea turtles early every morning. What a treat!

reviews.title: Great snorkeling beach
reviews.text: Tons of fish which swim right by your faceProtected cove Reduces surf Recommend finding sand beds for entrance into surfLifeguard on beachWent 3 days back to back and easily found a spotFor suntanning Returned at sunset saw whales out about 1/4 mile

reviews.title: Great beach!
reviews.text: Great beach with lots of parking across the road. Lifeguards, pavilions, picnic tables, playground for the kiddies, restrooms. Lots of grass before you get to the sand/beach. Nice shady areas.

reviews.title: Great place to snorkel!
reviews.text: Saw a large sea turtle and a white eel. Last time we saw a seal and 2 turtles. Usually a seal laying on the shore. Sometimes a turtle. Lots of people, but that’s because there is a lot of sea life in the water here. Well worth the visit. Sometimes a Ukelele lesson at the pavilion. Haven’t had any current problems at this beach when we visited, but we follow the rules.  Pacific waters can be very dangerous though so don’t turn your back on the ocean when visiting Hawaii. Waves come in sets and then there are rogue waves, but if you are careful you will have a great time.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: We loved seeing the seals here and walking around the beach. Great snorkeling and saw turtles and lots of fish.

reviews.title: Nice Public Beach
reviews.text: This public beach is very popular as it is tucked in next to the Sheraton and several other condo complexes. There is a lawn area and basic park facilities.  But parking can be tricky as there are only a very few public spots adjacent to the park. Many visitors seem to park down the public street aways.

reviews.title: Nice beach but crowded
reviews.text: One of the nice things about this beach park is that there is a lifeguard.  There are a couple areas great for toddlers and we also saw a lot of people snorkeling.  But there can be a lot of waves and rocks.  As someone said the beach extends to the Sheraton but not really-you have to climb through an area of rocks to walk all that way.  It seems to be popular with families.  There is quite a deep area of sand which is nice too.

reviews.title: A very relaxed place to be.
reviews.text: We stayed in one of the condos just a few hundred meters from the park and used and walked through the park daily.   A good deal of care was given in the cleaning and general appearance in the park.  We were there at Christmas when the beaches were filled but the park remained open and not crowded.

reviews.title: Overcorwded and dangerously rocky
reviews.text: We came to check out this famous beach after lunch, and it was packed with people, like a can of sardines.  Parking was nearly impossible in the afternoon.  Once we found a spot we were stunned with how crowded the beach was.  There are large parking lots here and all spaces were taken.  The beach has showers, picnic tables, and bathrooms.  There is a protected cove for kids to swim, and the rest of the beach for adults.  The entry into the water is a solid piece of stone and the ocean bottom is incredibly rocky.  The beach area towards the large hotels was much less crowded.  We found a shady spot under a palm tree, on the grassy lawn facing the beach.  Getting a little peace here was not possible either because of the constant football throwing by guys showing off their machismo.  This place felt like a tourist trap.

reviews.title: Wedding and vacation
reviews.text: Beach extends from Sheraton And is a beautiful stretch of sand to behold and which stretches to Shipwreck Beach

reviews.title: Nice clean beach
reviews.text: Nice day with the teens and husband.  Beach not very crowded and surf great for boogie boarding and snorkeling.  Pack a lunch and coolers for drinks and enjoy the sun.  We also rent chairs by the week from the local surf shops for 15.00

reviews.title: Awesome! MUST visit.
reviews.text: Great place to spend the day. Currents can be swift between the beach and the island but there is plenty of areas to swim away from the current. Watchful Lifeguards on duty that are happy to show you where to swim away from the current. Great day.

reviews.title: Great Snorkeling for Rookies!
reviews.text: This is one of our favorite snorkeling spots.  You are guaranteed to see a number of colorful fish.  If your lucky, you will catch a Monk Seal an Green Sea Turtle resting on the beach.  However, DON'T get near them!  They are special and protected!  Just view from afar, as you won't see them much at home.  The bonus, is that there are lifeguards on this beach.  It is certain to be crowded, but if you are just snorkeling, you won't even notice!  Just hard to find a place to park and drop your gear!  Pack a lunch and make a day of it.

reviews.title: Great beach for kids
reviews.text: This was the perfect place for a beach day with our kids. A great unexpected sight was seeing napping sea turtles and a monk seal on the beach. People could do a better job keeping their distance from the turtles. There are calm sandy areas perfect for wading through and playing. Also it’s a nice place for some beginner snorkeling with a variety of fish to see, no coral though. Another section in front of the Sheraton has smaller waves ideal for boogie boarding. Across the street there is a surf shop that had everything available for rent like beach chairs, umbrellas, and boogie boards.

reviews.title: A lovely park for all ages
reviews.text: This is a perfect family spot for everyone from the surfers to a protected kids wading pool. It has nice white sand beaches with nearby shops for food and drinks.

reviews.title: Great! If you dont mind heavy crowds
reviews.text: Very good for snorkelling. Lifeguards all around. Probably the busiest beach in all of kauai. If you do not like crowds...go early!

reviews.title: Turtles and monk seals
reviews.text: Turtles and monk seals here every day! Be sure to give them the appropriate distance...also snorkeling here is good in the winter, there is a calm pool with many types of fish. Place to rent gear across the road. Not a fan of the boogie boarding beach to the left, it's called breakneck beach for a reason!

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: This is an ok spot for families but this is not nearly as good of a beach as others you'll find on Kauai.

reviews.title: Good place to enjoy the beach with your family and snorkel
reviews.text: We came here to snorkel and to sit on the beach. The lifeguards were very attentive as some travelers were not aware of their lack of safety in the water. It was not overly crowded and it was a beautiful day. There were pavilions to have lunch in the shade.  Bathrooms were typical of beach bathrooms.

reviews.title: Turtles, monk seals, easy snorkeling- and packed with people.
reviews.text: We love Poipu beach for the snorkelling - my 10 year old son had the time of his life snorkelling alongside a turtle. We saw several turtles right up on the beach, which was amazing to see. Also, there are monk seals that frequently sunbathe here. This is an easy place for young kids to snorkel and see all kinds of fish. But be warned- this is a very popular beach and it does get crowded. There is a big parking lot across the street and we didn't have issues finding a spot either time we went, but we also arrived there in late morning, and it tended to get pretty full by mid-afternoon.

reviews.title: Loved It!!!
reviews.text: What a beautiful beach.  I walked the beach several days on our visit and each time I was struck by the beauty

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: It is second best beaches in Kauai next to Anini beach. Great for kids since there is reef area and no big waves there. We saw many turtles towards sunset.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: We visited many beaches in Kauai and Poipu is one of the finest beach we've been to in Kauai.Beautiful sand beach with picnic area, restrooms and close by restaurants , you dont need anything more than that.

reviews.title: Came for seals
reviews.text: It’s a very small beach.  Mostly came to see the monk seals that come up on shore during the day.  Volunteers sit and guard them.  They are roped off.  But the volunteers are friendly and will answer any questions you may have

reviews.title: Beautiful and Very Crowded
reviews.text: Lovely and very popular beach. Boogie boarding, snorkeling and swimming...with a thousand other people. This is a beautiful and very popular location. Still worth the visit but plan to fight for parking in high tourist season. Spotted several green sea turtles from the rocks away from the beach area.

reviews.title: Relaxed, good famil snorkling and body surfing
reviews.text: Park is open and available for short walk or parking.  There are two areas, on east side is good for body surfing and west is good for small children and easy snorkling

reviews.title: Very small
reviews.text: The other side of the road is filled with hotels that only have a tiny patch of beach, so I imagine this also relatively small beach becoming easily packed.

reviews.title: Good for many reasons
reviews.text: You can snorkel, suntan, walk and see turtles and monk seals here every day.  We stay nearby, but it’s worth a drive here, especially with kids.  I’ve been here 4 times now, for a total of maybe 25 days, and I’ve seen sea turtles most days by Brennekes.  Just walk around the little cove, look into the waves and watch for them!

reviews.title: Great snorkeling
reviews.text: We stay in Poipu every year.  It is the best beach - safe to swim, snorkeling is awesome, people watching, lots of monk seals - plenty to keep you entertained!

reviews.title: An Average Beach, Until We Noticed the Sea Turtles
reviews.text: This was the beach closest to where we stayed (Aston at Poipu Kay). It just seemed like your average beach, until fellow beachgoers pointed out the three sea turtles in the surf, along with us frolicking there.  It was pretty neat to see them in their natural environment, and not just in an aquarium... and yes, people were being respectful of the animals and keeping clear of them. I think seeing them made my 9 year old's trip!

reviews.title: Amazing beach for snorkeling!
reviews.text: This is one of our favorite beaches on Kauai.  Awesome place to snorkel.  Calm waters due to the surrounding reef.  Clear water, even at midday.  Abundance of tropical fish as soon as you put your face in the water.  Even had a sea turtle and a Hawaiian Monk Seal on the beach.  Plenty of parking, but it can fill up on a busy day.

reviews.title: Wonderful Warm Beach with Great Waves; wear beach shoes for optimal enjoyment!!
reviews.text: We visited with our adult children we had such a good time we came back 3 days in a row. Would suggest beach shoes for optimal enjoyment. Sun is hot 🥵 beware of burning backs😅

reviews.title: Excellent family beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach. It’s a bit touristy, but there is an excellent protected area for small children and pretty good snorkeling. There are also life guards on duty, showers, reasonably clean restrooms, and covered picnic tables. The Poipu area is very nice with lots of shops and restaurants.

reviews.title: Best Beach ...
reviews.text: This beach covers everything.  Sandy, rocky, black rocks, rocking waves, gentle waves.  This trip we’ve seen MANY turtles and several Monk Seals, which rest on the beach.  If you go to the pond/in front of Brenneke’s at night, you may see a lot of turtles coming in to rest.  In and out of the water.  Bring a flashlight.  They are amazing.  We lucked out and saw 2 during the day — one right by a seal!  It’s always an adventure to go see what may be on the beach each day.  Sightings usually result in the seal/turtle being roped off for their, and the visitors’, safety.  For the seals they will have a sign stating the sex and age of the seal, sunning itself while many onlookers take pictures.  Usually there is a volunteer there also, answering questions.   Poipu Beach is also a great place for snorkeling and paddle boarding or surfing (or watching others do these things).  And there’s always the sunsets!  Love this beach!

reviews.title: Busy
reviews.text: Very popular, get there early for parking, wading, swimming or snorkeling, this beach has it all. Check it out.

reviews.title: Great Beach for all to enjoy
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach, just keep in mind it can get busy and parking may be tricky during peak hours. Very family friendly!Across the street you can walk to get snow cones or snacks!

reviews.title: Great beach to take a dip in a calm ocean.
reviews.text: My wife and I are in our 60s and found this to be a great beach to take a nice dip in a calm ocean setting. The beach is in a horseshoe shape so this cuts down on the big waves plus there's a lifeguard station there also. This would be a great beach to take little children to play in the ocean and not worry about any large waves or rip currents taking them out to sea.

reviews.title: Winter snorkeling salvation
reviews.text: OK I admit it, Go all the way to Hawaii and leave my snorkel in the luggage in the hotel. Luckily I was saved by my husband who loaned me his so I could look at the fish on this beautiful beach. I must say I saw over 20 species of fish in knee-deep water here. I wonderful salvation to my vacation and I love this beech.  Not to mention my sea turtle that was sleeping here.

reviews.title: excellent location for a variety of activies
reviews.text: Great for most people.  a double sided beach which allows for different activities according to the wind direction and state of the ocean.  Shower and toilet facilities also.  Nearby seafood restaurant as well as Brennecke Beach for boogie boarding.  Snorkel kit and boogie boards available for hire

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach with Great Swimming and Snorkeling
reviews.text: Poipu Beach was recommended as the best beach in Kauai by a friend and it did not disappoint. We went to Kauai in winter and many of the beaches were not swimmable due to rough waters but Poipu's unique reefs make it an ideal beach for swimming and the snorkeling was phenomenal. Highly Recommended!

reviews.title: Lovely spot at Sunset
reviews.text: Poipu Beach Park is a lovely spot..... not only a wide beach, but grass area with shade plus restrooms!  I went last evening and watched a beautiful sunset. Take a beach chair and a book and hangout for a while!

reviews.title: Nice Beach but Crowded
reviews.text: Very nice beach area about 25 minutes south of Lihue.  Heavily used by tourists from the many condos and other tourist havens in this area.  Fine white sand and there is plenty of beach for walks, sunbathing and building sand castles.  A good place to visit, if you are looking for a nice easily-accessible beach where you can spend some nice down time either alone or with your family – as long as you don’t mind the crowds.

reviews.title: Turtle watch
reviews.text: Grabbed a few brews at the corner store and hit the beach for sunset. Then apparently after sunset loggerhead turtles come to rest at the beach. We watched for another 30-45 mins after sunset and saw two turtles and a whale!

reviews.title: Busy Beach That's Great for Kids
reviews.text: If you're looking for a quiet, secluded beach, this is not for you. But if you're a family with kids of any age, it's ideal. A sheltered lagoon area is a perfect place to introduce little ones to water fun, and elsewhere, rolling waves provide plenty of excitement for older kids, teens, and adults. A playground and restrooms are readily available. As a senior couple, this wouldn't be our first choice of beaches on Kauai; but if we had been traveling with grandchildren, it would be perfect.

reviews.title: Beach Fun
reviews.text: Great little spot for family fun. Shallow protected pool suitable for kids. Some snorkelling can be done in this area. A turtle swam onto the beach!

reviews.title: Being in the center of a feeding frenzy of hundreds of fish is HILARIOUS!
reviews.text: We rented snorkel gear at the Nukumoi Surf Shop (no reefs but lots of fish – especially if you purchase fish food at the surf shop and then become the center of a feeding frenzy of hundreds of fish in the shelter of the rocks on the far left of the beach).

reviews.title: Beautiful calm beach
reviews.text: We've been at Poipu a number of times and it is definitely one of our go-to spots! It tends to be a little bit busy due to the resorts situated close by. The waters are relatively calm and comparison to other beaches around the island... good for kids, boogie-boarding, snorkeling Etc. Beautiful beach for sunsets! Depending on the wind and surf Heights there still tends to be a strong current if you go into the deeper areas.

reviews.title: Great spot for snorkeling and people watching...
reviews.text: We were on Kauai last week + a few - we stayed on Poipu at the Point.  This beach is a few mins drive and an amazingly beautiful place. Came here at night once looking for green sea turtles. No luck. Went snorkeling a day later and swam within a few inches (no kidding) of a humongus green sea turtle.  The only reason I didn't give a 5 was the facilities were dirty and in dire need of upgrading.

reviews.title: Snorkel where you can see
reviews.text: We went to lydgate first today to snorkel and visibility was sparse. We then went To Poipu and in shallow water were able to see around 15 varieties of fish in clear water at close range. Highly recommend,

reviews.title: Simply Amazing, Sea Turtle Beach
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite beaches on the Island of Kauai. There is great snorkeling here. Not only the water, but the view is fabulous. One of the best sunset beaches on the Island!  However my most favorite part are the Monk seals who come ashore to rest in the daytime and the amazing Green Sea Turtles who come ashore after the sun sets. A week ago, 8 turtles came up and 2 nights ago 9!!! Wow, what a sight. But please, please no flash photography as it can scare them back into the water where danger lurks at night. Just enjoy with no flashes or flashlights, respect them. Mahalo!

reviews.title: Just a lovely beach
reviews.text: We grabbed an Uber to the beach from our NCL cruise for a relaxing afternoon.  It is perfect--white sand, protected cove, monk seals, and of course, chickens!  Grab a shave ice from the shop across the way and you've got a perfect day at the beach!

reviews.title: Good snorkeling location
reviews.text: We enjoyed this beach three times while staying on the north shore and driving over to this location.  The beach was very good, but a bit tough to walk through where the sand was not packed.  The parking lot was full two of three times as the two were during the day and the last time in the early evening.  Get there as early as possible.  There are two lifeguard stations at this beach which was very welcome and indicated to us the importance of this beach.As I am not an experienced snorkeler, it was good to be here to practice and enjoy the 16 different types of fish that I saw on both days we were there.  So worth it to see the various types of fish, their colors, the shapes and what seemed like whimsical swimming.  My wife does not snorkel but she took the opportunity just to stand in the water and used my mask to look into the water to see some of the fish.It will be important to wear water shoes or socks as the there is a lot of rock just as you enter the ocean.  With this footwear, it was very easy to keep balance and prevent injury with scrapping from the rock.The washrooms were Ok based on the fact they need to be easy to clean and are used by hundreds each day.  We did go to the beach in an early evening and really enjoyed seeing a large turtle that came ashore.  During the other visits there were monk seals sunning and resting which was nice to see.  Loved it here and will be back next time we are in Kaua'i.

reviews.title: Beach close to Grand Hyatt
reviews.text: This beach is close to the hotel. It is probably not the nicest beach on the island. The sand is great, there is a lot of lava areas nearby, which are beautiful. The shore drops off to the water. The waves were pretty big, red flag warning all the days we were there, but people were able to surf and play in the water. A trail borders the water, is beautiful to see the coastline.There are some whale sittings at times!Public parking close by, no rentals available for gear, chairs, or umbrellas.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: We love this beach and park. It does get crowded early so get here early. Pack a lunch, lots of picnic tables or purchase from the local restaurant. We come here every year.

reviews.title: Great place to wake up
reviews.text: This beach has a great view, great place to snorkel (very shallow, not much surf) and some friendly turtles in the morning. The turtles are sun bathing until it get's too hot then take off (slowly as you can imagine) into the water and off into the sea. The beach and park are great for all people, families, couples, solo travelers, etc. There is a lot of space on the grass to set up shop if the beach is full. It's a short walk to another beach to body surf too, less than a 5 minute walk.

reviews.title: GREAT SPOT ON KAUAI
reviews.text: calm low key spot in southern kauai, condo was minutes away & family went here after a day site seeing on other key spots of kauai. easy snorkeling & turtle sighting

reviews.title: Good snorkelling in shallow water, and turtle town
reviews.text: We visited Poipu on a walk-by our first day here and several turtles were snoozing on the beach in the late afternoon, but no cameras! We returned a couple of days later to snorkel, and saw lots and lots of fish, a sea snake, and an eel. Later in the evening we walked back and 9 turtles had crawled up on the beach to snooze. Good spot!

reviews.title: Safe Snorkeling but watch your feet
reviews.text: This beach is really nice. It is pretty safe even for less experienced swimmers. It’s great for snorkeling with lots of fish to see in the relatively shallow water. We even saw a sea turtle and a rare monk seal was resting on the beach. It is very rocky though and if you have sensitive feet, it’s best to wear water shoes or flippers. The park has nice, shaded picnic benches and restrooms.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling!
reviews.text: We saw so many different kinds of fishes here, including eels! The fish aren’t even afraid of people. There were so many, some swam in schools. Great for little kids!

reviews.title: Relaxing and diverse
reviews.text: Has it all.  Barbecue grills for public use, fishing, rocks, beach.  Little coves, so even though it was very busy, felt private at the same time.  Spotted a monk seal right by the rocks, and watched sea turtles for a couple of hours in the surf.  Loved this visit!

reviews.title: Nice beach for families
reviews.text: Poipu Beach is a very nice beach to take your family to. It's lagoon is surrounded by a jetty keeping the water calm. The snorkeling is good and you never know when a turtle will show up.With two lifeguard stands it is very safe.

reviews.title: Great Beach for the family
reviews.text: Poipu is beautiful. It’s a very calm protected beach where everyone can get in the water. Snorkeling is good too. It can get a little crowded at times compared to other beaches in Hawaii. Worth the visit.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Snorkel here about the best place this time of yr. good place to swim for all ages but might want water shoes. Great views and stay for sunset. Monk seal was sleeping on the beach while we were there. Also every other Sun afternoon a group of locals get together and play ukeleles. Very informal very nice group. Im not sure they want publicity though. They have bathroom, lifeguard and restaurant/shop across the street.

reviews.title: Amazing beach for families
reviews.text: Great beach with protected sandy area for toddlers, plus good snorkelling.  Frequently turtles or seals resting on the beach too!

reviews.title: Nice Beach on Kauai's South Shore
reviews.text: Poipu Beach is a very nice, white sand beach where you can set up your sand chair and relax the hours away. Or you can hop on your boogie board or surf board or grab a sandwich at the local deli across the street or people watch.The beach has a life guard, restrooms and showers. There is a grassy area behind the beach where you can have a picnic, play frisbee or hang out.Parking is across the street with some spots on the street. Beware: it does get a little crowded, especially the weekend. Bring chairs, beach umbrella, your sunglasses and plenty of suntan lotion!If you have snorkel gear, you might bring that, too, although I did not see many people snorkeling on the several occasions I was there.Great sunsets, too!

reviews.title: Lifeguard on duty
reviews.text: This is one of the areas there is a lifeguard. The beach area is both sand or grass. There are several covered areas to picnic or just get out of the sun. The grassy area is full of tiny pine cones from the trees, so wear something on your feet.  While we were there a large green sea turtle came upon the beach.  It was beautiful  to see, but so  sad that so many people did not respect the large animal and did not give it room. The guards were told, but nothing done.  They needs some  conservationist on duty to educate the public.

reviews.title: So many people!
reviews.text: I thought this beach was just okay.  There we so many people there it was hard to find a spot.  We ended up in a section that was pretty rocky on the beach floor.  I'd go someplace else.

reviews.title: Lots of fish!
reviews.text: Shallow and clear beach with lots of fish and fish species. Swam monk seals who had just been sleeping on beach and then entered the water. Saw a moray eel resident who lives on one the shelves about 60 feet out. Not really a swimming beach per se due to corals and shallowness but lots of young kid with parents loved it. If you want to go into deeper water there are numerous other beaches just north or south at 5 minute drives. We came back twice to Poipu due to ease of snorkeling. Love it !!

reviews.title: Beautiful family beach
reviews.text: Great beach for family fun. Fun restaurant across the street. Plenty of room so don’t feel crowded. Can easily walk to it if staying close by the area.

reviews.title: Not so great
reviews.text: First, Whoever claims this is good Snorkeling hasn’t been lately (or at all). It’s cloudy visibility, (and we were there on a dry sunny week), totally overcrowded (and this was off season!), topography was sparse or just dead, and although we saw a few schools of fish through the churned up water, they seemed as though people were feeding them (so absolutely WRONG). Lifeguards are yelling into bullhorns every few minutes at unsafe surfers and swimmers without fins, so don’t count on any peaceful garden- island moments at this spot. Go to the north for peace and fewer crowds.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach. It sits in front of Kiahuna Plantation Resort and next to the Sheraton Hotel.  There are no lifeguards here.  There is a small public parking area in front of the beach.  Great waves and a few surfers.  Not too crowded.

reviews.title: Nice place to snorkel
reviews.text: This is a nice, protected, place to snorkel or swim.  The is a lot of parking and a lot of beach, but this place gets really busy!  We saw a Hawaiian Monk Seal basking on the shore as well as two large sea turtles.  The are a fair amount of fish swimming around.   To the left when facing the ocean is the calmest water.  Just at the edge where the sand ends and the rocks begin the are hundreds of different fish.  There are outdoor showers and restrooms here.

reviews.title: AMAZING Snorkeling & Turtles
reviews.text: We stayed next to this beach and snorkeled every day seeing amazing variety of fish and we saw several turtles dock this beach to lay out. It was incredible. There is also a great surf break to the right of the beach in front of the Marriott. You can enjoy all the water activities at this beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach with lifeguards and great snorkeling.  Also much wildlife.  You will see sea turtles and monk seals as well as a lot of fish!  Lively beach!

reviews.title: Sunset Paradise
reviews.text: This is probably one of the most beautiful, peaceful, isolated beaches you will ever visit. My first morning consisted of three seals asleep on a sandbar and a mama sea turtle asleep on the beach.  Great waves with lots of beginning surfers,  and lots of colorful fish to view just a few feet off the shore.   The sunsets combined with the roaring waves made this place Paradise.  Can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach for families and couples.  Swimming areas with lifeguards and a small "island" to swim to about 20 yards from shore.  There are beach areas and rocky areas if you want to swim or just watch the waves crash against the rocks.  And right across the street is Brennecke's Beach Broiler for food and drinks.  Poipu beach is one of my wife's favorite places to be.

reviews.title: Busy But Worth It. Good Snorkelling!
reviews.text: This is a very busy beach, but surprisingly, you won't mind the crowds. It's a wonderfully happy, sunny spot with a protected area for swimming and snorkelling. The abundance of tropical fish you can see are greater in number than at many other snorkelling sports on the islands. And BONUS- there's a deli across the park where you can pick order sandwiches to go and beer for your cooler! There are often turtles and mom seals resting on the sand. You need keep your distance from these protected animals. Take a sand umbrella for some shade.

reviews.title: Nice park
reviews.text: Lovely park/beach to spend a few hours at.  There is a beach and lawn area with plenty of picnic tables in the shade.  Lifeguard stand and protected cove area are good for children to swim.  I saw turtles swimming.

reviews.title: Great snorkeling and swimming
reviews.text: Great place to swim and snorkel on Kauai.  Sea turtles and monk seals are frequent visitors to this area including lounging on the beach while you swim.   Amazing variety of tropical fish species makes this an excellent place to snorkel and view marine wildlife.  Hundreds of tropical fish are present every time we swim here. Beach House happy hour is right down the road.   Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Favorite beach in Kauai
reviews.text: This beach has it all...beautiful sandy beach; safe for kids and timid swimmers; lifeguards; great snorkeling; grassy area; picnic areas; parking; restrooms and frequent ocean visitors-monk seals and turtles!  It's a lovely spot for sunrise and sunset.We miss the tombolo-a sandy strip of land that connected from the beach to a little "island".  It's made snorkeling on the right side almost obsolete due to rip currents, rough conditions.  However, there is still great snorkeling to the left.Hope the tombolo comes back!Poipu beach is very clean and family friendly. I suggest getting there early as it has become quite busy since the north shore beaches are closed (north of Hanalei)

reviews.title: Small but family friendly
reviews.text: This is a small beach on the south side that seemed very safe fro families with smaller kids.  It is also the one place on this part of the island where snorkeling seems to be done (although I am not sure what people can see there).

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach - a must if you're on Kauai
reviews.text: We went to Poipu Beach Park after a happy hour meal to walk the beach, take in the sights, & unwind. It is the perfect spot for that - & for playing in the ocean, snorkeling (there's a sheltered cove,) eating a picnic/snack, & people watching. As the sun set, several sea turtles even came up on the beach to hang out with us. Very cool - If you're on Kauai, this beach park is a MUST.

reviews.title: Public beach
reviews.text: We visited Poipu Beach while staying at the grand Hyatt resort because we couldn’t swim in the ocean at the hotel due to high waves. This popular beach was very clean and very swim friendly. The crystal clear water was awesome to snorkel and see colorful fish. The only downfall was the limited parking. You should get there early for good close parking located directly across the street. I highly recommend it

reviews.title: swim super but Monk Seals is the most interesting
reviews.text: yes of course it is nice for swimming but the most interesting is that there are nearly every Monk Seals coming on the sand for a rest and they lay there for hours, you can get very close to them(around 5-10 yards) As soon as they arrive people make  a kind of fence in order to protect and avoid that tourist get to close ( it is absolutley forbidden to get close and touch) we have seen them every day.

reviews.title: Nice beach on the south shore
reviews.text: We spent a really nice beach day here. It was a very nice area with bathrooms and parking available. We had a great time snorkeling and saw lots of pretty fish in very clear waters. Definitely need to bring water shoes as many in our group left with cut up feet from the rocks and coral on the bottom of the water. Not a great place to take a beach walk or really play in the water due to the rocky bottom, but still a great place to be!

reviews.title: our favorite beach in Poipu
reviews.text: Gentle waves in an ideal ocean temperature!  Great views of the sunsets nightly!  Not crowded; easy access to parking

reviews.title: Enjoy the Sunset
reviews.text: Our end of day destination. Great sunsets. Snorkelling and just enjoying the relaxation. Park for kids and restaurants and bars aling the strip. Lifeguards. Surfers like sunset surfing.

reviews.title: sunsets
reviews.text: Gorgeous sunsets every single night we were there, safe swimming and great snorkeling. Water shoes are recommended, rocks cut through your feet

reviews.title: Great snorkeling beach!
reviews.text: This beach is great for snorkeling.  There is an abundance of picnic tables, changing area and places to snack and eat across the street.  I saw a multitude of very colorful fish and on the sand bar was a sea turtle and sea lion!

reviews.title: Easy, nice beach
reviews.text: This is a popular spot and for good reason. Easy in and out of the water, snorkeling is often good, turtles may be hanging out, and there are shady areas on the beach so you can get out of the sun. All the good things one likes in a beach.

reviews.title: Best beach southern Kauai
reviews.text: Free and easy parking. A 5 minute walk gets you to this beautiful beach. Swimming, snorkeling, sun bathing etc etc. Ample of space to find yourself a great spot. The ocean is pretty flat here so excellent for novice snorkelers. Brenneckes, is a 5 minute walk a great place to eat and drink with below a snack bar to get an ice cream, some chips or a drink. Changes are high to see a turtle moving onto the beach. With a lifeguard on duty you will be quite safe here. Enjoy, highly recommended.

reviews.title: Across fro Brennekes -- Monk seals and turtles
reviews.text: This is our go to beach on Kauai. Lifeguards, nice grassy park, soft sand beach, toilets, lots of free parking, across from Brennekes ( a fave for dinner but also has snacks, rentals, snow cones, etc. The water is very nice -- not good for body surfing but some soft waves and a very protected area for the small kiddies off to the left. But Reef Walkers are a requirement for us -- the bottom is rocky. But the local Whalers Markets or ABC stores sell the reef walkers for about $10 a pair. Good snorkeling on the left side of the tombolo (the small island). Lots of fish. And there always seem to be 2 or 3 monk seals on the beach for a rest and usually a turtle, too. But stay back at least 15 feet or be prepared to pay a very stiff fine!

reviews.title: First Hawaiian snorkel
reviews.text: Very clean beach and restrooms.  Plenty of showers outside and near sidewalk of grass not into more sand.  The lifegaurds were on the ball to anounce to people about cautions! But hard to understand the PA system.

reviews.title: Rough waves for snorkeling but best turtle viewing spot
reviews.text: We went to Poipu Beach at 7 am - best time for calmer waves - but still very rough for snorkeling but best time to see giant sea turtles and monk seals which are going extinct - the sea turtles rest on this beach at night and return to the ocean in the morning - so great to see them early morning before they return - we also went about 8pm - saw 6 sea turtles but can’t use light - bad for the turtles - very hard to see them then - better to go early morning!

reviews.title: Very Nice
reviews.text: Great beach for swimming, snorkeling and for children. It has a protected area that's like an ocean swimming pool. Has life guards too. Places to rent snorkeling gear, to eat, benches and tables that are covered and bathrooms.

reviews.title: Family friendly and absolutely beautiful!
reviews.text: This is a really nice place to take your family and snorkel in a protected area.  If you approach the water on the left side, the bottom is soft and sandy without rocks.  The snorkeling if good but not great visibility.  I saw lots of small fish, a sea turtle and there were 3 monk seals sleeping in the afternoon sun right on the beach!

reviews.title: Great beach with 3 seals.
reviews.text: Great sand on this beach and there were 3 seals plopped on the beach where they cordoned off the area where they were to keep nosies away.

reviews.title: Best overall beach
reviews.text: This was our favorite beach because of it’s overall appeal to all ages: kids’ pool, snorkeling, boogie board, and seeing monks/turtles daily. I will go back here!

reviews.title: Beach park
reviews.text: Beach park for all ages. There is a wall to break the waves and allow for a small swimming cove for families and snorkelers. The snorkeling was fantastic.  Many different fish and lots of them. Picnic tables there. Showers and restrooms available.

reviews.title: Hardly any parking
reviews.text: The beach is pretty decent. The sandbar doesn’t go very far out and the beach is a little small. Good luck finding parking unless you belong to the Sheraton hotel.

reviews.title: Very pretty
reviews.text: This is a very pretty beach but we end up here every time the weather is bad and it's too murky to snorkel with too big of waves to enjoy the beach. We were able to see Munk seals and turtles and of course a glorious sunset.

reviews.title: Fun time
reviews.text: This is one of the most popular beaches on Kauai. For this reason it can be crowded by Kauai standards but nothing like you can find on Oahu or Maui. It is a beautiful beach and some decent snorkeling as well. We saw lots of fish not far from shore. We also saw a very endangered Hawaiian monk seal on the rocks there. It was great morning there.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Good snorkeling here and something for everyone with the protected “kiddy pool” area to the left (easy snorkeling entry from there). Common place to spot turtles or seals resting on the beach. The parking lot can fill up fast.

reviews.title: Nice safe beach
reviews.text: Poipu Beach is a safe beach for wading and snorkeling. There is lots of sea life at Poipu Beach and near by beaches. There are bathrooms.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Had a good time swimming and snorkeling. Pretty good snorkeling right off the beach. Surf shop With chair and equipment rental on site. Saw turtles, seals, tons of fish and of course the requisite chickens.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Not an easy place to swim but you can at least get in the water to swim, surf, snorkel or SUP. Great sunset views. Easy walking access to shops and restaurants.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The Poipu Beach Park was just a short walk from our timeshare. Every morning a beautiful sunrise and every evening a gorgeous sunset! The ocean is warm, clear and clean!

reviews.title: Favorite Beach
reviews.text: This beach is a great option! This side of the island has the best weather. There are a couple of different spots on the beach depending on what you want to do (a calm area in the water to relax in, surfing, and an area with a bit more waves to ride). The beach and sand itself is nice too and there are grassy areas, playgrounds and sitting areas too.

reviews.title: Honu and monk seals and beauty
reviews.text: Beautiful beach on the south side of Kauai, where lots of sea turtles (honu) and mink seals hang out on the sand. Beautiful views, relatively clean, and gorgeous sunrises and sunsets.
